website_content.summary: Punjabi University Patiala has released the May-2026 examination results for various M.Com and B.Tech courses. Students can now access their marks online via the official PUP results portal.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Punjabi University Patiala Result 2026 Overview
Punjabi University, Patiala (PUP) has officially declared the results for the **May-2026 examination cycle**. This release covers multiple undergraduate and postgraduate streams.

### 🎓 Courses Included in this Release
* **M.Com. Honors (FYIC)** - Sem-II (NEP), Sem-II Reappear, Sem-IV (NEP 2020)
* **M.Com. Hons Finance** - Sem-II & Sem-IV
* **M.Com. Hons (Five Year Course)** - Sem-IV (Regular & Reappear/Old Syllabus)
* **B.Tech. (E.C.M.)** - Semester VI

### 🛠️ How to Check Your Result
1. Visit the official result portal at **results.pupexamination.ac.in**.
2. Select the link corresponding to your **Course and Semester**.
3. Enter your **Roll Number** in the required field.
4. Click **Submit** to view your marks.
5. Download and print a copy for future academic or verification purposes.

### ⚠️ Important Instructions
* **Provisional Nature:** These results are provisional. Please verify them with the original DMC issued by the university.
* **Correct Link:** Students in the 'Reappear' or 'Old Syllabus' categories must ensure they select the specific link matching their category.
* **Discrepancies:** For any errors in the result, contact the **Examination Branch of Punjabi University, Patiala** directly.

website_content.title: Tripura NEET UG 2026 Round 2 Revised Seat Allotment Result
website_content.summary: TRMCC has released the Revised Provisional Allotment Result for Round 2 of Tripura NEET UG 2026 for MBBS and BDS courses. Candidates must rely solely on the revised list for reporting to institutes.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Tripura Medical Counselling Committee (TRMCC), under the Directorate of Medical Education, Government of Tripura, has officially announced the **Revised Provisional Allotment Result for Round 2** of the NEET UG 2026 counselling process. This result applies to candidates seeking admission into **MBBS and BDS** courses under the state quota.

## Key Highlights
* **Important Update:** A previous provisional result was withdrawn due to technical issues; candidates must use the **Revised** version.
* **Automatic Cancellation:** Candidates upgraded to a new seat in Round 2 will have their Round 1 seat cancelled automatically.
* **Result Format:** The result is published as a PDF containing the list of allotted candidates.

## How to Check Your Result
1. Navigate to the official TRMCC portal.
2. Access the **'UG Counselling'** section.
3. Click on the link for the **Revised Provisional Allotment Result of Round-2**.
4. Open the PDF and use `Ctrl+F` to search for your **Roll Number** or **Candidate ID**.
5. Verify the allotted college, course, quota, and category.

## Important Instructions for Candidates
* **Documentation:** Keep your NEET UG admit card, scorecard, and all original certificates ready. Incomplete sets may lead to rejection by the institute.
* **Reporting:** Report to the allotted institute within the specified deadline to avoid automatic cancellation of the seat.
* **Verification:** Do not act upon any results published prior to the Revised Provisional Allotment list.

website_content.title: Delhi High Court Despatch Rider-cum-Process Server Interview Admit Card 2026
website_content.summary: The High Court of Delhi has released the Stage-III Interview admit cards for Despatch Rider-cum-Process Server (Post Code 54/25). Candidates who cleared previous stages can now download their call letters for the September 2026 interviews.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The High Court of Delhi, through DSSSB, has announced the release of admit cards for the **Stage-III (Interview)** of the Despatch Rider-cum-Process Server recruitment. This is the final stage for candidates who successfully cleared the preceding examinations under Advertisement No. 04/2025.

## Key Highlights
* **Post Name:** Despatch Rider-cum-Process Server
* **Post Code:** 54/25
* **Current Phase:** Stage-III Interview
* **Conducting Body:** DSSSB on behalf of Delhi High Court

## Important Dates
* **Admit Card Release Date:** 16 September 2026
* **Interview Date (Batch 1):** 20 September 2026
* **Interview Date (Batch 2):** 27 September 2026

## Interview Guidelines & Dress Code
To ensure a smooth process, candidates must adhere to the following strictly:
* **Prohibited Items:** Calculators, laptops, mobile phones, smartwatches, Bluetooth devices, and other electronic gadgets are strictly forbidden.
* **Dress Code:** 
    * Light clothing with half sleeves.
    * No large buttons, brooches, badges, or flowers.
    * Slippers or low-heeled sandals (Shoes are **not allowed**).
* **Documentation:** Candidates must carry a clear printout of the admit card and required identification.

## How to Download Admit Card
1. Visit the official recruitment portal.
2. Enter your login credentials and registration details.
3. Verify your details (Name, Roll Number, Venue, and Time).
4. Download and print the PDF for the interview day.

website_content.title: RITES Limited Recruitment 2026: Engineering Professionals (Ports & Waterways)
website_content.summary: RITES Limited (Navratna CPSE) is inviting applications for Senior and Assistant Manager positions in Ports, Waterways, and Coastal Modelling. Apply by October 8, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## 🚢 RITES Limited Recruitment 2026

RITES Limited, a Navratna CPSE under the Ministry of Railways, is recruiting **Engineering Professionals** on a regular basis for specialized roles in maritime and coastal infrastructure.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 16.09.2026
* **Application Deadline:** 08.10.2026
* **Written Test (Tentative):** 25.10.2026

###  vacancy Details
| Post Name | Vacancies | Age Limit |
| :--- | :---: | :---: |
| Sr. Manager (Ports & Waterways) | 1 | 38 Years |
| Assistant Manager (Ports & Waterways) | 2 | 32 Years |
| Assistant Manager (Coastal Modelling) | 2 | 32 Years |

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria

**Educational Qualification:**
* **Bachelor's Degree** in Civil Engineering (Full-time).
* **Master's Degree** in Marine Engineering & Management / Ocean Structures / Structural Engineering or Coastal Engineering.
* **Minimum Marks:** 60% for UR/EWS and 50% for Reserved categories.

**Work Experience:**
* **Sr. Manager:** Minimum 8 years professional experience (including 5 years in design/analysis of marine structures).
* **Assistant Manager:** Minimum 2 years professional experience in marine structure design or numerical modelling of coastal processes.

### 💰 Salary & Benefits
* **Sr. Manager:** ₹60,000 – ₹1,80,000
* **Assistant Manager:** ₹40,000 – ₹1,40,000
* **Additional Benefits:** Medical facilities, Group Insurance, Maternity/Paternity leave, and Leave Encashment.

### 📝 Selection Process
1. **Written Test:** 125 objective questions (No negative marking).
2. **Document Scrutiny:** Verification of eligibility documents.
3. **Interview:** Final selection based on 60% Written Test + 40% Interview weightage.

### 💳 Application Fee
* **General/OBC:** ₹600 + taxes
* **EWS/SC/ST/PwBD:** ₹300 + taxes (Refundable upon participation)

website_content.title: AAI SSCO Consultant Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: Airports Authority of India (AAI) invites applications from retired Short Service Commission Officers (SSCOs) for 39 Consultant positions. The last date to apply via email is October 1, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Airports Authority of India (AAI), a Schedule ‘A’ Mini Ratna Category-1 PSE, is seeking retired Short Service Commission Officers (SSCOs) from the Indian Army, Navy, Air Force, or Coast Guard to serve as **Consultants** on a contract basis to support Air Traffic Services (ATS) at Joint User Defence Airfields.

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 17 September 2026
* **Application Last Date:** 1 October 2026
* **Interview Date:** To be intimated via email to shortlisted candidates

## Vacancy Details
Total Posts: **39**

| Location | Vacancies |
| :--- | :--- |
| Pune Airport (SMC) | 11 |
| Goa (Dabolim) Airport (SMC + ATC) | 15 |
| Port Blair Airport (SMC) | 04 |
| Darbhanga Airport | 03 |
| Purnea Airport | 04 |
| Kanpur Airport | 02 |

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Eligible Candidates:** Retired SSCOs of Indian Army, Navy, Air Force, or Coast Guard.
* **Educational Qualification:** Graduate in any discipline from a recognized university.
* **Professional Qualification:** Basic ATC Course/ATM and AL (Basic) and GCA/ATSS Course.
* **Experience:** Minimum 5 years of cumulative ATC duties (at least 1 year at a Joint User Defence Airfield).
* **Age Limit:** Maximum 50 years as of 01.10.2026. (Gap since retirement must not exceed 6 years).

## Selection Process
* **No Written Exam.**
* Selection is based solely on **Application Verification** and a **Personal Interview**.
* Merit ranking of the interview determines final selection.

## How to Apply
1. Download the Application Form (Annexure-1) from the official notification.
2. Attach self-attested copies of educational and experience certificates.
3. Merge all documents into a **single PDF (Max 5 MB)**.
4. Email the PDF to **[email protected]** on or before October 1, 2026.

**Note:** Applications sent via any other mode will be rejected.

website_content.markdown_content:
## Mumbai University B.Ed. Sem-II (CBCS) Result 2026

The **Mumbai University** has released the results for the B.Ed. (Sem-II)(CBCS) (Two Year Course) Examination conducted in August 2026. The results are available in an office register (PDF) format, organized center-wise and seat-number-wise.

### 📌 Result Overview
* **Conducting Body:** Mumbai University
* **Examination:** B.Ed. (Sem-II)(CBCS) (Two Year Course)
* **Programme Code:** 4E00142
* **Result Declaration Date:** 15 September 2026
* **Total Semester Credits:** 24

### 🛠️ How to Check Your Result
1. Visit the official result portal at **mumresults.in**.
2. Under the **'First Half 2026'** results table, locate the entry: `4E00142 - B.ED.(SEM-II)(CBCS)(TWO YEAR COURSE)`.
3. Click the linked PDF to open the office register.
4. Use your **Exam Centre Name** or search the PDF using your **Seat Number**.
5. Verify your result by cross-referencing your seat number with your **PRN (Permanent Registration Number)**.

* **Verification:** Always use both your seat number and PRN to avoid confusion with candidates having similar names.
* **Provisional Marks:** Internal marks marked with a carried-forward indicator are provisional until external theory results are finalized.
* **Official Documents:** The downloaded PDF is for immediate reference; official mark sheets/grade cards will be issued separately by the university or your respective college.
* **Grievances:** For any discrepancies, students must approach their college's examination department first.

website_content.title: SLPRB AP Police Recruitment 2026: Apply for 2,050 SI, Constable, and Scientific Assistant Posts
website_content.summary: The State Level Police Recruitment Board (SLPRB), Andhra Pradesh, has invited online applications for 2,050 vacancies across the Police, Fire Services, and Prisons departments.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The State Level Police Recruitment Board (SLPRB), Andhra Pradesh, has released six notifications to recruit **2,050 personnel** for various roles within the AP Police Department, State Disaster Response and Fire Services, and Prisons and Correctional Services.

## Vacancy Breakdown
* **Sub Inspectors (SI):** Including Civil, AR, SPF, Communications, and PTO (Total: 438 posts).
* **Police Constables (PC):** Including Civil, AR, Communications, Mechanics, and Drivers (Total: 1,556 posts).
* **Firemen & Warders:** State Disaster Response and Prisons Dept (Total: 309 posts).
* **Scientific Assistants:** Forensic Science Laboratory (Total: 43 posts).

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** 
    * **SI (Civil/AR/SPF):** Any Degree.
    * **SI (Comm/PTO):** Relevant Diploma/B.Tech.
    * **Scientific Assistant:** M.Sc in Physics/Chemistry/Biology.
    * **Constable/Fireman/Warder:** Intermediate or equivalent (SSC + ITI for specific technical roles).
* **Age Limit (as of 01.07.2026):** 
    * **SI:** 21–27 years.
    * **Constables:** 18–24/27 years.
    * **Scientific Assistant:** Up to 44 years.
    * *Age relaxations apply for EWS, BC, SC, ST, and Govt employees.*

## Selection Process
Depending on the post, selection involves:
1. **Preliminary Written Test** (Qualifying)
2. **Physical Measurements Test (PMT)**
3. **Physical Efficiency Test (PET)**
4. **Final Written Examination / Technical Paper**
5. **Trade/Driving Test** (Where applicable)
6. **Certificate Verification**

## Application Fee
* **SI & Scientific Assistant:** ₹600 (OC/BC) | ₹300 (SC/ST)
* **Constable, Fireman & Warder:** ₹300 (OC/BC) | ₹150 (SC/ST)

website_content.summary: GRID-INDIA is hiring 52 Executive Trainees for Electrical and Computer Science disciplines based on GATE 2027 scores. Interested engineers can apply via the online portal after the declaration of GATE results.
website_content.markdown_content:
## GRID-INDIA Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026

Grid Controller of India Limited (GRID-INDIA), a Miniratna-I CPSE under the Ministry of Power, is inviting applications for the position of **Executive Trainee** for bright and committed engineers.

### 📌 Vacancy Details
Total Vacancies: **52**

* **Executive Trainee (Electrical):** 37 Posts
* **Executive Trainee (Computer Science):** 15 Posts

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria

**1. Educational Qualification:**
* **Electrical:** Full Time Regular B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc (Engg.)/IDD in Electrical/Power Systems/Electrical & Electronics Engineering with minimum **65% marks/CGPA**.
* **Computer Science:** Full Time Regular B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc (Engg.)/IDD in Computer Science/Computer Engineering/IT with minimum **65% marks/CGPA**.
* *Final year students expecting results by 14.08.2027 are eligible if they meet the 65% criteria in pre-final semesters.*

**2. Mandatory Requirement:**
* Candidates must appear in and qualify the **GATE 2027** paper in the corresponding discipline. Only GATE 2027 scores are valid.

**3. Age Limit (as of 31.07.2027):**
* Maximum Age: **28 Years**
* Relaxation: OBC-NCL (3 years), SC/ST (5 years), PwBD (10 years).

### ⚙️ Selection Process
The final selection is based on a weighted score:
* **GATE 2027 Score:** 85% Weightage
* **Group Discussion (GD):** 3% Weightage
* **Personal Interview (PI):** 12% Weightage

### 💰 Salary & Benefits
* **Pay Scale:** Rs. 50,000 – 1,60,000/- IDA (E2 Level).
* **Additional Benefits:** Performance Related Pay (PRP), Company Leased Accommodation/HRA, Medical facilities, and other government-approved allowances.
* **Service Bond:** Rs. 5,00,000 for General/OBC/EWS and Rs. 2,50,000 for SC/ST/PwBD.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Advertisement Date:** 16.09.2026
* **Application Window:** To be notified after GATE 2027 results are declared.
* **Crucial Date for Age:** 31.07.2027

### 💳 Application Fee
* **UR/OBC-NCL/EWS:** Rs. 500
* **SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen:** Exempted

website_content.title: CTET Syllabus and Exam Pattern 2026 - 22nd Edition
website_content.summary: The CBSE is conducting the Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET) 2026 on December 12 and 13. This is a mandatory qualifying exam for teaching positions in KVS, NVS, and EMRS schools.
website_content.markdown_content:
## CTET 2026 Overview
The **Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET)** is a national-level entrance exam conducted by CBSE to determine the eligibility of candidates for teaching classes 1 to 8 in central government schools.

### 📅 Key Exam Details
* **Exam Dates:** December 12 and 13, 2026
* **Mode of Exam:** Offline (Pen and Paper / OMR based)
* **Certificate Validity:** Lifetime
* **Negative Marking:** None

### 📝 Exam Structure
Candidates can appear for one or both papers based on their teaching goals:
* **Paper 1:** For those aspiring to teach **Classes 1 to 5** (Primary Level)
* **Paper 2:** For those aspiring to teach **Classes 6 to 8** (Upper Primary Level)

### 📊 Marking Scheme & Qualifying Marks
Each paper consists of **150 MCQs** for **150 Marks** with a duration of **2 hours 30 minutes**.

| Category | Qualifying Marks | Percentage |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| General / UR | 90/150 | 60% |
| SC / ST / OBC / PwD | 82-83/150 | 55% |

### 📚 Syllabus Highlights

#### Paper 1 (Primary Stage)
* **Child Development & Pedagogy (30 Marks)**
* **Language I & II (30 Marks each)**
* **Mathematics (30 Marks)**
* **Environmental Studies (30 Marks)**

#### Paper 2 (Upper Primary Stage)
* **Child Development & Pedagogy (30 Marks)**
* **Language I & II (30 Marks each)**
* **Subject Specialization (60 Marks):** Either *Mathematics & Science* OR *Social Studies/Social Science*.

### 💡 Preparation Strategy
* Focus heavily on **CDP** as it is common to both papers.
* Use **NCERT Textbooks** for EVS, Science, and Social Studies.
* Solve **Previous Year Question Papers** to understand the pattern.
* Attempt all questions since there is **no negative marking**.

## Overview
The Himachal Pradesh Public Service Commission (HPPSC) has published the provisional answer key for **Paper-I (Screening Test)** for the recruitment of **Assistant Professor (College Cadre) Sanskrit** under the Department of Higher Education, Himachal Pradesh.

## Key Dates
* **Exam Date:** 14 September 2026
* **Answer Key Release Date:** 15 September 2026
* **Objection Window Opens:** 16 September 2026
* **Objection Window Closes:** 20 September 2026

## Objection Details
* **Objection Fee:** ₹100 per question (Non-refundable)
* **Submission Mode:** Online only
* **Requirement:** Every objection must be accompanied by an authentic supporting document/reference in **PDF format**.

## Step-by-Step Process to Raise Objections
1. Log in to the official HPPSC applicant portal using registered credentials.
2. Access the provisional answer key section for **Assistant Professor (College Cadre) Sanskrit, Paper-I**.
3. Identify and select the question(s) you wish to challenge.
4. Upload the required supporting PDF document for each question.
5. Complete the payment of ₹100 per question via the online link.
6. Submit the final objection within the specified window (16–20 Sept 2026).

## Important Instructions
* No offline objections will be accepted.
* Objections without the fee payment or supporting PDF documents will be summarily rejected.

website_content.markdown_content:
## HPU M.Lib.I.Sc Admission Counseling 2026-27

Himachal Pradesh University (HPU), Shimla, through the Department of Library & Information Science, has issued a notification for admission counseling for the **Master of Library & Information Science (M.Lib.I.Sc)** course.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Notice Issued:** 15 September 2026
* **Counseling Date:** 17 September 2026
* **Reporting Time:** 10:30 AM

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* Candidates must possess a **B.Lib.I.Sc degree** from a recognized, legally established Indian University or Institute.

### 📍 Counseling Venue
Department of Library & Information Science, Department of Evening Studies, The Mall, Shimla-01.

### 📄 Required Documents
Candidates must bring both **original documents** and **self-attested photocopies** of the following:
* Printed copy of the online application form.
* B.Lib.I.Sc degree and mark sheets.
* Category Certificates (EWS, SC/ST, OBC).
* Single Girl Child Certificate (Must explicitly state the candidate is the only child and only girl child).
* HPU-employee-ward, sports, or cultural certificates (if applicable).
* J&K migrant certificates (if applicable).

### ⚠️ Important Instructions
* Only candidates who have previously submitted the online application are eligible to attend.
* Failure to produce original documents may lead to disqualification from the counseling process.

website_content.markdown_content:
## UAS Mandya UG Admission 2026-27 (ICAR Quota)

The University of Agricultural Sciences, Mandya has officially released the provisional admission list for candidates selected via the **ICAR Quota (CUET-2026/UG)**. 

### 🎓 Programmes Covered
* B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture
* B.Tech (Food Technology)
* B.Tech (Biotechnology)
* B.Sc. (Hons.) Forestry
* B.Sc. Ag. (Hons.) Natural Farming

### 🏫 Participating Colleges
* College of Agriculture (Mandya, Hassan, Chamarajanagar)
* College of Forestry (Ponnampet)

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Reporting Period:** 12-10-2026 to 14-10-2026
* **Orientation & Class Commencement:** 16-10-2026

### 💰 Fee Structure
* **I Semester Fee:** Rs. 43,790 (via DD to 'The Comptroller, UAS, Mandya')
* **ID Card & Misc Fees:** Rs. 9,070 (Cash)
* **Hostel Deposit:** Rs. 15,000 (One-time cash deposit)

### ⚠️ Crucial Instructions
* **Document Verification:** Admission is provisional until original academic documents are verified. Failure to produce genuine documents will lead to cancellation.
* **Subject Eligibility:** Candidates who appeared in subjects different from those passed in 12th standard will be rejected.
* **Remedial Courses:** Students who studied Agri-Chemistry or Agri-Biology in 12th must take remedial courses in Mathematics and Physics.
* **Refund Policy:** Fees will not be refunded if admission is cancelled.

website_content.summary: The District Programme Officer, Gautam Buddha Nagar is recruiting 267 women for honorarium-based posts of Anganwadi Karyakatri and Sahayika. Applications are open until September 28, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
Direct recruitment for honorarium-based (contract) positions under the Child Development Projects (ICDS) in the urban and rural areas of Gautam Buddha Nagar district.

## Vacancy Breakdown
**Total Posts: 267**
* **Anganwadi Karyakatri (Worker):** 84 Posts
* **Anganwadi Sahayika (Helper):** 183 Posts

**Project Areas:** Shahar (City), Bisrakh, Dankaur, Dadri, and Jewar.

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Gender:** Only female candidates are eligible.
* **Education:** Minimum **Intermediate (12th pass)**. Candidates up to Postgraduate can apply; merit is determined based on the highest qualification.
* **Residency:** Must be a resident of the concerned **Gram Sabha (Rural)** or **Ward (Urban)** where the post is vacant.
* **Age Limit:** 18 to 35 years (Cut-off date: 01.07.2026).

## Selection Process
* **No Written Examination or Interview.**
* Selection is entirely **online and merit-based**.
* Priority is given to eligible candidates below the poverty line (**BPL**).
* Merit is calculated based on educational qualifications from Intermediate to Postgraduate.

## Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 07.09.2026
* **Age Cut-off Date:** 01.07.2026
* **Application Deadline:** 28.09.2026 (Midnight)

website_content.title: AIIMS Gorakhpur Faculty Recruitment 2026-27 Notification
website_content.summary: AIIMS Gorakhpur is recruiting for 68 Group-A Faculty positions across 31 medical departments. Applications close on October 13, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## AIIMS Gorakhpur Faculty Recruitment 2026-27

All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), Gorakhpur has released a detailed advertisement for the recruitment of **Faculty (Group-A)** posts. These positions are available via Direct Recruitment, Deputation, and Contractual basis.

### 📌 Vacancy Details
Total Vacancies: **68 Posts** across 31 departments/specialties:
* **Professor:** 18 Posts
* **Additional Professor:** 8 Posts
* **Associate Professor:** 24 Posts
* **Assistant Professor:** 18 Posts

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
**Essential Qualification:**
* **Basic:** MBBS or equivalent recognized by NMC.
* **Post Graduate:** MD/MS or NMC-recognized equivalent in the relevant subject.
* **Super-Specialty:** DM/MCh for relevant posts.

**Teaching Experience (Post-Qualification):**
* **Professor:** 14 Years (General) / 11-12 Years (Super-Specialty)
* **Additional Professor:** 10 Years (General) / 7-8 Years (Super-Specialty)
* **Associate Professor:** 6 Years (General) / 3-4 Years (Super-Specialty)
* **Assistant Professor:** 3 Years (General) / No experience required for Super-Specialty

### 💰 Salary & Pay Scale (7th CPC)
* **Professor:** Level-14A (₹1,68,900 – ₹2,20,400)
* **Additional Professor:** Level-13A2+ (₹1,48,200 – ₹2,11,400)
* **Associate Professor:** Level-13A1+ (₹1,38,300 – ₹2,09,200)
* **Assistant Professor:** Level-12 (₹1,01,500 – ₹1,67,400)

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 14.09.2026
* **Application Start Date:** 14.09.2026
* **Application Deadline:** 13.10.2026 (Online & Hard Copy)

### 📝 Application Fee
* **General/OBC/EWS:** ₹2,000
* **SC/ST:** ₹500
* **PwBD/Retired Faculty:** Nil

### 🛠 How to Apply
1. **Online:** Submit the application via the official Google Form.
2. **Documents:** Upload PDF/Word copies of application, brief of candidate, and PPT.
3. **Hard Copy:** Send signed application and self-attested documents via Speed/Registered Post to the Recruitment Cell, AIIMS Gorakhpur by **13.10.2026**.

website_content.title: Gujarat NEET UG 2026 Round 2 Seat Allotment Result
website_content.summary: ACPUGMEC has announced the Round 2 seat allotment results for MBBS and BDS courses in Gujarat. Candidates can now check their allotted institutes and download allotment letters.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Gujarat NEET UG 2026 Round 2 Allotment Details

The Admission Committee for Professional Undergraduate Medical Educational Courses (**ACPUGMEC**) has officially released the **Round 2 seat allotment results** for candidates seeking admission into MBBS and BDS courses in Gujarat.

### 📌 Key Highlights
* **Conducting Body:** ACPUGMEC
* **Courses Covered:** MBBS and BDS
* **Result Declaration Date:** September 14, 2026
* **Allotment Type:** Rank-wise and Institute-wise PDFs

### 🗓️ Important Dates
* **Choice Filling:** September 7 to September 11, 2026
* **Revised Provisional Merit List:** September 8, 2026
* **Seat Allotment Result:** September 14, 2026

### 🔍 How to Check Your Result (Without Login)
1. Visit the official portal.
2. Navigate to the **'Medical & Dental'** tab under the 'Undergraduate Admission' section.
3. Click on the **'Round 2 Seat Allotment Result'** link.
4. Open the Rank-Wise or Institute-Wise PDF and search for your Name, NEET Roll Number, or Rank using **Ctrl+F**.

### 📥 How to Download Allotment Letter (Login Required)
To complete the admission process, candidates must download their individual allotment letter:
1. Go to the official website and select **'Candidate Login'** under the Medical & Dental tab.
2. Enter your **User ID, Password, and 4-digit PIN**.
3. Download and print the allotment letter (Mandatory for reporting).

### ⚠️ Important Instructions
* Do not rely on SMS/Email; check the official portal for the most accurate status.
* Ensure you download the official PDF from the verified government website.
* If not allotted a seat in Round 2, keep an eye on subsequent or mop-up round announcements.

website_content.title: Cochin Shipyard Limited (CSL) Apprentice Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: Cochin Shipyard Limited invites online applications for 210 Technician (Vocational) and Trade Apprentice positions. Eligible Kerala domicile candidates can apply by October 8, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
Cochin Shipyard Limited (CSL), a premier Miniratna Schedule 'A' Government of India company, is offering **210 apprenticeship seats** for one year of training under the Apprentices Act, 1961.

## Vacancy Details
A total of 210 seats are available, split as follows:
* **ITI Trade Apprentices:** 205 seats across 16 trades (Electrician, Fitter, Welder, Machinist, etc.)
* **Technician (Vocational) Apprentices:** 5 seats in disciplines like Accounting, Nursing, and CRM.

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Education (ITI):** 10th Standard pass and ITI (National Trade Certificate - NTC) in notified trades.
* **Education (Vocational):** Pass in Vocational Higher Secondary Education (VHSE) in the concerned discipline.
* **Age Limit:** Minimum **18 years** as of 08.10.2026.
* **Domicile:** Must be a **domicile of Kerala**.

## Selection Process
There is **no written examination**. Selection is based on:
1. **Merit Shortlisting:** Based on percentage of marks in the prescribed qualification.
2. **Certificate Verification:** Original document check for shortlisted candidates.
3. **Medical Fitness:** Final selection subject to medical clearance.

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 16.09.2026
* **Application Last Date:** 08.10.2026
* **Age Reckoning Date:** 08.10.2026

## Key Highlights
* **Application Fee:** Nil (Free)
* **Stipend:** Rs. 11,000/- per month
* **Training Duration:** One Year

website_content.summary: The Department of School Education, Telangana has released the provisional answer keys and response sheets for TGTET-In-Service Teachers 2026. Candidates can now review their performance and challenge incorrect answers by September 17.
website_content.markdown_content:
## TG TET In-Service Teachers 2026 Answer Key

The **Department of School Education, Government of Telangana (SCERT & TGTET Cell)** has officially released the provisional answer key for the Teacher Eligibility Test for In-Service Teachers conducted via Computer-Based Test (CBT).

### 📅 Important Dates
* **CBT Exam Dates:** 7 September to 11 September 2026
* **Provisional Answer Key Release:** 15 September 2026
* **Objection Window:** 15 September to 17 September 2026
* **Expected Result Date:** 28 to 30 September 2026

### 📋 Key Examination Details
* **Exam Mode:** Online Computer-Based Test (CBT)
* **Total Marks:** 150 Marks (for Paper-I and Paper-II)
* **Papers Available:** Paper-I (Classes I-V) and Paper-II (Mathematics & Science / Social Studies)

### 🛠️ How to Download Answer Key & Response Sheet
1. Visit the official portal at **tgtet.aptonline.in**.
2. Click on the **"Answer Key"** or **"Initial Key Download"** link.
3. Select the relevant **Paper and Language Medium**.
4. Log in with registration details to download the PDF.
5. Cross-verify your Response ID with the Official Correct Option.

### 🚩 How to Raise an Objection
Candidates finding discrepancies in the provisional key can challenge them until **17 September 2026**:
* Log in to the objection portal using Application Number and Password/DOB.
* Select the specific **Question ID** you wish to challenge.
* Upload **valid documentary proof** or reference sources in PDF format.
* Pay the applicable objection fee via the online gateway.
* Submit the form and save the acknowledgment receipt.

### ⚠️ Important Instructions
* **Verification:** Ensure you match the Question ID for your specific shift and medium to avoid errors.
* **Proof Required:** Objections without supporting evidence will not be considered.
* **Finality:** The final result will be based on the **Final Answer Key** issued after the review of all objections.

website_content.summary: CEE Kerala has opened the second phase online option registration for M.Pharm admissions 2026-27. Eligible GPAT candidates must submit their college preferences by September 17, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
* **Course:** Post Graduate Course in Pharmacy (M.Pharm) 2026-27
* **Conducting Body:** Commissioner for Entrance Examinations (CEE), Kerala
* **Allotment Phase:** Second Phase Centralized Allotment
* **Qualifying Exam:** GPAT 2024 / 2025 / 2026
* **Registration Mode:** Online only via Candidate Portal

## Important Dates
* **Start of Option Registration:** 14.09.2026
* **End of Option Registration:** 17.09.2026 (up to 5:00 PM)
* **Provisional Allotment Date:** 18.09.2026
* **Final Allotment Date:** 19.09.2026
* **Fee Remittance & Joining:** 22.09.2026 to 24.09.2026 (up to 4:00 PM)

## Step-by-Step Registration Process
1. Visit the official CEE Kerala website.
2. Access the **'M.Pharm 2026 - Candidate Portal'**.
3. Log in using your **Application Number and Password**.
4. Navigate to the **'Option Registration'** menu.
5. Arrange Course-College combinations based on your priority.
6. Submit the options before the deadline (17 Sept, 5:00 PM).

## Key Instructions
* **Mandatory Action:** Online option registration is compulsory for second phase consideration, even if you already have a first-phase allotment.
* **Careful Selection:** Only select colleges/courses you genuinely intend to join; withdrawing later may result in loss of registration fees.
* **No Offline Submissions:** Options sent via post, fax, or email will be strictly ignored.

website_content.summary: Uttarakhand Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UKSSSC) invites online applications for 200 Scaler (Group-C) positions. The application process closes on October 22, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## 🌲 UKSSSC Scaler Recruitment 2026

The Uttarakhand Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UKSSSC) is recruiting for the post of **Scaler** under the Uttarakhand Van Vikas Nigam (Forest Development Corporation).

### 📌 Key Highlights
* **Post Name:** Scaler (Group-C)
* **Total Vacancies:** 200
* **Pay Scale:** ₹19,900 – ₹63,200 (Level-2)
* **Nature of Post:** Non-gazetted, Temporary (covered under EPF)

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 22 September 2026
* **Application Last Date:** 22 October 2026
* **Correction Window:** 26 October to 27 October 2026
* **PST/PET Date:** Tentatively from 19 November 2026

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** Must have passed **Intermediate (12th)** or equivalent with **Science or Mathematics** from a recognized board/school in India/Uttarakhand.
* **Preferential Qualification:** 2 years service in Territorial Army OR NCC 'B' or 'C' certificate.
* **Age Limit:** 18 to 28 years (as of 01 July 2026). Age relaxations apply for SC/ST/OBC and other reserved categories.
* **Domicile:** Candidate must be registered with Uttarakhand Employment Exchange, hold a domicile certificate, or have completed schooling in Uttarakhand.

### 🏃 Physical Standards (PST/PET)
**Height Requirements:**
* **Male:** 163 cm (Relaxed to 152 cm for ST/Gorkha/Garhwali/Kumaoni etc.)
* **Female:** 150 cm (Relaxed to 145 cm for ST/Gorkha/Garhwali/Kumaoni etc.)

**Physical Efficiency Test (Qualifying):**
* **Race:** Male (25 km in 4 hrs) | Female (14 km in 4 hrs)
* **Shot Put:** Male (5.00m) | Female (3.50m)
* **Long Jump:** Male (4.00m) | Female (2.00m)
* **High Jump:** Male (1.10m) | Female (0.70m)

### ✍️ Selection Process
1. **Stage 1:** Qualifying PST and PET.
2. **Stage 2:** Written Competitive Exam (100 Marks, Objective Type, 2 hours).
   * *Negative Marking:* 1/4th mark deducted for each wrong answer.
   * *Min Qualifying Marks:* 45% for UR/EWS/OBC and 35% for SC/ST.
3. **Stage 3:** Document Verification.

### 💳 Application Fee
* **UR/OBC:** ₹300
* **SC/ST/EWS/Divyang (Uttarakhand):** ₹150
* **Orphans:** No Fee

website_content.title: HPPSC Scientific Officer (NDPS) Recruitment 2026 - Syllabus & Exam Pattern
website_content.summary: HPPSC is recruiting for the post of Scientific Officer (NDPS), Group-B under the Directorate of Forensic Services. Candidates must clear a descriptive Subject Aptitude Test (SAT) covering Forensic Science and Chemistry.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The Himachal Pradesh Public Service Commission (HPPSC) is conducting the recruitment process for **Scientific Officer (NDPS), Group-B** for the Directorate of Forensic Services, Home Department, H.P. The primary selection stage is the **Subject Aptitude Test (SAT)**.

## Exam Pattern: Subject Aptitude Test (SAT)
* **Question Type:** Descriptive
* **Total Marks:** 120
* **Duration:** 3 Hours
* **Structure:** Divided into two parts (Part-I and Part-II), each carrying 60 marks.

## Detailed Syllabus

### Part-I: Forensic Science Fundamentals (60 Marks)
* **Forensic Basics:** History, scope, Locard's Principle, and AI/ML applications.
* **Crime Scene Management:** Evidence collection, 3D recording, blood stain analysis, and road accident reconstruction.
* **Dactylography:** Fingerprint classification, Henry system, and NAFIS.
* **Instrumental Methods:** Microscopy (SEM, TEM), Spectroscopy (AAS, ICP-MS), and Chromatography (HPLC, TLC).
* **Quality & Law:** ISO/IEC 17025:2017, BNS, BNSS, BSA 2023, and the NDPS Act.
* **Research:** Methodology, ethics, and plagiarism detection.

### Part-II: Chemistry & Pharmacology (60 Marks)
* **Chemistry Basics:** Organic, Inorganic, and Physical chemistry, Stereochemistry, and Proteins/Lipids.
* **NDPS Specialization:** Narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances, and active constituents of Papaver somniferum and Cannabis sativa.
* **Forensic Chemistry:** Arson investigation, petroleum products, and alcohol analysis.
* **Analytical Chemistry:** Volumetric/gravimetric techniques and GLP.
* **Separation Techniques:** GC-MS, LC-MS, and drug extraction methods (Stas-Otto).
* **Forensic Pharmacology:** Pharmacokinetics, drug metabolism, and toxicological studies.

## Key Preparation Strategies
* **Segmented Study:** Treat Part-I (Forensics) and Part-II (Chemistry/Pharmacology) as separate study blocks.
* **Focus on Instruments:** Deep dive into the principles and applications of spectroscopy and chromatography.
* **Descriptive Practice:** Since the exam is descriptive, practice long-form answer writing within the 3-hour time limit.
* **Legal Review:** Thoroughly study the BNS, BNSS, BSA 2023, and NDPS Act.

website_content.title: KBCNMU Temporary Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: KBCNMU has announced 138 vacancies for Temporary Assistant Professors across various university schools and departments. The online application window is open from September 12 to September 28, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
Kavayitri Bahinabai Chaudhari North Maharashtra University (KBCNMU), Jalgaon, is inviting applications for the post of **Temporary Assistant Professor (Contract)** for the academic year 2026-27. These positions are self-supporting and based on a contract.

## Key Highlights
* **Total Vacancies:** 138 posts across 54 subject codes.
* **Nature of Job:** Purely temporary and contract basis.
* **Posting Locations:** University Schools/Departments (Jalgaon), Science and Commerce College (Molgi), and Tribal Academy (Nandurbar).

## Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 11.09.2026
* **Online Application Starts:** 12.09.2026
* **Online Application Deadline:** 28.09.2026
* **Hard Copy Submission Deadline:** 05.10.2026 (up to 5:00 PM)

## Eligibility Criteria
Eligibility varies based on the subject group:

**1. UGC/State Government Rules (General Subjects):**
* Master's degree with at least 55% marks in the relevant subject.
* Must have cleared **NET/SET** or hold a **Ph.D.** degree as per UGC regulations.

**2. AICTE Rules (Computer Science/IT & Engineering):**
* **CS/IT:** B.E./B.Tech/B.S. & M.E./M.Tech/M.S. or B.E./B.Tech & MCA with first class in any one degree.
* **Engineering/Tech:** B.E./B.Tech/B.S. & M.E./M.Tech/M.S. with first class in any one degree.
* **Management:** Master's degree in Business Administration/PGDM/CA/ICWA/M.Com with first class and 2 years of professional experience.

## Selection Process
* **Short-listing:** Based on Maharashtra Government Resolution dated 08 March 2019 (Table 3A).
* **Final Selection:** Through a personal interview.

## Application Fee
* **Open Category:** Rs. 750/-
* **Reserved Category:** Rs. 375/-

website_content.summary: AIIMS New Delhi has announced the final Open Round of seat allocation for B.Sc. (Hons.) Nursing and Allied & Health Care Courses for the August-2026 session. Registration and choice filling must be completed by September 16, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## AIIMS B.Sc. Nursing & Allied Health Care Open Round 2026

AIIMS New Delhi has opened the **final round (Open Round)** for seat allocation for the August-2026 session. This is the last opportunity for eligible candidates to secure a seat.

### 📌 Key Highlights
* **Vacancies:** 239 vacant seats for B.Sc. (Hons.) Nursing across 19 participating AIIMS institutes.
* **Courses Covered:** B.Sc. (Hons.) Nursing and B.Sc. Allied & Health Care Courses.
* **Security Deposit:** A mandatory deposit of **Rs 25,000** is required for eligibility.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Registration & Choice Filling:** September 11 to September 16, 2026 (until 5:00 PM)
* **Seat Surrender Deadline:** September 15, 2026 (for existing seat holders)
* **Seat Allotment Result:** September 19, 2026
* **Reporting/Joining Period:** September 24 to September 28, 2026

### ⚠️ Critical Instructions
* **Eligibility Requirement:** Candidates must complete **both** the registration/choice filling and the payment of the security deposit to be considered.
* **Payment Warning:** The security deposit must be paid from the **candidate's, parent's, or relative's bank account**. Payments from cyber cafés or shared accounts are strictly prohibited as refunds are processed to the original source account.
* **Penalty Clause:** Candidates who are allotted a seat but fail to report within the stipulated dates will face a **penalty of Rs 25,000** in addition to the forfeiture of their security deposit.

### 🛠️ How to Register
1. Log in to the official portal using entrance exam credentials.
2. Click on the **'Open Round of Seat Allocation'** link.
3. Verify details and select preferred AIIMS institutes in order of priority.
4. Submit choices and pay the security deposit via the online payment link.

website_content.summary: GADVASU Ludhiana is inviting online applications for 45 Group C positions including Steno Typist, Clerk, and Storekeeper. The application window is open from September 16 to October 8, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## GADVASU Group C Recruitment 2026

Guru Angad Dev Veterinary and Animal Sciences University (GADVASU), Ludhiana, has released Advertisement No. 03/2026 for the recruitment of **45 Group C posts**. 

### Vacancy Details
* **Clerk:** 20 Posts
* **Steno Typist:** 15 Posts
* **Storekeeper:** 10 Posts
* **Total:** 45 Vacancies

### Eligibility Criteria
**Educational Qualifications:**
* **Storekeeper:** Bachelor's degree with Economics / B.Com / B.B.A.
* **Clerk & Steno-Typist:** Bachelor's degree from a recognized university.

**Mandatory Requirements (All Posts):**
* **Computer Proficiency:** 120-hour certified course in PC use/IT or 'O' level certificate from DOEACC.
* **Punjabi Language:** Must have passed Matriculation in Punjabi from PSEB or a recognized board.

### Selection Process
All candidates must first pass the **Qualifying Punjabi Language Test (Exam-I)**. Following this, the process differs by post:

* **Storekeeper:** Main Examination (Exam-II) focusing on General Knowledge and Core Subjects (Commercial Math, GST, Store Keeping, etc.).
* **Clerk:** Main Examination (Exam-II) followed by a **Qualifying Typing Proficiency Test** in both Punjabi (Raavi font) and English.
* **Steno-Typist:** Main Examination (Exam-II) and a **Shorthand Proficiency Test** (English & Punjabi), where shorthand marks contribute to the final merit.

### Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 16 September 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 8 October 2026 (4:00 PM)
* **Hard Copy Deadline (In-service only):** 21 October 2026

* **Regular Classes Duration:** Until the third week of June 2026

website_content.title: APPSC Welfare Officers Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: APPSC announces recruitment for 90 posts of Assistant Social Welfare, Tribal Welfare, and Hostel Welfare Officers. Online applications are open from 9 October to 29 October 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The **Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC)** has issued brief notifications (No. 25/2026 & 26/2026) for direct recruitment to various welfare officer positions across the state's Social, Tribal, and Backward Classes Welfare departments.

## Vacancy Details
A total of **90 provisional vacancies** are available:
* **Assistant Social Welfare Officer:** 11 Posts
* **Assistant Tribal Welfare Officer:** 06 Posts
* **Hostel Welfare Officer Grade-II:** 73 Posts (Distributed across Social, Tribal, and BC Welfare services)

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Assistant Social/Tribal Welfare Officer:** Bachelor's Degree from a recognized university or equivalent.
* **Hostel Welfare Officer Grade-II:** Educational qualifications will be specified in the Detailed Notification (due by 9 October 2026).
* **Crucial Date:** The date of the Detailed Notification will be the cutoff date for age and qualification eligibility.

## Salary Structure
* **Assistant Welfare Officers:** ₹48,440 – 1,37,220
* **Hostel Welfare Officer Grade-II:** ₹37,640 – 1,15,500

## Selection Process
Selection will be based on a **single-level online Computer-Based Recruitment Test (CBRT)**. There will be no screening test regardless of the number of applications.

**Exam Scheme:**
* **Assistant Welfare Officers:** 3 Papers (General Studies & Mental Ability + 2 Subject Papers), Total 450 Marks.
* **Hostel Welfare Officer Grade-II:** 2 Papers (General Studies & Mental Ability + Education), Total 300 Marks.
* **Negative Marking:** 1/3rd mark deduction for each wrong answer.

## Important Dates
* **Detailed Notification:** On or before 9 October 2026
* **Application Start Date:** 9 October 2026
* **Application Last Date:** 29 October 2026 (11:59 PM)

website_content.summary: APPSC invites online applications for 85 posts across the Pollution Control Board, Horticulture Service, and Forensic Science Laboratory. Applications open from 6 October to 27 October 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## APPSC Recruitment 2026 Overview

Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC) has released brief notifications for three distinct technical roles. Candidates must apply online via the official portal.

### 📌 Vacancy Details
* **Assistant Environmental Engineer (APPCB):** 40 Posts
* **Horticulture Officer (A.P. Horticulture Service):** 37 Posts
* **Assistant Director (A.P. State Forensic Science Laboratory):** 8 Posts

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Horticulture Officer:** 4-year B.Sc. Degree / B.Sc. (Hons) Degree in Horticulture from a recognized University/ICAR accredited institution.
* **Assistant Director (FSL):** 
    * **Forensic Engineering:** B.E. in Mechanical/Structural/Civil/Production Engineering.
    * **Physics:** M.Sc. in Physics or equivalent (Material Science, Nuclear Physics, etc.).
    * **Chemistry:** M.Sc. in Chemistry or B.Sc. with A.I.C. in Forensic Sciences.
    * **Biology:** M.Sc. in Botany/Zoology/Microbiology/Biochemistry/Bio-Tech/Genetics/Forensic Science or Degree in Medicine with B.Sc.
    * *Note: 5 years practical experience in Forensic/Analytical/Police Lab is required for AD (FSL) posts.*
* **Assistant Environmental Engineer:** Educational qualifications will be specified in the Detailed Notification (due by 6 Oct).

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Detailed Notification:** By 6 October 2026
* **Application Start Date:** 6 October 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 27 October 2026 (11:59 PM)

### 💰 Salary Scale
* **Assistant Environmental Engineer & AD (FSL):** Rs. 57,100 – 1,47,760
* **Horticulture Officer:** Rs. 54,060 – 1,40,540

### ✍️ Selection Process
* **Exam Mode:** Computer Based Recruitment Test (CBRT - Online).
* **Pattern:** Single-level examination (No screening test).
* **Negative Marking:** 1/3rd mark deduction for wrong answers (Confirmed for Env. Engineer & Horticulture Officer).
* **Additional Test:** Computer Proficiency Test (CPT) required for Environmental Engineer and AD (FSL).

website_content.summary: Lalit Narayan Mithila University has announced the Spot Admission Merit List for UG courses (B.A/B.Sc/B.Com) for the 2026-30 session. Selected candidates must complete their admission process between September 14 and 16, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
Lalit Narayan Mithila University (LNMU) has released the **UG Spot Admission Merit List 2026** for the 1st semester of Undergraduate courses under the Choice Based Credit System (CBCS). This represents the final round of centralized merit-based admissions for the academic session 2026-30.

## Key Dates
* **Merit List Release Date:** 13 September 2026
* **Admission Window:** 14 September 2026 to 16 September 2026

## Courses Included
* **B.A.** (Bachelor of Arts)
* **B.Sc.** (Bachelor of Science)
* **B.Com** (Bachelor of Commerce)

## How to Download the Merit List
1. Visit the official university website or the **Samarth Admission Portal**.
2. Log in using your **Application ID and Password**.
3. Search for your name/roll number in the Spot Admission Merit List PDF.
4. Download and print your **seat allotment/selection letter**.

## Admission Process
* **Verification:** Report to the allotted college within the specified window (14-16 Sept).
* **Documentation:** Carry all original documents along with self-attested photocopies.
* **Finality:** This is generally the final round; any remaining seats may be filled at the college level per university guidelines.

## Important Note
Candidates who fail to report to their allotted college by **16 September 2026** will lose their claim to the seat.

website_content.summary: DGME Uttar Pradesh has opened Round 2 registration for MBBS and BDS seats. Eligible candidates must register by September 17, 2026, to secure seats under state quotas.
website_content.markdown_content:
## UP NEET UG 2026 Round 2 Counselling

The **Directorate General of Medical Education and Training (DGME), Uttar Pradesh**, has announced the commencement of Round 2 counselling for MBBS and BDS courses. This round aims to fill the remaining vacancies across government and private medical colleges in the state.

### 🎓 Seats Available
* **Government Colleges:** 85% State Quota seats.
* **Private Colleges/Universities:** 100% State Quota seats.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Registration Window:** September 14, 2026 to September 17, 2026
* **Registration Fee Deadline:** September 17, 2026
* **Merit List Release:** September 17, 2026
* **Choice Filling & Locking:** September 17 to September 19, 2026
* **Seat Allotment Result:** September 21, 2026
* **Reporting to College:** September 22 to September 25, 2026

### 📝 Registration Process
1. Visit the official portal and click on the **Round 2 Registration link**.
2. Enter **NEET UG roll number**, application number, and personal details.
3. Pay the required registration fee and security deposit.
4. Upload necessary documents for verification.
5. Submit the form and download the confirmation page.

### ⚠️ Critical Instructions
* **Mandatory Admission:** Candidates allotted a seat in Round 2 must take admission, otherwise, the entire security deposit will be forfeited.
* **Re-entry for Round 3:** If a seat is allotted in Round 2 but not taken, candidates must pay the security amount again to participate in Round 3.
* **Eligibility:** Verify eligibility criteria thoroughly before making payments.

website_content.title: APPSC Recruitment 2026: Apply for 255 Assistant Director, Statistical Officer & Other Posts
website_content.summary: APPSC has announced 255 provisional vacancies for various technical and administrative roles. Applications are open from October 13 to November 2, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## APPSC Recruitment 2026 Overview
The Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC) has released notifications for direct recruitment to 255 provisional vacancies across six diverse roles. Selection will be based on a single-level Computer Based Recruitment Test (CBRT).

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 15 September 2026
* **Application Start Date:** 13 October 2026
* **Application Last Date:** 02 November 2026 (11:59 PM)
* **Crucial Date for Eligibility:** Date of Detailed Notification

### 💼 Post-wise Vacancy & Salary Details
| Post Name | Vacancies | Pay Scale (Rs.) |
| :--- | :---: | :--- |
| Assistant Statistical Officer | 196 | 37,640 - 1,15,500 |
| Analyst Grade-II | 18 | 48,440 - 1,37,220 |
| Assistant Director (Econ & Stat) | 17 | 57,100 - 1,47,760 |
| Inspector of Factories | 12 | 65,360 - 1,54,980 |
| English/Telugu Reporters | 11 | 57,100 - 1,47,760 |
| Assistant Director (Tribal Welfare) | 01 | 48,440 - 1,37,220 |

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Inspector of Factories:** Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical or Industrial Engineering + 2 years industrial experience.
* **Reporters:** Bachelor's Degree + Shorthand and Typewriting qualifications (English/Telugu).
* **Assistant Statistical Officer:** Bachelor's Degree with Statistics as a main subject or as a paper in the degree.
* **Analyst Grade-II:** Bachelor's Degree in Chemistry, Bio-Chemistry, Biology or Environmental Sciences.
* **Assistant Director (Tribal Welfare):** Master's Degree in Social Anthropology, Sociology or Social Work + 2 national journal publications.
* **Assistant Director (Econ & Stat):** Postgraduate Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics or Computer Science.

### ✍️ Selection Process
* **Mode:** Single-level online Computer Based Recruitment Test (CBRT).
* **Screening:** No screening test will be conducted.
* **Marking:** 1/3rd negative marking for wrong answers in objective papers.

## ERD Punjab Lecturer Recruitment 2026

The Education Recruitment Directorate (ERD), Government of Punjab, has officially released the admit cards for the **Lecturer (Group B)** written examination.

* **Total Vacancies:** 1,013

website_content.title: APPSC Various Posts Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: APPSC invites online applications for 299 provisional vacancies across 8 subordinate services in Andhra Pradesh. Applications are open from October 16 to November 5, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## APPSC Recruitment 2026 Overview
The Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC) has released brief notifications for **299 provisional vacancies** across eight different subordinate services. Selection will be based on a single-level **Computer-Based Recruitment Test (CBRT)**.

## Vacancy Details
| Post Name | Vacancies | Pay Scale (₹) |
| :--- | :---: | :--- |
| Executive Officer Grade-III | 104 | 25,220 – 80,910 |
| Industrial Promotion Officer | 78 | 54,060 – 1,40,540 |
| Supervisor Grade-I (Women Only) | 29 | 37,640 – 1,15,500 |
| Forest Section Officer | 26 | 32,670 – 1,01,970 |
| Forest Beat Officer | 23 | 25,220 – 80,910 |
| Draughtsman Grade-II | 20 | 34,580 – 1,07,210 |
| District Probation Officer Grade-II | 15 | 44,570 – 1,27,480 |
| Forest Range Officer | 04 | 48,440 – 1,37,220 |

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Executive Officer Grade-III:** Bachelor's Degree from a recognized university.
* **District Probation Officer:** Bachelor's in Social Work/Psychology or specified Master's degree.
* **Supervisor Grade-I:** Bachelor's in Home Science, BSW, Sociology, or specified B.Sc. streams (Women only).
* **Forest Section Officer:** Bachelor's degree in Science/Engineering (specific subjects).
* **Draughtsman Grade-II:** ITI Trade Certificate in Draughtsman (Civil).
* **Forest Beat Officer:** Intermediate (12th) pass or equivalent.
* **Forest Range Officer:** Bachelor's degree in Agriculture, Science, or Engineering (specific subjects).

## Important Dates
* **Detailed Notification:** On or before 16 October 2026
* **Online Application Starts:** 16 October 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 5 November 2026 (11:59 PM)

## Selection Process
* **Mode:** Online Computer-Based Recruitment Test (CBRT).
* **Stages:** Single-level examination (No Screening Test).
* **Normalization:** Marks will be normalized if the exam is held in multiple sessions.

website_content.markdown_content:
## APPSC Group-I Recruitment 2026 Overview

The Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC) is inviting applications for various **Group-I Services** positions. This is a premier opportunity for graduates to enter administrative leadership roles in the state government.

### 📌 Key Highlights
* **Total Vacancies:** 163 (Provisional)
* **Application Mode:** Online Only
* **Selection Process:** Screening Test $\rightarrow$ Mains (Written) $\rightarrow$ Interview

### 💼 Post-wise Vacancies & Salary
| Post Name | Vacancies | Pay Scale (Rs.) |
| :--- | :---: | :--- |
| Deputy Collector | 11 | 61,960 - 1,51,370 |
| DSP (Civil) | 36 | 61,960 - 1,51,370 |
| Divisional Development Officer | 35 | 65,360 - 1,54,980 |
| Asst. Commissioner of State Tax | 14 | 61,960 - 1,51,370 |
| District Educational Officer | 14 | 61,960 - 1,51,370 |
| Asst. Audit Officer | 14 | 54,060 - 1,40,540 |
| Deputy Registrar | 15 | 57,100 - 1,47,760 |
| Other Group-I Posts | 20 | Varies |

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **General Posts:** A Bachelor's Degree from any recognized university in India.
* **DSP (Communications):** B.E./B.Tech in Electronics & Communication, Electronics & Telecommunication, or Radio Engineering.
* **Physical Standards:** Candidates for DSP roles must meet physical requirements mentioned in the detailed notification.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Brief Notification Released:** 15/09/2026
* **Detailed Notification:** On or before 06/10/2026
* **Online Application Starts:** 06/10/2026
* **Application Deadline:** 27/10/2026 (11:59 PM)

### 📝 Selection Process
1. **Screening Test:** OMR-based objective papers (General Studies & General Aptitude). 1/3rd negative marking applies.
2. **Mains Exam:** Descriptive papers including Qualifying English/Telugu and five core subject papers.
3. **Interview:** Final stage carrying 75 marks.

website_content.title: Mysore City Corporation (MCC) UGD Helper Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: Mysuru Mahanagara Palike is recruiting 116 UGD Helpers through a special internal process. Applications must be submitted offline by October 9, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
Mysuru Mahanagara Palike (MCC) has announced a **special, one-time recruitment** for 116 UGD Helper (Under Ground Drainage Helper) positions. Please note that this is **not an open recruitment** and is restricted to existing personnel.

## Key Highlights
* **Total Vacancies:** 116
* **Pay Scale:** Rs. 27,000 – Rs. 46,675
* **Application Mode:** Offline (In-person submission)
* **Selection Basis:** Purely on merit based on length of continuous service

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Employment Status:** Must be currently working in MCC on daily-wage, contract, outsourcing, or equal-pay-for-equal-work terms.
* **Experience:** Minimum **2 years of continuous service** performing UGD Helper or equivalent duties.
* **Language:** Must be conversant in **Kannada**.
* **Exclusions:** Candidates engaged through STP (Sewage Treatment Plant) or Wet Well contracts are not eligible.
* **Age Limit:** 18 to 55 years.

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 10 September 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 09 October 2026, 5:30 PM

## Documents Required
* Prescribed application form with passport-size photo
* Proof of Date of Birth
* Certified proof of current engagement and service length at MCC
* Certified ESI and PF documents
* Relevant Caste/Income/Rural/Disability certificates (if applicable)

## How to Apply
1. Collect the free application form from the **MCC Central Office, Sayyaji Rao Road, Mysuru-570004**.
2. Fill in the details accurately and attach self-attested copies of all required documents.
3. Submit the completed form **by hand** at the MCC Central Office on or before the deadline.

website_content.title: Deoghar Home Guard (Grih Rakshak) Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: JGRV Deoghar has announced 772 vacancies for Rural and Urban Home Guard posts. Eligible candidates from Deoghar district must apply online by October 26, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## 📢 Overview
Jharkhand Griha Raksha Vahini (JGRV), Deoghar has released Advertisement No. 01/2026 for the enrolment of **Home Guards (Grih Rakshak)**. This is a voluntary enrolment opportunity for residents of Deoghar to serve the nation.

## 📊 Vacancy Details
Total Vacancies: **772**
* **Rural Home Guard:** 635 Posts (Block-wise distribution)
* **Urban Home Guard:** 137 Posts (Technical & Non-Technical)
* **Women's Reservation:** 50% of posts are earmarked for women.

## 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
### 1. Educational Qualification
* **Rural Home Guard:** Minimum 7th class pass.
* **Urban Home Guard:** Minimum Matric (10th) pass.

### 2. Age Limit (as of 01.01.2026)
* **Minimum Age:** 19 Years
* **Maximum Age:** 40 Years

### 3. Residence
* Candidates must be permanent/ordinary residents of the respective Deoghar block or urban area.

### 4. Physical Standards
| Parameter | Male (Gen/OBC/BC) | Male (ST/SC) | Female (All) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Height** | 162 cm | 157 cm | 148 cm |
| **Chest** | 79 cm | 76 cm | N/A |

## 🛠️ Selection Process
1. **Physical Efficiency Test (PET):** Race, High Jump, Long Jump, and Shot Put.
2. **Hindi Writing Ability Test:** Qualifying test (30% minimum marks).
3. **Technical Skill Test:** Only for Urban Technical candidates.
4. **Final Phase:** Merit List $\rightarrow$ Document Verification $\rightarrow$ Medical $\rightarrow$ Police Verification.

## 📅 Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 11 October 2026
* **Application Last Date:** 26 October 2026 (up to 5:00 PM)
* **Exam Dates:** To be announced via newspapers/website.

## 💰 Application Fee & Allowance
* **Fee:** Rs. 100/- (Online payment)
* **Allowance:** This is a **voluntary enrolment**, not a salaried job. Duty allowance is paid only for days actually deployed on duty.

website_content.title: SMC Provisional Answer Key 2026: Download OMR & Raise Objections
website_content.summary: Surat Municipal Corporation has released the provisional answer keys and OMR download instructions for Supervisor, Junior Pharmacist, Assistant Auditor, and Technical Officer posts. Candidates must submit objections by September 15, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## SMC Provisional Answer Key 2026

The Surat Municipal Corporation (SMC) Recruitment Department has released the official notice regarding the provisional answer keys for the written examinations held on **06/09/2026**. This update is critical for candidates who appeared for the following positions:

* **Supervisor (Computer)**
* **Junior Pharmacist**
* **Assistant Auditor**
* **Technical Officer**

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Notice Release Date:** 10 September 2026
* **Answer Key Objection Window:** 11 September to 15 September 2026
* **Last Date to Download OMR Sheet:** 17 September 2026

### 📥 How to Download Your OMR Sheet
Candidates must download their OMR sheets before the deadline to avoid missing out:
1. Visit the **RECRUITMENT** section on the official SMC website.
2. Click on the **"ANSWER KEY(S)"** link.
3. Enter your **Application Number** (Format: AAAA/BBBBBB/CCC/DDDDDD), **Seat Number**, and **Date of Birth**.
4. Save the PDF for your records.

### ⚠️ Objection Process (Query Reporting)
If you disagree with the provisional answer key, you may raise an objection under these conditions:
* **Format:** Use the prescribed "Query Reporting Form for Provisional Answer Key".
* **Evidence:** Attach a certified/self-attested color scanned copy of valid documentary evidence.
* **Submission:** Send via e-mail to the official recruitment email address.
* **Deadline:** Objections must be submitted between **11/09/2026 and 15/09/2026**. Objections after this window will not be considered.

website_content.markdown_content:
## NHM Tamil Nadu Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026

The District Health Society, under the National Health Mission - Tamil Nadu, has announced a massive recruitment drive for **Contractual/Temporary Staff Nurses**. These positions are available across institutions under the Directorate of Public Health and Preventive Medicine, Medical and Rural Health Services, Medical Education & Research, and the Greater Chennai Corporation.

### 📌 Key Highlights
* **Total Vacancies:** 4,724
* **Post Name:** Contractual/Temporary Staff Nurse
* **Nature of Job:** Purely Temporary / Contract Basis
* **Application Mode:** Offline (Physical Submission)

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** Candidates must possess a **GNM (General Nursing and Midwifery)** or **B.Sc. Nursing** degree from an Indian Nursing Council-recognised institution.
* **Professional Registration:** Valid registration with the **Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council** is mandatory.
* **Age Limit:** Maximum age is **50 years**.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 12-09-2026
* **Application Deadline:** 25-09-2026 (until 5:00 PM)

### 📍 Job Locations
Vacancies are available across districts of Tamil Nadu. 
**Note:** This recruitment is NOT applicable to **Tiruppur** and **Chengalpattu** districts due to the Model Code of Conduct.

### 📝 How to Apply
1. Download the application form and district-wise vacancy details from the official NHM-TN website.
2. Complete the form and attach self-attested photocopies of all required documents.
3. Submit the physical application to the **Office of the District Health Officer/District Health Society** of the concerned district by the deadline.

* **Reasoning:** 15 Marks
* **Arithmetic Abilities:** 15 Marks
* **General Science:** 10 Marks
* **Duration:** 80 Minutes | **Negative Marking:** None

### 💰 Application Fee
* **UR/EWS:** ₹600
* **SC/ST/ALC:** ₹500

* **Application Start Date:** 29 August 2026

* **PST/PET Commencement:** 22 September 2026 onwards

| Post Name | Vacancies | Pay Scale (Rs.) |

website_content.title: MPESB Naib Tehsildar Departmental Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: MPESB invites applications for 73 Naib Tehsildar posts through a Limited Departmental Competitive Examination. This recruitment is exclusively for eligible serving employees of the MP Revenue Department.
website_content.markdown_content:
## 📢 Recruitment Overview
**MPESB** has announced the **Naib Tehsildar Departmental Limited Competitive Examination 2026**. Please note that this is a **Limited Departmental Exam** and is NOT open to the general public.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 17 September 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 01 October 2026
* **Correction Window:** 17 September to 06 October 2026
* **Probable Exam Date:** Starting from 14 November 2026

### 🔢 Vacancy Details
Total Posts: **73**
* **Clerical Service Cadre:** 46 Posts
* **Patwari/Revenue Inspector Cadre:** 27 Posts
*(Includes Direct Recruitment and Backlog vacancies)*

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Departmental Status:** Must be a regular/officiating employee for at least **5 years** in the Revenue Mandal, Commissioner Land Records, Principal Revenue Commissioner, Divisional Commissioner, or Collector establishments.
* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Arts, Science, Commerce, or Agriculture from a recognized university.
* **Age Limit:** Maximum **55 years** as of 01 January 2026.

### 💰 Salary & Fees
* **Pay Scale:** Level-9 (₹36,200 – ₹1,14,800)
* **Application Fee:** ₹2,000 (plus portal charges)

### ✍️ Selection Process
Selection is based on two objective-type papers (100 marks each):
* **Paper I:** General Reasoning, GK, Hindi, English, Maths, Science, and Computer Knowledge.
* **Paper II:** Govt Service Rules, Revenue Terminology, Land Revenue Code 1959, Revenue Book Circular, and Land Records Rules.
* **Qualifying Marks:** 55% for General; 40% for SC/ST.

* **Strict Timelines:** KEA will not be responsible for any loss of seat due to failure to follow the mandated procedure or timelines.

website_content.markdown_content:
## UP ITI Admission 2026 - 2nd Round Seat Allotment

The **State Council for Vocational Training, Uttar Pradesh (SCVTUP)** has announced the 2nd Allotment Result for admissions into Government and Private Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs) across the state for the 2026 session.

### 📌 Key Admission Details
* **Admission Mode:** Purely Merit-Based (No written exam).
* **Eligibility Basis:** Marks obtained in Class 8th or Class 10th.
* **Allocation Process:** Seat allotment is conducted in multiple rounds. Candidates not allotted a seat in the first round are automatically considered for subsequent rounds.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **2nd Allotment Result Date:** 12 September 2026
* **Reporting & Fee Payment Deadline:** 17 September 2026

### 🛠️ How to Check Your Allotment Result
1. Visit the official admission portal.
2. Navigate to the **'Round 2 seat allotment result'** section.
3. Log in using your **Application Number** and **Password**.
4. View your allotted institute and trade/branch.
5. Download and print the **Seat Allotment Letter** for the physical reporting process.

### ⚠️ Crucial Instructions
* **Login Credentials:** Note that Round 2 requires an Application Number and Password (unlike Round 1 which used DOB).
* **Freeze vs Float:** If the option is available, 'Floating' allows you to seek a better seat in the next round, while 'Freezing' confirms your current seat.
* **Deadline:** Failure to report to the allotted institute by **17 September 2026** will result in the forfeiture of the seat.

website_content.markdown_content:
## WBUAFS B.F.Sc. (Hons.) Admission 2026-2027

The West Bengal University of Animal and Fishery Sciences (WBUAFS) has released the official notification for the **Counselling cum Admission** process for the 4-year Bachelor of Fishery Science [B.F.Sc. (Hons.)] degree program.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Counselling & Physical Reporting:** 15-09-2026
* **Reporting Time:** 10:45 A.M. to 11:45 A.M.
* **Commencement of Classes:** 16-09-2026

### 🎓 Course Overview
* **Course:** Bachelor of Fishery Science [B.F.Sc. (Hons.)]
* **Duration:** 4 Years
* **Academic Session:** 2026-2027

### 📜 Reservation & Eligibility Rules
* **OBC Candidates:** Must provide a Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) certificate issued on or after 01.04.2026. Without this, candidates will be treated as General/UR.
* **EWS Certificates:** Must be issued on or after 01.04.2026 as per West Bengal Government guidelines.
* **Domicile Proof:** Domicile certificates issued by elected representatives (MLA, MP, Councilor, etc.) are **NOT acceptable**. Use Proforma b or e-District certificates.
* **PwD:** Seats are filled on a horizontal basis within respective categories.

### ⚠️ Key Instructions for Candidates
* **Merit-Based:** Admissions are strictly based on the Provisional Merit List.
* **Documents:** Original documents are mandatory for verification during reporting.
* **Anti-Ragging:** Selected candidates must submit an online Anti-Ragging affidavit via www.antiragging.in or www.amanmovement.org at the time of registration.
* **Provisional Nature:** All admissions are provisional and subject to verification of documents and eligibility.

website_content.title: ISRO IPRC Recruitment 2026: Apply for Technical Assistant, Technician 'B' & More
website_content.summary: ISRO Propulsion Complex (IPRC) invites online applications for 22 specialized posts across various technical and support roles. The application window is open from 15 September to 5 October 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## 🚀 ISRO IPRC Recruitment 2026

The **ISRO Propulsion Complex (IPRC)**, located in Mahendragiri, Tamil Nadu, has released a recruitment notification (Advt No. IPRC/RMT/2026/01) for various technical and support positions. 

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 12 September 2026
* **Application Start Date:** 15 September 2026
* **Application Last Date:** 05 October 2026

### 🛠️ Vacancy Details
| Post Name | Total Posts | Qualification |
| :--- | :---: | :--- |
| **Technical Assistant** (Auto/Mech/EC) | 5 | First Class Diploma in relevant branch |
| **Technician 'B'** (Turner/Fitter/Welder/etc) | 13 | 10th Std + ITI (NCVT/NAC) |
| **Cook 'A'** | 1 | 10th Std + 5 Years Experience |
| **Fireman 'A'** | 3 | 10th Std + Physical Fitness |

### 💰 Pay Scale
* **Technical Assistant:** Level 7 (Rs. 44,900 – Rs. 1,42,400)
* **Technician ‘B’:** Level 3 (Rs. 21,700 – Rs. 69,100)
* **Cook ‘A’ & Fireman ‘A’:** Level 2 (Rs. 19,900 – Rs. 63,200)

### 🎓 Eligibility Highlights
* **Technical Assistant:** Must possess a **First Class Diploma** in the specified engineering discipline.
* **Technician 'B':** Must have passed **10th/SSC** and hold an **ITI certificate** with NTC/NAC from NCVT.
* **Cook 'A':** Requires a certificate of experience from a well-established hotel/canteen (individual certificates not accepted).
* **Fireman 'A':** Requires 10th pass and a **Preliminary Medical Examination Certificate** to be uploaded during application.

### 📝 Selection Process
* **Cook 'A':** Selection involves a **Skill Test** based on experience certificates.
* **Fireman 'A':** Candidates must meet prescribed **Physical Fitness Standards**.
* For other posts, please refer to the detailed advertisement on the official portal.

website_content.summary: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) has released the interview call letters for the Design Trainee (DT) and Management Trainee (MT) 2026 recruitment. Shortlisted candidates can now download their letters for the personal interviews scheduled in Bengaluru.
website_content.markdown_content:
## HAL DT & MT Interview Call Letter 2026

Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL), a Maharatna CPSE, has officially issued the **Interview Call Letters** for candidates who cleared the CBT written exam for the posts of **Design Trainee (DT)** and **Management Trainee (MT)**.

### 📌 Quick Overview
* **Organization:** Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL)
* **Advertisement No:** HAL/CHRC-TM/RECT-02/2026
* **Total Vacancies:** 120 (60 DT + 60 MT)
* **Current Stage:** Interview Call Letter Download
* **Interview Venue:** Bengaluru

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Interview Call Letter Release:** 12 September 2026
* **Personal Interview Dates:** 21 to 25 September 2026

### 🛠️ How to Download Call Letter
1. Visit the official login portal at **cbexams.com**.
2. Navigate to the link for **Interview Call Letter - DT/MT 2026**.
3. Log in using your **Application Number** and **Date of Birth**.
4. Download the call letter and take at least two clear printouts.

### 📂 Documents Required for Interview
* **Printed Call Letter:** Mandatory copy of the interview letter.
* **Identity Proof:** Valid government-issued photo ID.
* **Educational Records:** Original and photocopies of all mark sheets and degree certificates.
* **Category Certificate:** Valid SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS certificates (if applicable).
* **PwBD Certificate:** From a competent authority (if claiming reservation).

### ⚠️ Key Instructions
* **Single Application:** Candidates who applied for both DT and MT posts face rejection.
* **Posting Locations:** Selected trainees may be posted in Bengaluru, Tumakuru, Hyderabad, Nasik, Koraput, Barrackpore, Lucknow, Kanpur, or Korwa.
* **Caution:** HAL does not take payments for employment; beware of fraudsters.

website_content.title: BLW Varanasi Sports Quota Recruitment 2026-27
website_content.summary: Banaras Locomotive Works (BLW) invites online applications from eligible Indian sportspersons for 25 vacancies across various sports disciplines. The application window closes on October 12, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## 🏆 BLW Sports Quota Recruitment 2026-27

Banaras Locomotive Works (BLW), Varanasi, under Indian Railways, is recruiting talented sportspersons for **25 positions** under the Sports Quota (Open Advertisement) for the year 2026-27.

### 📋 Vacancy Details
Total Posts: **25**
* **Basketball (Men):** 6 Posts
* **Volleyball (Men):** 7 Posts
* **Wrestling (Men):** 4 Posts
* **Handball (Men):** 8 Posts

**Pay Level Distribution:**
* Pay Level-5: 2 Posts
* Pay Level-2: 8 Posts
* Pay Level-1: 15 Posts

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
**Educational Qualification:**
* **Pay Level 5:** Graduation/Degree from a recognized university.
* **Pay Level 2:** 12th Pass (+2 stage) or equivalent.
* **Pay Level 1:** 10th Pass / ITI or equivalent.

**Sports Qualification:**
Candidates must meet specific achievement norms (Category A, B, or C) based on the Pay Level they are applying for. Achievements must be from events held on or after **01.04.2024**.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 12.09.2026
* **Application Closing Date:** 12.10.2026
* **Age Cut-off Date:** 01.01.2027

### 🔞 Age Limit (as of 01.01.2027)
* **Minimum Age:** 18 Years
* **Maximum Age:** 25 Years
* *Note: No age relaxation is provided for any community.*

### 💰 Application Fee
* **General Category:** ₹400
* **SC/ST/Ex-SM/PwBD/Minorities/EBC:** ₹250
* **Note:** Fees are **refundable** for candidates who actually appear in the trials.

### ⚙️ Selection Process
Selection is based on a composite score of 100 marks:
1. **Sports Trials:** 40 Marks (Minimum 25 required to be 'FIT')
2. **Sports Achievements:** 50 Marks
3. **Educational Qualification:** 10 Marks

**Final Step:** Medical Examination and a mandatory 5-year Service Bond.

website_content.markdown_content:

Punjabi University, Patiala has released the provisional results for multiple UG and PG courses. Students who appeared for the May/June 2026 and December 2025 sessions can now check their marksheets online.

website_content.title: NCRTC Supervisor-I & Junior Maintainer Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: NCRTC is recruiting for 90 technical posts including Supervisor-I and Junior Maintainer for the Namo Bharat Project. Apply by October 9, 2026, via the official portal.
website_content.markdown_content:
## 🚆 NCRTC Recruitment 2026 Overview
NCRTC has announced vacancies under two separate notices for the **Namo Bharat Project**. This is a prime opportunity for technical graduates and diploma holders to work with a prestigious Joint Venture of the Govt of India and State Governments.

### 📊 Vacancy Breakdown
* **Notice No. 33/2026 (Contract Basis):** 23 Posts (Supervisor-I & Junior Maintainer)
* **Notice No. 32/2026 (Direct Recruitment):** 67 Posts (Operations & Maintenance Staff)
* **Total Vacancies:** 90

### 🛠️ Post Details & Eligibility
**1. Supervisor-I (Pay Level S1):**
* **Trades:** IT, Full Stack Developer, Corporate Hospitality, Corporate Communications, Electrical, Civil, Electronics, Mechanical, and Operations.
* **Qualification:** B.E/B.Tech, 3-Year Diploma, or relevant Graduate/PG degree in the specified field.

**2. Junior Maintainer (Pay Level NS3):**
* **Trades:** Electrical, Fitter, RAC, and Electronics.
* **Qualification:** ITI (NCVT/SCVT) certificate in the relevant trade. (**Note:** Higher qualifications are not accepted for ITI posts).

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Online Application Starts:** 10.09.2026
* **Last Date to Apply:** 09.10.2026 (23:55 hrs)
* **Tentative CBT Date:** November/December 2026

### 💰 Salary & Benefits
* **Supervisor-I:** Initial Basic Pay ₹37,000 (Scale: ₹37,000 – ₹1,15,000)
* **Junior Maintainer:** Initial Basic Pay ₹18,250 (Scale: ₹18,250 – ₹59,200)
* **Additional Perks:** VDA, HRA, and Cafeteria allowances as per company rules.

### 📝 Selection Process
1. **Computer Based Test (CBT):** 100 questions, 100 marks, 90 minutes. No negative marking.
2. **Medical Fitness Test:** Standards as per Indian Railway Medical Manual (IRMM).

### 🕒 Age Limit (as of 10.09.2026)
* **Maximum Age:** 28 Years
* **Relaxation:** SC/ST (5 years), OBC (3 years), PwBD (10-15 years).
