website_content.title: CBI Special Public Prosecutor Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: CBI invites applications from eligible advocates for engagement as Special Public Prosecutors (SPP) across four key trial court locations. The application deadline is October 8, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## CBI Special Public Prosecutor (SPP) Recruitment 2026

The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI), Policy Division, New Delhi, is inviting applications from experienced advocates for engagement as **Special Public Prosecutors (SPP)**. These prosecutors will be responsible for conducting trials of Lokpal-referred CBI cases.

### 📍 Trial Court Locations
Separate advertisements have been issued for the following locations:
* **Lucknow**
* **Jabalpur**
* **Ghaziabad**
* **Coimbatore**

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
To be eligible for this engagement, candidates must meet the following requirements:
* **Educational Qualification:** LLB degree.
* **Professional Enrollment:** Must possess an Enrollment Certificate as an Advocate with the Bar Council.
* **Standing at Bar:** A minimum of **10 years' standing** as an Advocate.
* **Criminal Experience:** Extensive experience handling criminal matters in Sessions Courts.
* **Mandatory Requirement:** Proven experience in conducting trials of cases under the **Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988**.
* **Location Constraint:** Candidates must be stationed at the place where the concerned Court is situated.

### 📅 Important Dates & Details
* **Application Deadline:** 08 October 2026
* **Engagement Period:** Minimum 3 years
* **Selection Mode:** Shortlisting based on application, followed by an interaction with CBI.
* **Application Mode:** Online only via the prescribed proforma.

### 📄 Required Documents
* Educational Qualification certificates.
* Bar Council Enrollment Certificate.
* Details of important criminal cases handled.
* Specific details of cases under the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988.
* Unconditional willingness/consent to work under Government of India terms.

### 💰 Professional Fee
Fees are governed by **DoPT File No. 225/19/2023-AVD-II dated 08.04.2024**.

website_content.title: PSEB Class 10 & 12 Supplementary Result Rechecking & Revaluation 2026
website_content.summary: The Punjab School Education Board (PSEB) has opened applications for the rechecking and revaluation of Class 10 and 12 supplementary exam results. Students must submit their online applications by September 21, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Punjab School Education Board (PSEB)** has declared the supplementary (compartment) results for 2026. Students who wish to challenge their marks can apply for either rechecking or revaluation of their answer scripts.

## Important Dates
* **Class 12 Supplementary Result:** August 25, 2026
* **Class 10 Supplementary Result:** August 29, 2026
* **Application Deadline (Rechecking/Revaluation):** September 21, 2026

## Understanding the Process
* **Rechecking:** A verification process to ensure all answers were evaluated, totals are correct, and no question was missed. Marks are not re-assessed.
* **Revaluation:** A comprehensive re-examination of the answer script by a different examiner. Marks may increase, decrease, or remain unchanged.

## How to Apply
1. Visit the official PSEB portal.
2. Navigate to the **Results** or **Important Links** section.
3. Select the rechecking/revaluation link for your respective class.
4. Log in using your roll number and credentials.
5. Choose the subject(s) and the type of review requested.
6. Pay the required fee online and submit.

## Key Guidelines
* **Mode:** Only online applications are accepted; offline submissions will not be entertained.
* **Eligibility:** Generally, only theory papers are eligible for revaluation; practical marks are typically excluded.
* **Outcome:** Students should be aware that marks can change in either direction after revaluation.
* **Confirmation:** Always save or print the digital confirmation page after submission.

The **Staff Selection Commission (SSC)** has officially released the City Intimation Slips for the Selection Post Phase-XIV Examination 2026. This slip is designed to help candidates organize their travel logistics ahead of the actual examination.

* **Total Vacancies:** 2,919

* **Shift 1:** Reporting 7:45 AM | Gate Closes 8:30 AM | Exam 9:00 AM – 10:00 AM
* **Shift 2:** Reporting 10:30 AM | Gate Closes 11:15 AM | Exam 11:45 AM – 12:45 PM
* **Shift 3:** Reporting 1:15 PM | Gate Closes 2:00 PM | Exam 2:30 PM – 3:30 PM

* **Not an Admit Card:** The city intimation slip is for informational purposes only and **cannot** be used for entry into the exam centre.
* **Required Documents:** You must carry the printed **Admit Card** and a **valid original photo ID proof** on the exam day.

* **Verification:** Check your name and registration details on the slip; report any errors via official SSC channels immediately.

website_content.title: GSSSB Research Assistant & Statistical Assistant Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: GSSSB invites applications for 41 Class-3 posts of Research and Statistical Assistants under the Directorate of Statistics and Economics. Eligible candidates can apply online via the OJAS portal from 9 September to 23 September 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## 📌 Recruitment Overview

The **Gujarat Subordinate Service Selection Board (GSSSB)** has announced vacancies for Class-3 positions within the Directorate of Statistics and Economics, Gandhinagar.

## 📊 Vacancy Details
* **Research Assistant (Class-3):** 18 Posts
* **Statistical Assistant (Class-3):** 23 Posts
* **Total Vacancies:** 41

## 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** A postgraduate degree, OR a bachelor's degree with **Statistics, Economics, or Mathematics** (or related subjects) as a principal subject from a recognized university.
* **Computer Proficiency:** Basic computer application knowledge as per Gujarat Civil Services rules.
* **Language:** Proficiency in Gujarati or Hindi.
* **Age Limit:** 18 to 37 years (as of 23/09/2026). Age relaxation applies for reserved categories and women.

## 💰 Salary Structure (Fixed Pay for first 5 years)
* **Research Assistant:** ₹49,600/- per month
* **Statistical Assistant:** ₹40,800/- per month

## 📅 Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 09/09/2026 (2:00 PM)
* **Application Last Date:** 23/09/2026 (11:59 PM)
* **Fee Payment Deadline:** 26/09/2026

## 📝 Selection Process
Selection is based on a single-stage **Computer Based Response Test (CBRT)** or OMR exam:
* **Part-A (90 Marks):** Reasoning, Quant, Constitution, Current Affairs & Comprehension.
* **Part-B (120 Marks):** Subject-specific (Statistics, Official Statistics, Maths, Economics).
* **Negative Marking:** 1/4 mark deducted for every wrong answer.
* **Minimum Qualifying:** 40% in both Part-A and Part-B independently.

website_content.markdown_content:
## BEL Senior Engineer Recruitment 2026

**Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL)** has released a notification for the recruitment of **Senior Engineers (E-III)** on a Fixed Term Basis for the Export Manufacturing - SBU at the Bangalore Complex.

### 📌 Vacancy Breakdown
* **Senior Engineer - Computer Science (Database and Software Development):** 05 Posts
* **Senior Engineer - Electronics (Embedded System Development):** 05 Posts
* **Senior Engineer - Computer Science (3D Visual Software Development):** 02 Posts
* **Total Vacancies:** 12

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** Full-Time B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc Engineering (4 Years Course) from AICTE approved institutions/recognized universities.
* **Eligible Disciplines:** Electronics, ECE, Telecommunication, Instrumentation, Electrical & Electronics, Computer Science, IT, and Information Science.
* **Minimum Marks:** 
    * General/OBC/EWS: **60%**
    * SC/ST/PwBD: **50%**
* **Experience:** Minimum **04 years** of post-qualification industrial experience in relevant fields (as of 01 August 2026).
* **Age Limit:** Maximum **35 years** (as of 01 August 2026).

### 💰 Salary & Benefits
* **Pay Scale:** ₹50,000 - 3% - ₹1,60,000
* **Allowances:** Dearness Allowance (DA), HRA, Conveyance, Performance Related Pay, and Medical Reimbursement.
* **Perquisites:** 35% of annual basic pay.

### 🗓️ Important Dates
* **Notification Release:** 09 September 2026
* **Application Start Date:** 09 September 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 29 September 2026

### ⚙️ Selection Process
Selection is based on a weighted score:
* **Written Test:** 85% Weightage
* **Interview:** 15% Weightage

### 📄 Application Fee
* **General / EWS / OBC:** ₹472 (₹400 + 18% GST)
* **SC / ST / PwBD / Ex-Servicemen:** No Fee

website_content.title: Bareilly Anganwadi Sahayika Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: The Office of the District Programme Officer, Bareilly is inviting online applications for 171 honorarium-based Anganwadi Sahayika posts. Eligible female residents of Bareilly can apply by September 29, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The Office of the District Programme Officer, Child Development (Bal Vikas Seva evam Pushtahar), Bareilly has announced direct recruitment for **Anganwadi Sahayika (Helper)** positions. These are honorarium-based roles distributed across 16 Child Development Projects in both urban and rural areas of the Bareilly district.

## Key Vacancy Details
* **Total Posts:** 171
* **Post Name:** Anganwadi Sahayika
* **Gender Requirement:** Female only
* **Application Mode:** Online

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** Minimum **Intermediate (12th)** or equivalent; Maximum Postgraduate.
* **Age Limit:** 18 to 35 years (as of 01.07.2026).
* **Residency:** Must be a permanent resident of the concerned ward or Gram Sabha of the vacant post.

## Selection Process & Priority (Chayan Variyata)
There is **no written exam or interview**. Selection is based on a priority list:
1. Widowed women (BPL resident of the Gram Sabha/Ward).
2. Legally divorced or abandoned women (BPL resident of the Gram Sabha/Ward).
3. Other women from BPL families in the area.
4. Non-BPL widowed/divorced/abandoned women.
5. General women residents of the area.

## Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 08.09.2026
* **Age Cut-off Date:** 01.07.2026
* **Application Deadline:** 29.09.2026

## Required Documents
* High School certificate (for DOB proof)
* Intermediate/Degree certificates
* Digitally signed Residence & Caste certificates (from Tehsil)
* Income/BPL certificate (not older than 3 years)
* Death certificate/Court orders (for widow/divorcees)

website_content.title: EIL Recruitment 2026 for Experienced Engineers and Managers (61 Posts)
website_content.summary: Engineers India Limited (EIL) has released a recruitment notification for 61 vacancies across Engineer, Deputy Manager, Manager, and Senior Manager positions. Qualified engineering professionals can submit online applications between 11 September 2026 and 25 September 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## EIL Experienced Professionals Recruitment 2026 Overview

Engineers India Limited (EIL), a Navratna Public Sector Undertaking under the Government of India, has announced 61 vacancies for experienced personnel across various engineering and technical disciplines under Advertisement No. **HRD/Rectt./Advt./2026-27/08**.

### Important Dates
* **Cut-off Date for Eligibility:** 31 August 2026
* **Online Application Start Date:** 11 September 2026 (00:00 Hrs)
* **Online Application Last Date:** 25 September 2026 (23:59 Hrs)

### Vacancy Summary
* **Engineer Level:** 12 Vacancies (Civil, Mechanical-Piping)
* **Deputy Manager Level:** 37 Vacancies (Civil, Mechanical, Chemical, Environmental, AI/Data Science, IT, Instrumentation, Electrical)
* **Manager Level:** 10 Vacancies (Chemical, Power Plant, AI/IT, Electrical, Metallurgy)
* **Senior Manager Level:** 02 Vacancies (AI/Data Science, Chemical-Process)
* **Total Posts:** **61 Vacancies**

### Eligibility Criteria & Age Limits (as on 31.08.2026)
* **Engineer:** Full-time regular BE/B.Tech/B.Sc (Engg.) with min. 65% marks + min. 1 year post-qualification experience. **Max Age:** 28 Years.
* **Deputy Manager:** Full-time regular BE/B.Tech/B.Sc (Engg.) or MCA with min. 65% marks + min. 4 years post-qualification experience. **Max Age:** 32 Years.
* **Manager:** Full-time regular BE/B.Tech/B.Sc (Engg.) or MCA with min. 65% marks + min. 8 years relevant experience. **Max Age:** 36 Years.
* **Senior Manager:** Relevant degree with min. 65% marks + senior-level relevant experience.

### Selection Process
* Shortlisting of applications based on qualification and experience criteria.
* **Personal Interview** (in-person at New Delhi/Gurugram or via Video Conferencing). No written test is scheduled.

### Key Instructions
* A candidate can apply for **one position only** under this recruitment advertisement.
* In case of multiple submissions, only the latest application will be considered.

Shortlisting will be based on the candidate's eligibility, educational qualifications, and professional experience as prescribed in the official notification.

website_content.title: AWEIL GSF Kashipur Technical Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: AWTM Ichapur is inviting offline applications for 40 contractual Technical posts at GSF Kashipur. Eligible ITI holders must apply by October 7, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Academy of Weapon Technology & Management (AWTM), Ichapur, a unit of **Advanced Weapons and Equipment India Limited (AWEIL)** under the Ministry of Defence, is hiring for **40 tenure-based Technical posts** on a contractual basis for placement at **Gun & Shell Factory (GSF), Kashipur**.

## Vacancy Details
Total vacancies available: **40** across following trades:
* **Mechanical Fitter:** 14
* **Turner:** 07
* **Machinist:** 06
* **Electroplater:** 06
* **Electrical Fitter:** 04
* **Heat Treatment Operator:** 03

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** Candidates must possess Matriculation (10th) plus a National Trade Certificate (NTC) or National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) in the relevant trade issued by **NCVT**.
* **Age Limit:** 18 to 35 years (as of the application deadline). 
    * SC/ST: +5 years
    * OBC: +3 years
    * PwD: +10 years

## Selection Process
Selection is based purely on merit through the following stages:
1. **Shortlisting:** Based on marks obtained in the NCVT trade examination.
2. **Trade Test:** Practical test conducted by AWTM Ichapur.
3. **Final Merit:** Weighted score of **80% (NCVT marks)** and **20% (Trade Test marks)**.
4. **Verification:** Document verification and medical fitness test.

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 07 September 2026
* **Last Date to Apply:** 07 October 2026

## Application Fee
* **General/OBC/EWS:** ₹100 (Payable via Demand Draft in favor of "Ordnance Factories Institute of Learning, Ishapore")
* **SC/ST/PwD/ESM:** Exempted

## How to Apply
1. Download the application form from the official website.
2. Fill the form in **Block Letters**.
3. Attach self-certified copies of certificates and two self-attested photographs.
4. Send the application via post to: *The Chief General Manager, Academy of Weapon Technology & Management, Ichapur, P.O.- Ichapur, Nawabganj, Dist. – 24 Parganas(N), PIN – 743144*.
5. Ensure the envelope is superscribed: **"APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF [Trade Name] ON CONTRACT BASIS"**.

website_content.summary: UKSSSC has announced 101 Group 'C' vacancies for Personal Assistants and Stenographers across various Uttarakhand government departments. Eligible candidates must apply online by October 14, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The Uttarakhand Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UKSSSC) is conducting direct recruitment for **Group 'C' posts** including Personal Assistants and Stenographers across multiple state departments such as the Commercial Tax Tribunal, Rural Development, and Housing Department.

## Vacancy Breakdown
* **Personal Assistant:** 94 Posts
* **Stenographer (Grade 2 & 3):** 7 Posts
* **Total Vacancies:** 101

## Eligibility Criteria
### Educational Qualification
* **Personal Assistant:** Intermediate (12th) from a recognized board. Specific posts may require additional diplomas in shorthand/typing.
* **Stenographer Grade-3:** Graduate from a UGC-recognized university.
* **Stenographer Grade-2:** Intermediate with proficiency in English and Hindi stenography.

### Skill Requirements
* **Shorthand:** Speed varies by post (generally 60-100 wpm in Hindi/English).
* **Typing:** Proficiency in Hindi/English typing (measured in key depressions per hour or wpm).

## Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 8 September 2026
* **Online Application Starts:** 14 September 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 14 October 2026
* **Correction Window:** 17 October to 19 October 2026
* **Tentative Exam Date:** 20 December 2026

## Age Limit (as of 01 July 2026)
* **General Age:** 18 to 42 years
* **Specific Posts:** 21 to 42 years (Judicial & Legal Academy / Power Transmission Corp)
* **Relaxation:** SC/ST/OBC candidates of Uttarakhand get 5 years relaxation; PwD candidates get 10 years.

## Domicile Requirements
Candidates must either be registered with an **Uttarakhand Sewayojan Office**, hold a domicile certificate, or have completed 10th and 12th from Uttarakhand institutions.

website_content.title: OPSC Assistant Professor (Electrical Engineering) Provisional Answer Key 2026
website_content.summary: OPSC has released the provisional answer keys for the Assistant Professor written exam in Government Engineering Colleges (Electrical Engineering). Candidates must submit any objections via the eChayan portal by September 17, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## OPSC Assistant Professor Answer Key 2026

The Odisha Public Service Commission (OPSC) has officially released the provisional answer keys for the written examination conducted on **29.08.2026** for the post of **Assistant Professor in Government Engineering Colleges (Electrical Engineering discipline)** under Advertisement No. 35 of 2023-24.

### Key Examination Details
* **Organization:** OPSC
* **Post:** Assistant Professor (Electrical Engineering)
* **Exam Date:** 29.08.2026
* **Answer Key Sets:** A, B, C, and D

### Important Dates
* **Answer Key Release Date:** 07.09.2026
* **Last Date to Raise Objections:** 17.09.2026

### Guidelines for Raising Objections
OPSC has mandated a strict process for challenging the provisional answers. Failure to follow these steps will result in the objection being rejected:

* **Online Submission:** Objections must be submitted exclusively through the **opscechayan.in** portal.
* **Set 'A' Reference:** Regardless of the question paper set you received during the exam, all objections **MUST be referenced against Set 'A'** only.
* **Justification:** Every challenge must be accompanied by sufficient evidence or justification for why the provisional answer is incorrect.
* **Deadline:** The portal will close on **17.09.2026**. No submissions will be accepted after this date.
* **No Other Mode:** Objections sent via email, post, or other means will not be entertained.

### Final Selection Process
* Questions that receive no objections will be treated as final.
* For challenged questions, a **Committee of Experts** will review the submissions to decide the Final Answer Key.

website_content.title: Punjab B.Ed Counselling 2026: Vacant Seat List & Phase 2 Schedule
website_content.summary: Panjab University has announced the vacant seat list and upgrade window for Punjab B.Ed Counselling 2026. Candidates can now participate in the upgrade process and Phase 2 choice filling.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
Panjab University is conducting the B.Ed Counselling 2026 for candidates who have qualified the **Punjab B.Ed Common Entrance Test (CET)**. The process is entirely online, spanning registration, choice filling, and seat allotment.

## Key Highlights
* **Upgrade Window:** Candidates can opt for seat upgrades from September 8 to 9, 2026.
* **Phase 2 Opportunity:** Candidates who missed submitting qualifying marks can do so between September 14 and 19, 2026.
* **Mode:** 100% Online process.

## Important Dates
| Event | Date |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Upgrade Option Window** | Sept 8 - 9, 2026 |
| **Upgraded Seat Allotment** | Sept 11, 2026 |
| **Phase 2: Updating Marks & Choice Locking** | Sept 14 - 19, 2026 |
| **Phase 2: Seat Allotment** | Sept 22, 2026 |
| **Phase 2: Reporting at Colleges** | Sept 22 - 24, 2026 |

## Counselling Process
1. **Registration:** Online registration and fee payment on the official portal.
2. **Choice Filling:** Selecting and locking preferred colleges/programs in order of preference.
3. **Seat Allotment:** Allocation based on CET ranks.
4. **Verification:** Reporting to the allotted college for document verification and final admission.

## Critical Instructions
* Ensure **qualifying degree marks** are updated during the Phase 2 window (Sept 14-19) to avoid disqualification.
* Strictly adhere to the **reporting windows** at allocated colleges to secure the seat.
* Double-check all academic details during registration.

website_content.title: Krishnagiri DHS Recruitment 2026 - 69 Contractual Vacancies
website_content.summary: The District Health Society, Krishnagiri, invites offline applications for 69 contractual posts across 25 different healthcare and support roles. The deadline for submission is 22 September 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The District Health Society, Krishnagiri (Tamil Nadu), under the National Health Mission, is recruiting for various contractual positions to be deployed across Government Medical Colleges, Hospitals, and Primary Health Centres in the district.

## Key Vacancies & Honorarium
| Post Name | Vacancies | Monthly Salary |
| :--- | :---: | :---: |
| **Medical Officer** | 1 | ₹60,000 |
| **Microbiologist** | 1 | ₹44,000 |
| **Dentist** | 1 | ₹40,000 |
| **Consultant (Yoga & Naturopathy)** | 1 | ₹40,000 |
| **Audiologist** | 1 | ₹32,000 |
| **Lab Technician Gr-2** | 19 | ₹18,000 |
| **Health Inspector Gr-II** | 19 | ₹17,500 |
| **Others (Support Staff/Driver/Cleaner)** | Multiple | ₹11,000 - ₹23,000 |

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Medical Officer:** MBBS registered with TNMC.
* **Microbiologist:** M.Sc Microbiology.
* **Lab Technician Gr-2:** BMLT (BMLS) or DMLT.
* **Health Inspector Gr-II:** 12th (Bio/Botany/Zoology) + Health Inspector training certificate.
* **Support Staff (Cleaner/Lab Asst):** 8th pass with ability to read/write Tamil.
* **Driver:** 10th pass/fail with Heavy Driving License.

## Important Dates
* **Last Date to Apply:** 22 September 2026 (by 5:00 PM)

## Application Process
**Note: This is an OFFLINE application process.**
1. Download the application form from **krishnagiri.nic.in**.
2. Attach self-attested copies of: 10th/12th marks, Degree/Diploma certificates, Community certificate, and Experience certificates.
3. Submit the application **in person** or via **Speed Post** to the District Health Society, Krishnagiri office.

## Important Highlights
* Positions are **purely temporary/contractual**.
* The Dentist post will be filled on a rotation basis.
* Applications without required certificates will be rejected.

website_content.title: Prasar Bharati Marketing Executive Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: Prasar Bharati is inviting applications for 20 Marketing Executive positions in its Sales Division across various India locations on a full-time contractual basis.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
Prasar Bharati, India's Public Service Broadcaster, is hiring **Marketing Executives** for its Sales Division. These positions are full-time contractual roles for an initial period of **two years**, extendable based on performance and organizational needs.

## Vacancy Details
* **Total Vacancies:** 20
* **Locations:** Various Akashvani/Doordarshan stations including Mumbai, Bengaluru, Kolkata, Vijayawada, Raipur, Rajkot, Ranchi, Kochi, Leh, Nagpur, Jalandhar, Lucknow, Varanasi, Dehradun, Panaji, and Tiruchirapalli.

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** MBA, MBA (Marketing), or PG Diploma in Management/Marketing from a recognized University/Institute.
* **Experience:** Minimum **one year of direct sales experience**. Candidates with experience in **Media Sales** will be given preference.
* **Age Limit:** Below **35 years** as of 07 September 2026.
* **Key Skills:** Fluency in English (local language is an advantage), strong communication skills, and a result-oriented approach to revenue targets.

## Salary Structure
* **Metro Cities:** Rs. 35,000 to Rs. 50,000 per month.
* **Other Locations:** Rs. 35,000 to Rs. 42,000 per month.

## Selection Process
* Shortlisted candidates will be contacted via email for a **test and/or interview**.
* No TA/DA will be provided for attending the selection process.

## Important Instructions
* This is a **purely contractual engagement** with no claim to regularization.
* Applications must be submitted online within 15 days of the newspaper publication date.

The Gauhati High Court, Kohima Bench has officially released the admit card for the Stage-I OMR-based Written Examination for the post of **Judicial Assistant**. ## MPPSC Scientific Officer (Chemistry) Result 2026 Overview

The Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission (MPPSC), Indore, has officially declared the result for the post of **Scientific Officer Chemistry** under the Home Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh (Advt No. 35/2023). The result has been issued in two separate documents: the **Selection List** and the **Obtained Marks List**.

* **Total Advertised Posts:** 17

website_content.markdown_content:
## RPSC Statistical Officer Answer Key 2026

The Rajasthan Public Service Commission (RPSC) has officially published the provisional answer key for the **Statistical Officer** recruitment (113 vacancies). Candidates who appeared for the examination on August 30, 2026, are advised to download the key and compare it with their recorded responses.

* **Exam Date:** 30 August 2026
* **Answer Key Release Date:** 7 September 2026
* **Objection Window:** 8 September 2026 to 10 September 2026 (till midnight)

### 🛠️ How to Raise an Objection
If you find a discrepancy in the provisional answer key, follow these steps:
1. Log in to the **SSO Rajasthan Portal** (sso.rajasthan.gov.in).
2. Navigate to the **Recruitment Portal** app.
3. Select the **Question Objection** link for the Statistical Officer Exam 2026.
4. Upload supporting evidence from authentic standard textbooks in **PDF format**.
5. Pay the non-refundable objection fee of **₹100 per question**.

### 📋 Documents Required for Download
* Roll Number or Application/Registration Number
* Date of Birth
* SSO ID and Password (required for objections)

### ⚠️ Key Instructions
* The current key is **provisional** and subject to change based on valid objections.
* Objections must be matched against the **Master Question Paper** only.
* Late submissions will not be entertained.

## Overview
The **Madras University (UNOM)** has officially published the results for the **Instant Examination (July-2026 session)**. This result is applicable to all eligible students across various undergraduate, postgraduate, and professional degree programs.

* **Conducting Body:** Madras University (UNOM)
* **Examination Cycle:** July-2026
* **Result Publication Date:** 07-09-2026
* **Required Credentials:** Register Number

## Step-by-Step Guide to Check Results
1. Visit the official e-governance portal of Madras University.
2. Locate the **"Register Number"** input field.
3. Enter your register number exactly as it appears on your hall ticket.

* **For Discrepancies:** If you notice any errors, contact the University examination section or your college cell directly.

## Important Notes
* Use only official university portals to avoid phishing or data theft.
* Digital copies should be maintained until the official hard-copy marksheet is provided.

website_content.title: RRB NTPC UG CBT 2 City Intimation Slip 2026
website_content.summary: The Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has released the City Intimation Slips for the NTPC Undergraduate CBT 2 exam. Qualified candidates can now check their allotted exam city and date on the official portal.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has released the city intimation slips for candidates who qualified for the **CBT 2 exam** under CEN 07/2025 (RRB NTPC Undergraduate recruitment). A total of **45,898 candidates** are eligible to check their exam details.

## Important Dates
* **City Intimation Slip Released:** 7th September 2026
* **Admit Card Release Date:** 13th September 2026
* **CBT 2 Exam Date:** 17th September 2026

## Key Examination Details
* **Total Vacancies:** 3,058 Undergraduate posts
* **Login Credentials:** Registration Number and Date of Birth (DDMMYYYY)
* **Requirement for Entry:** Note that the City Slip is for information only; the **official Admit Card** is mandatory for entry into the exam center.

## Steps to Download City Intimation Slip
1. Visit the official RRB website or your regional RRB portal.
2. Click on the link **'RRB NTPC UG CBT 2 City Intimation Slip 2026'**.
3. Enter your **Registration Number** as the User ID.
4. Enter your **Date of Birth** (DDMMYYYY) as the password.
5. Solve the captcha and click **Submit** to view your allotted city and date.

## Essential Instructions
* Ensure you carry a **valid photo ID** along with the admit card on the exam day.
* Monitor your registered email and SMS for any official communication.
* If you face login issues, wait for the official SMS/Email confirmation before retrying.

website_content.markdown_content:
## BFUHS PPMET 2026 B.Sc Nursing Round 2 Allotment

**Baba Farid University of Health Sciences (BFUHS)** is set to announce the provisional seat allotment result for B.Sc Nursing admissions under the Punjab Para Medical Entrance Test (PPMET) 2026.

### 📅 Important Schedule
* **Provisional Seat Allotment Result:** September 8, 2026 (Expected)
* **Revised/Final Allotment Result:** September 10, 2026
* **College Reporting Window:** September 11 to September 18, 2026 (Until 2:00 PM)

### 🛠️ Step-by-Step Process to Check Result
1. Visit the official BFUHS portal.
2. Locate the **"PPMET 2026 B.Sc Nursing Round 2 Seat Allotment Result"** link on the homepage.
3. Log in using your unique application number and password.
4. View and download the provisional allotment status.
5. Once the final result is declared on Sept 10, download and print the official **allotment letter**.

### 📋 Mandatory Reporting Requirements
Candidates must physically report to their allotted college between **September 11 and September 18** with the following:
* **Official Allotment Letter:** Downloaded from the dashboard.
* **Documents:** Original academic and category certificates for verification.
* **Medical Examination:** Must undergo the required medical check-up.
* **Fees:** Payment of six months' tuition fees via online bank payment or demand draft.

### ⚠️ Critical Warnings
* **Seat Cancellation:** Failure to report in person or pay the fee by the deadline will result in immediate cancellation of the seat.
* **Round 3 Shift:** All cancelled seats from Round 2 will be transferred to Round 3 counselling.
* **Objections:** Any objections to the provisional allotment must be submitted with supporting proof (Scorecard, Category certificate, etc.).

website_content.title: SSC CHSL Recruitment 2026: Apply Online for LDC, JSA, and DEO Posts
website_content.summary: The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has announced 2,536 tentative vacancies for LDC/JSA and DEO positions. Eligible 12th-pass candidates can apply online between September 7 and October 7, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## SSC CHSL Recruitment 2026 Overview

The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) is inviting online applications for the Combined Higher Secondary Level (CHSL) Examination 2026. This is a premier opportunity for candidates to secure a position in various Ministries, Departments, and Offices of the Government of India.

**Key Highlights:**
* **Posts:** Lower Division Clerk (LDC), Junior Secretariat Assistant (JSA), and Data Entry Operator (DEO).
* **Total Vacancies:** Approximately **2,536** (Tentative).
* **Job Location:** Across India.

## Eligibility Criteria

### Educational Qualification
* **DEO/DEO Grade 'A' (Specific Ministries):** 12th Standard pass in Science stream with Mathematics.
* **LDC/JSA & Other DEO Posts:** 12th Standard pass or equivalent from a recognized board.
* *Note: Candidates awaiting results can apply if the result is declared by 07 October 2026.*

### Age Limit (as of 01 August 2026)
* **Minimum Age:** 18 Years
* **Maximum Age:** 27 Years
* **Relaxation:** SC/ST (5 yrs), OBC (3 yrs), PwBD (10-15 yrs) as per Govt norms.

## Salary Structure (7th CPC)

| Post | Pay Level | Pay Scale |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| LDC/JSA | Level-2 | Rs. 19,900 – 63,200 |
| DEO | Level-4/5 | Rs. 25,500 – 92,300 |
| DEO Grade 'A' | Level-4 | Rs. 25,500 – 81,100 |

## Important Dates

* **Application Start Date:** 07 September 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 07 October 2026 (23:00 Hours)
* **Fee Payment Deadline:** 08 October 2026
* **Correction Window:** 14 October to 16 October 2026

## Selection Process

Selection is based on a two-tier Computer Based Examination (CBE):
1. **Tier-I:** Objective MCQs (English, Gen Intelligence, Quantitative Aptitude, General Awareness).
2. **Tier-II:** Includes Mathematical Abilities, Reasoning, English, General Awareness, Computer Knowledge Test, and a Skill/Typing Test.

website_content.title: SSC CHSL Recruitment 2026: Apply Online for 2,536 Vacancies, Exam Pattern & Syllabus
website_content.summary: The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has announced 2,536 vacancies for LDC, JSA, and DEO posts under the Combined Higher Secondary Level (CHSL) Examination 2026. Eligible 12th-pass candidates can submit their online applications on the official portal by 7 October 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## SSC CHSL Recruitment 2026 Overview

The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has officially released the notification for the Combined Higher Secondary (10+2) Level Examination 2026. This recruitment drive aims to fill approximately **2,536 vacancies** for Lower Division Clerk (LDC), Junior Secretariat Assistant (JSA), and Data Entry Operator (DEO) positions across various central government ministries and departments.

## Important Dates

* **Notification Release Date:** 7 September 2026
* **Online Application Start Date:** 7 September 2026
* **Last Date to Apply Online:** 7 October 2026 (11:00 PM)
* **Tier 1 Exam Date:** To be announced

## Post & Vacancy Details

* **Total Vacancies:** Approx. 2,536 Posts (Tentative)
* **Designations:**
  * Lower Division Clerk (LDC) / Junior Secretariat Assistant (JSA)
  * Data Entry Operator (DEO)
  * Data Entry Operator Grade 'A'

## Eligibility Criteria

* **Educational Qualification:** Candidates must have passed the 12th Standard (10+2) or equivalent examination from a recognized Board or University.
* **Age Limit & Category-wise Relaxation:** As per standard SSC rules and Government of India guidelines.

## Selection Process

The selection procedure consists of three stages:

1. **Tier 1 Examination (CBT):** Objective multiple-choice screening test (100 questions / 200 marks). Tier 1 scores are qualifying for shortlisting candidates to Tier 2.
2. **Tier 2 Examination (CBT + Skill/Typing Test):** 
   * **Session 1:** Section-1 (Maths & Reasoning), Section-2 (English & General Awareness), Section-3 Module-1 (Computer Knowledge Module - Qualifying).
   * **Session 2:** Section-3 Module-2 (Skill Test for DEO / Typing Test for LDC & JSA - Qualifying).
   * *Final merit is calculated based strictly on performance in Section-1 and Section-2 of Tier 2.*
3. **Document Verification (DV):** Verification of original certificates for provisionally shortlisted candidates.

## Exam Pattern

### Tier 1 Exam Pattern
* **General Intelligence:** 25 Questions (50 Marks)
* **General Awareness:** 25 Questions (50 Marks)
* **Quantitative Aptitude:** 25 Questions (50 Marks)
* **English Language:** 25 Questions (50 Marks)
* **Total:** 100 Questions | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes (80 minutes for eligible PwBD candidates)
* **Negative Marking:** 0.50 marks per wrong answer

### Tier 2 Exam Pattern
* **Section 1 (60 Qs, 180 Marks):** Mathematical Abilities (30 Qs) + Reasoning & General Intelligence (30 Qs) — Duration: 1 Hour
* **Section 2 (60 Qs, 180 Marks):** English Language & Comprehension (40 Qs) + General Awareness (20 Qs) — Duration: 1 Hour
* **Section 3 Module 1 (15 Qs, 45 Marks):** Computer Knowledge Module — Duration: 15 Minutes (Qualifying)
* **Section 3 Module 2:** Skill Test / Typing Test (Qualifying)
* **Negative Marking:** 1 mark per incorrect answer in Section 1, Section 2, and Module 1 of Section 3.

## Minimum Qualifying Marks

* **UR:** 30%
* **OBC / EWS:** 25%
* **SC / ST / PwBD / ESM:** 20%

## How to Apply

* Visit the official SSC portal at ssc.gov.in.
* Complete the One-Time Registration (OTR) if you are a new user.
* Log in, fill out the SSC CHSL 2026 application form, and upload required documents.
* Pay the application fee (if applicable) and submit the form before 7 October 2026.

website_content.title: APPSC Combined Competitive Examination (APPSCCE) Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: APPSC invites online applications for 135 vacancies across 13 Group-A and Group-B services for eligible residents of Arunachal Pradesh. The application window closes on October 20, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The Arunachal Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC) has announced the **Combined Competitive Examination-2026 (APPSCCE-2026)** for recruitment to 135 vacancies across various Group-A and Group-B services in the Government of Arunachal Pradesh.

## Vacancy Details
A total of **135 posts** are available across 13 services, including:
* **APCS (Entry Grade):** 60 Posts
* **Assistant Section Officer:** 38 Posts
* **APPS (Entry Grade):** 10 Posts
* **Other Posts:** CDPO, DIPRO, DF&CSO, DTO, Labour Officer, and more.

## Eligibility Criteria (Mandatory)
This is a **restricted recruitment**. Candidates must meet ALL three conditions:
1. **Permanent Residence:** Must hold a valid Permanent Residence Certificate (PRC) of Arunachal Pradesh.
2. **Indigenous Status:** Must hold an Arunachal Pradesh Scheduled Tribe (**APST**) Certificate.
3. **Language Proficiency:** Must be able to speak an indigenous tribal language of the state.

## Qualification & Age Limit
* **Education:** Graduate Degree from a UGC-recognized university (Candidates appearing in final exams may apply provisionally).
* **Age Limit:** 21 to 35 years as of 20th October 2026.
* **Relaxation:** APST (5 years), PwBD (15 years), Defence Personnel (8 years).

## Selection Process
1. **Preliminary Examination:** 
   - Paper I (General Studies) & Paper II (CSAT - Qualifying).
   - Negative marking: 1/3rd mark.
2. **Main Examination:** 
   - 8 subjective written papers including a qualifying English paper.
3. **Interview/Viva-Voce:** 
   - Final stage for shortlisted candidates.

## Important Dates
* **Application Start:** 16 September 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 20 October 2026 (1700 Hrs)
* **Preliminary Exam:** 06 December 2026

## Application Fee
* **General/Others:** ₹200
* **PwD Candidates:** Exempted

website_content.title: Odisha NEET UG Counselling 2026 Round 2 Registration
website_content.summary: The OJEE Committee has opened Round 2 registration for MBBS and BDS admissions under the 85% state quota. New candidates must register by September 8, 2026, to participate in the allotment process.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Odisha NEET UG Counselling 2026 - Round 2

The **OJEE (Odisha Joint Entrance Examination) Committee**, under the Directorate of Medical Education and Training, is now accepting registrations for Round 2 of state-quota counselling for **MBBS and BDS** admissions.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Fresh Registration (New Candidates):** September 7 to September 8, 2026 (until 11:59 PM)
* **Provisional/Final Merit List:** September 9, 2026
* **Choice Filling & Locking:** September 9 to September 10, 2026
* **Seat Allotment Result:** September 11, 2026

### 🎓 Eligibility & Basis
* **Basis:** Allotment is based on the **NEET UG 2026 score/rank**.
* **Quota:** Admissions are for the 85% state quota, including participating private medical colleges.

### 📝 Step-by-Step Application Process
1. **Login:** Access the official portal using your NEET UG 2026 roll number and credentials.
2. **Registration:** Complete the Round 2 form (for new registrants) by Sept 8.
3. **Verification:** Upload required documents for online verification.
4. **Payment:** Pay the counselling fee via the online gateway.
5. **Choice Filling:** Between Sept 9-10, select and arrange your preferred colleges in order of priority.
6. **Locking:** Ensure you lock your choices before the window closes on Sept 10.

### ⚠️ Key Instructions
* **Round 1 Candidates:** If you were not allotted a seat in Round 1, you **do not** need to register again; proceed directly to choice filling.
* **Upgradation:** Candidates upgrading in Round 2 retain their Round 1 seat unless a higher-preference seat is allotted.
* **Deadlines:** The registration window is very short (2 days)—ensure submission well before the cutoff.

website_content.title: NBEMS NEET PG 2026 Provisional Answer Key and Response Sheet
website_content.summary: NBEMS is set to release the provisional answer key and candidate response sheets for NEET PG 2026 on September 10, 2026. This initiative follows a Supreme Court order to ensure greater transparency in the examination process.
website_content.markdown_content:
## NEET PG 2026 Answer Key Overview

The **National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS)** will release the provisional answer key for the NEET PG 2026 exam. For the first time, candidates will have access to both the provisional answer key and their individual response sheets to estimate their probable scores.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Exam Date:** August 30, 2026
* **Re-exam (Jaipur Centres):** September 5, 2026
* **Answer Key Release (Expected):** September 10, 2026

### 🛠️ How to Download
1. Visit the official portal at **nbe.edu.in** or **natboard.edu.in**.
2. Navigate to the **NEET PG 2026** section.
3. Log in using your **Registration/Roll Number** and password/date of birth.
4. Click on the link for the **Provisional Answer Key and Response Sheet**.
5. Save the document as a PDF for your records.

### 🚩 Raising Objections
Candidates who find discrepancies in the provisional key can challenge the answers during a limited window. 
* Log in to the applicant portal.
* Go to the **Objection Section**.
* Upload supporting evidence and pay the required fee per question (if applicable).

### ⚠️ Key Instructions
* **Avoid third-party links:** Use only official NBEMS websites.
* **Unofficial Keys:** Use memory-based keys for rough estimates only; rely on the official key for final scoring.
* **Confidentiality:** Full question papers are not released; only Question IDs and response sheets are provided.

website_content.markdown_content:
## APSSB Uniformed Services Final Result 2026

The **Arunachal Pradesh Staff Selection Board (APSSB)** has officially declared the Revised Final Result for the Special Recruitment Drive for Uniformed Services Combined Examination 2026. This result includes appointment recommendations and post allotments for various uniformed roles.

### 📌 Posts Included in Final Result
* **Special Tiger Guard** (STPF)
* **Fireman**
* **Constable IRBn** (Post Code 7/26)
* **Constable Civil Police - Male** (Post Code 9/26)
* **Constable Civil Police - Female** (Post Code 8/26)
* **Constable Band, IRBn** (Post Code 5/26)
* **Constable Bugler, IRBn** (Post Code 6/26)

### 📅 Key Dates
* **Advertisement Published:** 13.03.2026
* **Provisional Result:** 20.06.2026
* **Document Verification:** 29.06.2026 to 03.07.2026
* **PST, PET & Trade Test:** 13.07.2026 to 26.07.2026
* **Medical Fitness Test:** Starting 10.08.2026
* **Revised Final Result Date:** 05.09.2026

### ⚠️ Important Notes
* **Result Revision:** The result was revised to address a grievance regarding One Time Age Relaxation (OTR) for a specific candidate, leading to changes in some post preferences and waitlists.
* **Unfilled Vacancies:** Certain vacancies in Constable Band, Constable Bugler, and Constable Civil Police (Female) remain unfilled due to lack of eligible candidates or preference issues.
* **Ex-Servicemen (ExSM):** Several ExSM reserved posts remain vacant as no eligible candidates were available.
* **Verification:** All selections are provisional. The final appointment is subject to character, antecedents, and document verification by the Appointing Authority.

### 🔍 How to Check Your Result
1. Visit the official APSSB website.
2. Navigate to the **'Notice'** section.
3. Select the notice titled **'Final Result Notice (Special Recruitment Drive for Uniformed Services Combined Examination 2026)'**.
4. Download the PDF and search for your **Roll Number** to find your allotted post and category.

website_content.markdown_content:
## Gujarat TAT-S Mains Hall Ticket 2026

The **State Examination Board (SEB), Gandhinagar** is set to release the hall tickets for the Teacher Aptitude Test Secondary (TAT-S) Mains examination. This is the final stage for candidates aspiring to become Secondary School Teachers for Classes 9 and 10.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Prelims Exam Date:** May 3, 2026
* **Prelims Result Declared:** July 4, 2026
* **Mains Hall Ticket Release:** September 14, 2026
* **Mains Exam Date:** September 20, 2026

### 🛠️ How to Download the Hall Ticket
1. Visit the official website: **sebexam.org**

website_content.title: BPSSC Company Commander (Gulma Samadesta) Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: BPSSC invites applications for 65 posts of Company Commander exclusively for serving Bihar Home Guards. The application window closes on October 10, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The Bihar Police Subordinate Services Commission (BPSSC) has announced recruitment for the post of **Gulma Samadesta (Company Commander)** in the Bihar Home Guard Vahini Seva Sanvarg. This is a promotion-based recruitment specifically for eligible serving personnel.

## Key Highlights
* **Total Vacancies:** 65
* **Post Name:** Company Commander (Gulma Samadesta)
* **Pay Scale:** Pay Level-6
* **Application Mode:** Online Only

## Important Dates
* **Notification Release:** 07-09-2026
* **Online Application Starts:** 10-09-2026
* **Application Deadline:** 10-10-2026
* **Cut-off Date (Eligibility):** 01-08-2026

## Eligibility Criteria
**This recruitment is NOT open to the general public.**
* **Service Requirement:** Must be an enrolled and trained member of the Bihar Home Guard Vahini.
* **Experience:** Minimum 5 years of service/duty completed.
* **Service Tenure:** Minimum 10 years of remaining service as of the cut-off date.
* **Education:** Graduate degree from a recognized university.
* **Age Limit:** 24 to 50 years (as of 01-08-2026).

## Physical Standards
* **Height (Men):** 165 cm (Gen/BC), 160 cm (EBC/SC/ST)
* **Height (Women):** 155 cm (All Categories)
* **Chest (Men):** 81-86 cm (Gen/BC/EBC), 79-84 cm (SC/ST)
* **Weight (Women):** Minimum 48 kg

## Selection Process
1. **Preliminary Examination:** MCQ-based test on General Knowledge and Current Affairs.
2. **Main Examination:** Two papers (General Hindi and General Studies/Science/Math).
3. **Physical Efficiency Test (PET):** Qualifying test including Race, High Jump, Long Jump, and Shot Put.

## Application Fee
* **All Categories:** ₹100 (Online payment only)

website_content.summary: The Jammu and Kashmir Services Selection Board (JKSSB) has officially released the admit cards for the OMR-based written examination for BCG Technician and Paramedical Assistant posts. Candidates can download their hall tickets from the official portal starting September 7, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## JKSSB Admit Card 2026 Overview

The Jammu and Kashmir Services Selection Board (JKSSB) has issued an official notice regarding the release of admit cards for the **BCG Technician** and **Paramedical Assistant** recruitment under the Health and Medical Education Department (Notification No. 07 of 2025, Item Nos. 30-34 & 122-130).

## Important Examination Details

* **Exam Date:** September 10, 2026 (Shift I & Shift II)
* **Exam Mode:** OMR Based Written Examination
* **Admit Card Download Start Date:** September 07, 2026
* **Department:** Health and Medical Education Department, J&K

## Step-by-Step Instructions to Download Admit Card

* Visit the official portal of JKSSB.
* Locate and click on the **Download E-Admit Card** link on the homepage.
* Sign in using your registered **Username** and **Password**.
* Download the E-Admit Card and take a clear printout for the exam day.

## Essential Guidelines for Candidates

* **Reporting Time:** Report to your designated exam centre at least **2 hours prior** to exam commencement for Biometric and Facial Authentication.
* **Issues in Downloading:** Candidates unable to download hall tickets must visit the JKSSB Board office at least 2 days prior to the exam with proof of application submission and fee payment.
* **Photo Mismatch:** Any mismatch in the photograph must be reported immediately to the JKSSB Central Office in Jammu or Srinagar prior to the exam day.
* **Post-Exam Protocol:** Duly signed admit cards must be submitted back to the invigilator after completing the examination.

website_content.title: GSRTC Helper Recruitment 2026 - 2510 Vacancies
website_content.summary: Gujarat State Road Transport Corporation (GSRTC) is inviting online applications for 2510 Helper posts on a contract basis. Eligible ITI holders must apply through the OJAS Gujarat portal by October 6, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## 🚌 GSRTC Helper Recruitment 2026-27

Gujarat State Road Transport Corporation (GSRTC) has announced a massive recruitment drive for the post of **Helper**. This is a contract-based fixed pay appointment for a period of five years.

### 📌 Key Highlights
* **Total Vacancies:** 2510
* **Post Name:** Helper
* **Salary:** ₹21,100/- per month (Fixed Pay)
* **Employment Type:** Contract (5 Years)

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** Must have passed at least a one-year course from a Government-recognised **ITI** in any of the following trades:
    * Mechanic Motor Vehicle, Diesel, General Mechanic, Fitter, Turner, Electrician, Sheet Metal Worker, Automobile Body Repairer, Welder, Welder cum Fabricator, Machinist, Carpenter, Painter General, or Automobile Paint Repairer.
* **Additional Weightage:** Candidates with an NCVT certificate and apprenticeship in the same trade will receive additional marks.
* **Age Limit:** 18 to 35 years (Age relaxations apply for Female, Reserved, PwD, and Ex-Serviceman candidates).

### 📝 Selection Process & Exam Pattern
Selection is based on a **100-mark MCQ examination** and apprenticeship certification.

**Weightage Breakdown:**
* MCQ Exam: 90 Marks
* Apprenticeship Certificate: 10 Marks

**Exam Syllabus (100 Marks | 2 Hours):**
* Trade-related subjects: 50 Marks
* GK / Gujarat History / Geography / Current Affairs: 30 Marks
* Basic Computer Knowledge: 10 Marks
* Gujarati Grammar: 5 Marks
* English Grammar: 5 Marks

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 7th September 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 6th October 2026
* **Fee Payment Deadline:** 8th October 2026

### 💰 Application Fee
* **Unreserved:** ₹300 + GST
* **Reserved/Female/EWS/SC/ST:** ₹200 + GST

website_content.title: WB JELET 2026 Round 1 Seat Allotment Result Out
website_content.summary: The West Bengal Joint Entrance Examinations Board (WBJEEB) has declared the WB JELET 2026 Round 1 seat allotment result on September 8, 2026. Candidates must complete fee payment and physical reporting by September 10, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## WB JELET 2026 Round 1 Seat Allotment Released

The **West Bengal Joint Entrance Examinations Board (WBJEEB)** has officially declared the Round 1 Seat Allotment Result for **JELET 2026** on September 8, 2026. Candidates who completed registration and choice locking can now log in to check their allotted seat for Lateral Entry into 2nd year (3rd semester) B.E / B.Tech / B.Pharm degree courses.

### Important Dates for JELET 2026 Counselling

* **Round 1 Allotment Result:** September 8, 2026
* **Seat Acceptance Fee (₹5,000) & Physical Reporting:** September 8 to September 10, 2026 (till 5:00 PM)
* **Round 2 (Upgradation) Result:** September 11, 2026
* **Round 2 Reporting:** September 11 to September 13, 2026
* **Mop-Up Round Registration:** September 15 to September 17, 2026
* **Mop-Up Round Allotment Result:** September 19, 2026

### Options Available After Allotment

* **No-Upgradation (Seat Freeze):** Select this if you are satisfied with the seat. Pay the ₹5,000 seat acceptance fee and complete physical admission at the allotted institute.
* **Yes-Upgradation:** Pay the seat acceptance fee and report to retain the Round 1 seat while staying eligible for a better seat in Round 2.

### How to Check Allotment Status

1. Visit the official WBJEEB portal.
2. Click on the **JELET 2026 Round 1 Seat Allotment Result** link.
3. Enter your **Application Number / Roll Number**, **Password**, and **Security PIN**.
4. View your allotment details and download the provisional allotment letter.

### Important Instructions

* Paying the online seat acceptance fee alone **does not** confirm admission. Physical reporting with original documents is compulsory.
* Failure to report within the deadline leads to automatic seat cancellation and disqualification from Round 2.

website_content.markdown_content:
## AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Overview

Airports Authority of India (AAI), Regional Headquarters, Nagpur has released an official notification for the engagement of **Graduate and Diploma Apprentices** for a 1-year training period under the Apprentices Act.

* **Advertisement No.:** 01/2026/APPRENTICE (Graduate/Diploma)/Nagpur
* **Total Seats:** 09 (Tentative)
* **Training Location:** Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar International Airport, Nagpur
* **Domicile Requirement:** Candidates must be domiciled in Maharashtra (Nagpur or nearby areas).

---

## Important Dates

* **Application Start Date:** 28th August 2026
* **Last Date to Apply Online:** 30th September 2026
* **Cut-off Date for Age Limit:** 31st July 2026

---

## Vacancy & Qualification Details

Candidates must have completed their Degree/Diploma on or after **01.04.2022** with a minimum of 50% marks (45% for SC/ST).

* **Graduate Apprentice (Civil Engg):** B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering (01 Post)
* **Graduate Apprentice (Electrical Engg):** B.E. / B.Tech in Electrical Engineering (01 Post)
* **Graduate Apprentice (HR):** Graduate Degree in any stream with computer knowledge (02 Posts)
* **Graduate Apprentice (Finance):** B.Com or BBA (01 Post)
* **Diploma Apprentice (Civil Engg):** Diploma in Civil Engineering (01 Post)
* **Diploma Apprentice (Electrical Engg):** Diploma in Electrical / Electronics Engineering (01 Post)
* **Diploma Apprentice (Mechanical Engg):** Diploma in Mechanical Engineering (01 Post)

---

## Age Limit & Relaxations (As on 31.07.2026)

* **Minimum Age:** 18 Years
* **Maximum Age:** 26 Years
* **Age Relaxation:** 
  * SC / ST / PWD: 5 Years
  * OBC (Non-Creamy Layer): 3 Years

---

## Monthly Stipend

* **Graduate Apprentice:** ₹15,000/- per month
* **Diploma Apprentice:** ₹12,000/- per month
* **Application Fee:** Nil (No Application Fee)

---

## Selection Process

* **Merit Screening:** Shortlisting based on marks obtained in the qualifying Degree / Diploma.
* **Document Verification & Interview:** Verification of certificates for shortlisted candidates.
* **Medical & Police Verification:** Pre-joining medical fitness and local police clearance.

website_content.title: Tamil Nadu NEET UG Counselling 2026
website_content.summary: The Directorate of Medical Education (DME), Tamil Nadu is conducting online counselling for MBBS, BDS, and allied medical courses based on NEET UG 2026 scores.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Tamil Nadu NEET UG Counselling 2026

The **Directorate of Medical Education (DME), Tamil Nadu** has announced the online counselling process for admissions to **MBBS, BDS, and allied medical courses** for the 2026 session. This process manages the allocation of 85% state quota seats and 100% of seats in private medical colleges within the state.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Round 1 Result Date:** August 27, 2026
* **Round 1 Reporting/Joining Window:** August 27 to September 5, 2026
* **Round 2 Schedule:** September 7, 2026

### 🎓 Eligibility & Scope
* **Requirement:** Based on NEET UG 2026 scores and the Tamil Nadu state merit list.
* **Seats Covered:** 85% State Quota + 100% Private Medical College seats.
* **Exclusions:** 15% All India Quota (AIQ) and central/deemed university seats are handled by the MCC.

### 🛠️ Counselling Procedure
1. **Online Registration:** Register via the official DME Tamil Nadu portal.
2. **Choice Filling:** Select and lock preferred colleges and courses.
3. **Seat Allotment:** Processing based on rank, category, and choices.
4. **Result Declaration:** Check and download the provisional allotment order.
5. **Reporting:** Visit the allotted institute for document verification and confirmation.

### ⚠️ Key Instructions
* **Choice Locking:** Ensure choices are locked before the deadline; unlocked choices may be ignored.
* **Reporting:** Failure to report within the specified joining window may lead to the forfeiture of the seat.
* **Updates:** Regularly check the official website for Round 2 and Round 3 updates.

website_content.summary: KPSC has released the final answer keys for the combined recruitment examination of Last Grade Servants, Storeman, and Lower Division Clerks. Candidates who appeared for the exam on August 1, 2026, can now verify their responses.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Kerala PSC Final Answer Key 2026

The Kerala Public Service Commission (KPSC) has officially published the **Final Answer Key** for the combined recruitment examination covering Category Codes **423/2025, 618/2025, 619/2025, and 620/2025**.

### Exam Details
* **Posts:** Last Grade Servants (LGS), Storeman, and Lower Division Clerk (LDC)
* **Question Paper Code:** 073/2026
* **Exam Date:** 1 August 2026
* **Key Release Date:** 7 September 2026

### Key Highlights
* **Mediums Available:** Separate answer keys are provided for Malayalam, Tamil, and Kannada mediums.
* **Verification:** Candidates must match the answer with the **Alpha Code (A, B, C, or D)** printed on their specific question booklet.
* **Status:** This is the **Final Answer Key** signed by the Section Officer; it is not a provisional draft.
* **Scoring:** Questions marked as deleted ('X') are typically excluded from the final score calculation.

### How to Check Your Answer Key
1. Navigate to the official KPSC website.
2. Access the **Answer Key (OMR Exams)** section.
3. Select the PDF corresponding to your medium (Malayalam/Tamil/Kannada).
4. Match your question number with the corresponding alpha code column to find the correct option.

website_content.title: Rajasthan SET Admit Card 2026
website_content.summary: The University of Kota (UOK) has released the admit cards for the Rajasthan State Eligibility Test (SET) 2026. This exam determines eligibility for the post of Assistant Professor across various subjects in Rajasthan.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Rajasthan SET 2026 Overview
The University of Kota (UOK) has officially released the admit cards for the **Rajasthan State Eligibility Test (SET) 2026**. Candidates who have successfully applied online can now download their hall tickets to appear for the examination.

## 📅 Important Dates
* **Notification Release:** 12 June 2026
* **Application Start Date:** 14 June 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 10 August 2026
* **Admit Card Release:** 07 September 2026
* **Examination Date:** 13 September 2026

## 📝 Exam Pattern & Selection
Selection is based solely on a written objective-type test consisting of Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs):

* **Paper I:** 100 Marks | 50 Questions
* **Paper II:** 200 Marks | 100 Questions
* **Total Duration:** 3 Hours (180 Minutes)
* **Note:** There is no break between Paper I and Paper II; all questions are compulsory.

## 🚀 How to Download Admit Card
1. Visit the official University of Kota (UOK) website.
2. Navigate to the **'Rajasthan SET 2026 Admit Card'** link on the homepage.
3. Enter your registered application credentials to log in.
4. View and download your admit card.
5. Take a clear printout for submission at the exam center.

website_content.title: Exim Bank Recruitment 2026: Deputy Manager & Manager Backlog Vacancies
website_content.summary: Exim Bank of India invites applications for 8 backlog vacancies for Deputy Manager and Manager roles. Apply online from 15th September to 10th October 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## 🏦 Exim Bank Recruitment 2026 Overview

Export-Import Bank of India (Exim Bank) has announced a **Special Recruitment Drive (SRD)** to fill backlog vacancies for high-level banking positions. This is a premier opportunity for Finance professionals and Chartered Accountants to join an all-India financial institution.

### 📋 Vacancy Details
* **Deputy Manager (Grade/Scale JM I):** 6 Posts
* **Manager (Grade/Scale MM II):** 2 Posts
* **Total Vacancies:** 8 (Reserved for SC, ST, and OBC)

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria

**1. Educational Qualification (Common for both posts):**
* Minimum **50% marks in Graduation** (3-year full-time).
* **Post Graduation:** MBA / PGDBA / PGDBM / MMS with specialization in Finance / International Business / Foreign Trade (minimum 2-year full-time with 50% marks) **OR** Chartered Accountant (CA) with mandatory ICAI membership.
* *Note: Distance/Correspondence degrees are not eligible.*

**2. Experience Requirements:**
* **Manager (MM II):** Minimum 3 years of experience in internal/credit audit within a scheduled commercial bank or reputed financial institution.
* **Deputy Manager (JM I):** Minimum 1 year of post-qualification experience in project finance, credit appraisal, or cross-border risk analysis.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 15-09-2026
* **Application Last Date:** 10-10-2026
* **Written Examination:** November 2026 (Tentative)

### 💰 Salary & Benefits
* **Deputy Manager:** Approx. **₹18 Lakh annual CTC**
* **Manager:** Approx. **₹20 Lakh annual CTC**
* Additional perks include leased accommodation, housing loans, and vehicle loans as per Bank rules.

### ✍️ Selection Process
1. **Written Test (70% Weightage):** Subjective professional knowledge test (100 Marks).
2. **Personal Interview (30% Weightage):** Conducted in Mumbai and New Delhi.

### 📝 Application Fee
* **OBC:** ₹600
* **SC / ST / PwBD / Female:** ₹100 (Intimation charges)

## MPSC Bench Clerk Grade-II Admit Card 2026

The Mizoram Public Service Commission (MPSC) has released the official schedule for the download of admit cards for the post of **Bench Clerk Grade-II** under the Lunglei Judicial District (Law & Judicial Department). This is a **Group 'B' (Non-Gazetted)** Limited Departmental Examination (LDE).

* **Post Name:** Bench Clerk Grade-II
* **Exam Category:** Limited Departmental Examination (LDE)
* **Department:** Lunglei Judicial District

## 📅 Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 3rd September 2026
* **Admit Card Download Window:** 8th September to 13th September 2026
* **Written Examination Dates:** 14th September to 18th September 2026

## 📥 How to Download the Admit Card
1. Visit the **MPSC Online Portal**.
2. Log in using your registered candidate account credentials.
3. Find the download link for the **Bench Clerk Grade-II LDE** admit card.
4. Download and take a clear printout for the examination venue.

## ⚠️ Critical Instructions
* **Mandatory Document:** No candidate will be allowed to enter the exam hall without a printed admit card.
* **Strict Window:** Download your card between **8th and 13th September**; there is no mention of window extensions.
* **Rejection Status:** If your application was rejected, check your portal account for the specific reason, as no separate emails/letters will be sent.

website_content.title: Nandyal Anganwadi Worker & Helper Recruitment 2026 – 70 Vacancies Announced
website_content.summary: The Office of the District Women & Child Welfare and Empowerment Officer, Nandyal, has issued a notification for 70 Anganwadi Worker and Helper posts. Eligible local female candidates can apply offline through their respective CDPO offices by September 18, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Nandyal Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Overview

The District Women & Child Welfare and Empowerment Officer, Nandyal District, Andhra Pradesh, has released a official recruitment notification (No. WDC02-ESTOAS(AWS)/1/2025-SA(1)-WDCWNDL) for 70 Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper positions across 6 ICDS Projects.

### Vacancy Details

* **Anganwadi Worker (AWW):** 3 Posts (Atmakur, Nandyal Projects)
* **Anganwadi Helper (AWH):** 67 Posts (Dhone, Allagadda, Atmakur, Nandyal, Banaganapalli, Nandikotkur Projects)
* **Total Posts:** 70

### Important Dates

* **Notification Date:** September 2, 2026
* **Application Start Date:** September 5, 2026 (10:30 AM)
* **Application Submission Deadline:** September 18, 2026 (5:00 PM)

### Eligibility Criteria

* **Gender & Local Residency:** Only local resident married female candidates belonging to the respective mandal/village/habitation are eligible.
* **Educational Qualification:**
  * **Anganwadi Worker:** Passed SSC / 10th Class.
  * **Anganwadi Helper:** Passed SSC / 10th Class (In case 10th-pass candidates are unavailable, candidates with lower qualifications who can read & write will be considered).
* **Age Limit (as on 01.07.2026):**
  * General Range: 21 to below 35 years.
  * Relaxation: 18 years and above in notified ICDS habitation areas if 21+ candidates are not available.

### Key Documents Required (Self-Attested Copies)

* Class 10th Marks List / Transfer Certificate (TC)
* Age Proof / Date of Birth Certificate
* Caste Certificate
* Residence Certificate
* Aadhaar Card & Ration Card
* Special Category Proof (Widow certificate / PHC Disability certificate if applicable)

### How to Apply

1. Download or collect the application form for your specific project/AWC.
2. Fill out all required fields carefully and attach self-attested copies of all requisite certificates.
3. Submit the completed application form in person at the respective **Child Development Project Officer (CDPO)** office before the deadline (September 18, 2026, 5:00 PM).

website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Commissioner for Entrance Examinations (CEE), Kerala, has officially released the **First Phase Centralised Allotment Process (CAP)** list for admission to Post Graduate Dental (MDS) courses for the academic year 2026.

## Key Highlights
* **Course:** Post Graduate Dental (MDS)
* **Allotment Basis:** NEET MDS 2026 Rank and candidate-submitted options.
* **Process:** Centralised Allotment Process (CAP).

## Important Dates
* **Allotment List Release Date:** September 5, 2026
* **Admission Completion Deadline:** September 11, 2026

## How to Check Allotment Status
1. Visit the official CEE Kerala portal.
2. Access the **'PG Dental 2026'** or **'MDS 2026 - Candidate Portal'**.

* **Memo:** Download and print the allotment memo from the portal.

* **Reporting:** Report in person to the allotted college with all original documents.
* **Deadline:** All formalities must be completed by **September 11, 2026**.

**Warning:** Failure to report by the deadline may result in the loss of the current allotment and higher-order options.

The **Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA)** has officially announced the schedule for Round 1 online seat allotment for MDS admissions for the 2026 academic session.

* **Option Entry Window Opens:** September 5, 2026 (4:00 PM)

* **Round 1 Provisional Result:** September 9, 2026 (After 6:00 PM)

### 🛠️ How to Enter Options
1. Visit the official KEA counselling portal.
2. Log in using your **registered credentials** (Registration/CET number and password).
3. Carefully review the **Seat Matrix and Fee Structure**.
4. Select and arrange preferred colleges and MDS specialisations in order of priority.
5. Submit options before the deadline and monitor the mock allotment result.

### ⚠️ Key Instructions
* **Eligibility:** Qualifying NEET MDS 2026 is necessary but not a guarantee of a seat; allotment depends on rank, category, and option entry.
* **Mode of Admission:** All rounds, including stray vacancies, are conducted **online only** via KEA. No separate college-level admissions exist.
* **Mock Result:** The mock allotment is for indicative purposes only and cannot be used for reporting.
* **Verification:** Always rely on the official KEA portal for seat matrix and fee details.

website_content.markdown_content:

Maharashtra Metro Rail Corporation Limited (MAHA Metro) is inviting applications for experienced personnel to join the **Nagpur and Pune Metro Rail Projects** on a contractual basis for 3 years.

**Key Highlights:**
* **Total Vacancies:** 56 (40 for Nagpur, 16 for Pune)
* **Application Mode:** Offline (Speed Post)
* **Eligibility:** Indian Nationals, residents of Maharashtra with experience in Metro/Railways/Govt/PSUs.

| Post | Nagpur | Pune | Total |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: |

* **Office Assistant:** Graduation in any discipline.

1. **Written Test:** 70 Marks (General Aptitude & Domain Knowledge).
2. **Interview:** 30 Marks (Experience & Domain Knowledge).
3. **Merit List:** Based on combined marks.
4. **Medical Examination:** Pre-Medical Examination (PME) at nominated hospital.

* **Notification Date:** 10 August 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 25 September 2026 (until 6:00 PM)

website_content.summary: The State CET Cell, Maharashtra has released the final Round 4 seat allotment for BBA, BMS, BCA, and BBM programmes. Allotted candidates must complete reporting and fee payment by September 8, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## MAH BBA CAP 2026 Round 4 Overview
The State Common Entrance Test (CET) Cell, Maharashtra, has announced the **Round 4 (Final) Seat Allotment** for the 2026-27 academic session. This process covers admissions for BBA, BMS, BCA, BBM, and Integrated MBA (1st year) programmes across the state.

## Key Dates to Remember
* **Round 4 Allotment Date:** September 5, 2026
* **Self-Verification & Fee Payment:** Up to September 8, 2026
* **Reporting to Institute:** Up to September 8, 2026

## Step-by-Step Guide to Check Allotment
1. Log in to the official portal using your **Application ID/Email** and **Password**.
2. Navigate to the **'Round 4 Allotment'** or **'Allotment Status'** tab.
3. View your allotted institute, course, and category.
4. Download and print the allotment letter for physical reporting.

## Mandatory Confirmation Process
To secure your seat, you must complete these three steps before the deadline:
* **Self-Verification:** Verify personal details, marks, and reservation claims online.
* **Seat Acceptance Fee:** Pay the required fee via the candidate login dashboard.
* **Institute Reporting:** Report physically to the allotted college with original documents for final admission.

## Important Instructions
* **Strict Deadline:** Failure to complete verification or payment by **September 8** will lead to seat cancellation.
* **Final Round:** As this is the final CAP round, any further admission attempts must be made through **Institute Level rounds**.
* **Grievances:** Any discrepancies in allotment should be reported via the online portal immediately.

website_content.summary: The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the admit cards for the Stenographer Grade 'C' and 'D' Computer-Based Examination 2026. Candidates can now download their hall tickets for the exams scheduled from September 9 to 15, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## SSC Stenographer Grade 'C' & 'D' Exam 2026

**The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has officially released the admit cards for the Stenographer Grade "C" and Grade "D" Computer-Based Examination (CBE).** Candidates who successfully applied for these posts can now access their hall tickets via the regional SSC portals.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Admit Card Release Date:** September 6, 2026
* **Computer-Based Examination:** September 9 to 15, 2026
* **City Intimation Slip Released:** August 31, 2026
* **Original Application Deadline:** May 15, 2026

### 📝 Exam Overview
* **Exam Stage:** Tier-I (Computer-Based Examination)
* **Login Requirements:** Registration Number/Roll Number and Date of Birth or Password
* **Mode of Download:** Online via official SSC regional portals

### 🛠️ Step-by-Step Download Process
1. Visit the official SSC website.
2. Navigate to the **"Admit Card"** section on the homepage.
3. Select your respective **SSC Regional Website**.
4. Click the link: **"SSC Stenographer Grade 'C' & 'D' Admit Card 2026."**
5. Enter your login credentials and the captcha code.
6. Download and take a clear printout of the hall ticket.

### ⚠️ Mandatory Exam Day Instructions
* **Reporting Time:** Reach the venue at least **60 minutes** before the reporting time.
* **Required Documents:** A printed copy of the admit card and one **original valid photo ID** proof.
* **Prohibited Items:** Mobile phones, smartwatches, and calculators are strictly forbidden inside the hall.
* **Note:** The city intimation slip is NOT a substitute for the actual admit card.

website_content.markdown_content:
## TSU Recruitment 2026 Overview

“Tribhuvan” Sahkari University (TSU), an Institution of National Importance, is inviting applications for **17 contractual posts** across various administrative and technical categories. These positions are for a period of three years, with some also open for deputation.

## Vacancy & Salary Breakdown

* **Assistant Registrar (Various streams)**: ₹1,06,000 per month
* **Senior Officer / Consultant / Resident Engineer**: ₹88,000 per month

## Eligibility Criteria

* **Qualification**: Bachelor's Degree with MBA/PG Diploma in Management or equivalent.
* **Experience**: Minimum 5 years of supervisory experience in Pay Level 6+.

### 2. Assistant Registrar

## Maharashtra GNM 2026 Merit List Overview

The State Common Entrance Test Cell (CET Cell), Maharashtra, has officially released the **provisional merit list** for GNM 2026. Candidates are advised to verify their details carefully to ensure a smooth admission process.

## 🛠️ Grievance Redressal Process
If you find any errors in your name, application number, category, or rank, follow these steps:
* Submit your grievance via the official portal by **September 8, 8 PM**.
* **Mandatory:** You must upload supporting documents; otherwise, the grievance will not be accepted.

* **Verify Fully:** Check your application number and category, not just the merit rank.
* **Official Source:** Avoid relying on unofficial screenshots; always use the official portal.
* **Save a Copy:** Download and keep a PDF copy of the merit list for future counselling and admission formalities.
* **Stay Updated:** Regularly check the official notification for further instructions on choice-filling and counselling.

website_content.markdown_content:
## SSC JHT Admit Card 2026 Overview

The **Staff Selection Commission (SSC)** has officially released the hall tickets for the **Combined Hindi Translators Examination (CHT) 2026**. Candidates who applied for the various translator posts can now access their admit cards for the Paper-I exam.

### 📅 Key Dates
* **Admit Card Release Date:** 6th September 2026
* **Paper-I Exam Date:** 8th September 2026
* **Exam Mode:** Computer-Based Test (CBT)

* Junior Hindi Translator (JHT)
* Junior Translation Officer (JTO)
* Junior Translator (JT)
* Senior Hindi Translator (SHT)
* Senior Translation Officer (STO)

### 🚀 How to Download Your Admit Card
1. Visit the official SSC website: **ssc.gov.in**.
2. Navigate to the **"Admit Card"** section on the homepage.

* **Verification:** Double-check your name, photograph, and shift details. Contact the regional SSC office immediately if any errors are found.

website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA) has announced the **Round 2 Provisional Cutoff and Seat Allotment** for the Diploma Common Entrance Test (DCET) 2026. This process facilitates lateral entry admission into the second year of Engineering and the first year of Architecture courses in Karnataka.

## 📅 Important Dates
* **Round 2 Option Entry Started:** September 2, 2026
* **Round 2 Provisional Cutoff/Allotment Release:** September 5, 2026
* **Fee Payment Window:** September 7 to September 9, 2026
* **Last Date to Report at Allotted College:** September 10, 2026

## 🛠️ Counselling Process
* **Verification:** Registration and document verification.
* **Option Entry:** Candidates select preferred colleges and courses online.
* **Allotment:** KEA prepares allotments based on rank, category, and preference.
