website_content.title: Delhi High Court Personal Assistant (PA) Recruitment 2026: Syllabus & Exam Pattern
website_content.summary: The High Court of Delhi has released the official syllabus and exam pattern for the recruitment of 150 Personal Assistants (PA). Candidates must navigate a rigorous four-stage selection process to secure a position.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The High Court of Delhi is recruiting for the post of **Personal Assistant (PA)** and **Senior Personal Assistant (SPA)**. To succeed, candidates must clear four distinct stages of examination. 

## Selection Process
The selection process is sequential; candidates must clear each stage individually:
* **Stage I: English Typing Test** (Qualifying only)
* **Stage II: English Shorthand Test** (Counts toward final merit)
* **Stage III: Main Descriptive Examination** (Written)
* **Stage IV: Interview** (Final Stage)

## Detailed Exam Pattern

### 1. English Typing Test (Stage I)
* **Duration:** 10 Minutes
* **Requirement:** Min. 40 words per minute (wpm)
* **Permissible Errors:** 3% of total words

### 2. English Shorthand Test (Stage II)
* **Speed:** 100 wpm
* **Format:** 500 words dictated in 5 minutes
* **Transcription Time:** 45 minutes
* **Marks:** 110 Marks
* **Disqualification:** More than 25 mistakes leads to failure

### 3. Main Descriptive Exam (Stage III)
* **Total Marks:** 100 | **Duration:** 120 Minutes
* **Essay (250 words):** 40 Marks
* **Letter Writing:** 15 Marks
* **Grammar & Comprehension:** 25 Marks
* **Translation (Hindi to English):** 10 Marks
* **Translation (English to Hindi):** 10 Marks
* **Qualifying Marks:** 45% for Reserved/PwBD candidates

### 4. Interview (Stage IV)
* **Total Marks:** 15 Marks
* **Minimum Qualifying Marks:** None

## Preparation Strategy
* **Focus on Speed:** Daily practice for 100 wpm shorthand and 40 wpm typing is critical as these are the first hurdles.
* **Master Descriptive English:** The Essay carries the highest weightage (40 marks); practice structured 250-word essays on administrative topics.
* **Bilingual Proficiency:** Regular practice of Hindi-English translation to secure the 20 marks available in Stage III.

The Odisha Staff Selection Commission (OSSC) has officially published the Model Answer Key for the written examination of the **Combined Recruitment Examination (CRE)** for various posts requiring Physical Measurement Test (PMT) and Physical Efficiency Test (PET)-2025, conducted under Advertisement No. 980/OSSC.

* **Answer Key Release Date:** 05/09/2026

* **User ID:** Roll Number
* **Password:** Date of Birth (Format: DDMMYYYY)

## Overview
The Directorate of Medical Education (DME), Madhya Pradesh, has announced the commencement of **Round 2 registration** for candidates seeking admission to MBBS and BDS courses under the **85% state quota** based on the Re-NEET UG 2026 results.

## Key Highlights
* **Courses:** MBBS and BDS
* **Quota:** 85% State Quota
* **Registration Mode:** Online via official portal
* **Eligibility:** Based on NEET UG 2026 results (declared July 16, 2026)

## Important Dates
* **Registration/Edit Window:** September 5 to September 6, 2026 (until 11:30 PM)
* **Revised Merit List (Expected):** September 7, 2026
* **Physical Reporting (Tentative):** September 12 to September 18, 2026

## Seat Allotment Process
1. **Merit List:** DME publishes the revised merit list for Round 2.
2. **Choice Filling:** Eligible candidates must complete fresh choice filling of colleges/courses.
3. **Locking:** Choices must be locked before the deadline (non-editable after locking).
4. **Allotment:** Based on rank, category, choices, and reservation policy.
5. **Reporting:** Allotted candidates must report to the college for document verification.

## How to Apply
* Visit the official DME MP portal.
* Select the **Round 2 Registration** or **Registration Edit** link.
* Enter NEET UG 2026 roll number and personal details.
* Pay the registration fee and security deposit online.
* Upload required documents: Scorecard, 10th/12th marksheets, Domicile, and Category certificates.
* Complete e-verification and choice filling after the merit list is released.

## Critical Instructions
* **Fresh Choice Filling:** Compulsory for all candidates in Round 2, including those seeking upgradation. Round 1 choices will NOT carry forward.
* **Duplicate Registration:** Round 1 registered candidates should NOT create a new registration; use the edit option instead.

website_content.summary: ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Pune is inviting walk-in interviews for 46 contractual posts including Professors and Senior Residents from September 7 to 11, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Bibvewadi, Pune has issued Advertisement No. 10 of 2026 for the recruitment of **teaching faculty and Senior Residents** on a contractual basis. This drive aims to fill existing and newly arising vacancies.

## Vacancy Breakdown
* **Professor:** 08 Posts
* **Associate Professor:** 11 Posts
* **Assistant Professor:** 09 Posts
* **Senior Resident (3 Year):** 15 Posts
* **Senior Resident (1 Year):** 03 Posts
* **Total Vacancies:** 46

## Eligibility & Age Limit
* **Educational Qualification:** Candidates must fulfill requirements as prescribed by the **National Medical Commission (NMC)** guidelines.
* **Age Limit (Faculty):** Maximum 68 Years.
* **Age Limit (Senior Resident):** Maximum 45 Years.
* *Age relaxation applies as per Govt of India rules.*

## Remuneration (Approximate)
* **Professor (Level 13):** Rs. 2,57,000
* **Associate Professor (Level 12):** Rs. 1,70,000
* **Assistant Professor/Senior Resident (Level 11):** Rs. 1,50,000

## Important Dates & Venue
* **Walk-in Interview Dates:** 07 September 2026 to 11 September 2026
* **Reporting Time:** 9:00 AM to 11:00 AM
* **Interview Timing:** 9:30 AM to 4:00 PM
* **Venue:** ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Bibvewadi, Pune, Maharashtra

## Application Fee
* **General/Other:** Rs. 500/- (via Demand Draft in favor of "ESI Fund A/c No.-1", payable at Pune)
* **SC/ST/PwD/Female/ESIC Contractual Employees:** Nil

## Selection Process
Selection will be based on a **Personal Interview** conducted by the Selection Board, followed by document verification.

## Amroha Anganwadi Karyakartri Recruitment 2026

The Office of the District Programme Officer (Bal Vikas evam Pushtahar), Amroha, has announced the recruitment of **105 Anganwadi Karyakartris** across seven Child Development Project areas in the Amroha district. These positions are on an honorarium basis.

### 📅 Important Dates

* **Application Start Date:** 04.09.2026
* **Application Last Date:** 24.09.2026 (Midnight)
* **Age Reckoning Date:** 01.07.2026

* **Gender:** Only women candidates are eligible.
* **Residence:** Must be a resident of the concerned Gram Sabha/Ward. If unavailable, residents of the concerned Nyaya Panchayat may be considered.
* **Education:** Minimum **Intermediate (12th)** or equivalent. Preference will be given to candidates with higher qualifications (up to Postgraduate).
* **Age Limit:** 18 to 35 years (as of 01.07.2026).

| Project Name | Type | Posts |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Amroha Shahar | Urban | 10 |
| Amroha Dehat | Rural | 9 |
| Dhanaura | Rural | 26 |
| Gajraula | Rural | 17 |
| Gangeshwari | Rural | 6 |
| Hasanpur | Rural | 12 |
| Joya | Rural | 25 |

Selection is based on a merit list derived from educational qualifications. Special priority is given in the following order:
1. **BPL** widow/legally divorced/separated women.
2. Above-poverty-line widow/divorced/separated women.
3. Other eligible candidates based on educational merit.

* **Documents:** Digitally verifiable residence and caste certificates are mandatory.
* **Income Limit:** Rural: ₹46,080 | Urban: ₹56,460 (Annual).

website_content.markdown_content:
## DSSSB Warder (Male) PET 2026

The **Delhi Subordinate Services Selection Board (DSSSB)** has officially released the admit cards for the Physical Endurance Test (PET) for the post of **Warder (Male), Post Code 15/25**.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Admit Card Release:** 5 September 2026
* **Physical Endurance Test (PET):** 12 September – 13 October 2026
* **Tier-I Result Declared:** 27 April 2026

### 📏 Physical Standards for PET
Candidates must meet the following mandatory requirements:
* **Height:** 170 cm
* **Chest:** 81–85 cm (unexpanded–expanded)
* **Race:** 1600 metres in 6 minutes
* **Long Jump:** 12 feet
* **High Jump:** 3 feet 9 inches

### 📉 Tier-I Cut Off Marks
* **UR:** 139.35
* **EWS:** 121.56
* **OBC:** 70.04
* **SC:** 110.46
* **ST:** 98.63
* **Ex-Servicemen:** 60.37
* **Sportspersons:** 60.84

### 📄 Required Documents for PET
* Printed copy of the **PET e-admit card**

website_content.markdown_content:
## MPSC Admit Card 2026-27

The Mizoram Public Service Commission (MPSC) has released the official schedule for downloading admit cards and the dates for written examinations for four key positions. Candidates must access their hall tickets through their individual accounts on the MPSC Online Portal.

### 📅 Examination & Download Schedule

| Post & Department | Admit Card Download Window | Exam Date |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Inspector of Excise & Narcotics / State Tax Officer** | 4th - 15th Sept, 2026 | 23.09.2026 to 25.09.2026 |
| **Junior Engineer (Civil) - P&E** | 21st Sept - 1st Oct, 2026 | 06.10.2026 & 07.10.2026 |
| **Motor Vehicle Inspector (MVI)** | 5th - 15th Oct, 2026 | 27.10.2026 & 28.10.2026 |

### 🛠️ How to Download Your Admit Card
* Visit the official MPSC Online Portal.
* Log in using your candidate account credentials.
* Navigate to the admit card section for your specific post.
* Download and print the admit card within the specified timeframe.

### ⚠️ Important Instructions
* **Check for Rejections:** If your application was not accepted, a rejection message with the reason will be available in your portal account.
* **Document Verification:** Possessing an admit card does not guarantee final eligibility; candidates can be rejected at any stage if uploaded documents are found unsatisfactory.
* **Exam Details:** Reporting time and center address are mentioned specifically on the downloaded admit card.

website_content.title: Delhi High Court Senior Personal Assistant & Personal Assistant Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: The High Court of Delhi is inviting online applications for 150 vacancies of Senior Personal Assistant (SPA) and Personal Assistant (PA). The application window is open from September 15 to October 5, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The High Court of Delhi has announced vacancies for **Senior Personal Assistant (SPA)** and **Personal Assistant (PA)** positions. This is a Group 'B' recruitment aimed at filling existing vacancies and creating a panel for future requirements.

## Vacancy Details
* **Total Vacancies:** 150
* **Senior Personal Assistant (SPA):** 117 Posts (Pay Level 8)
* **Personal Assistant (PA):** 33 Posts (Pay Level 7)

## Eligibility Criteria
### Educational Qualification
* **Graduate** from a recognized university.
* **Technical Skills (SPA):** Shorthand (English) $\ge$ 110 w.p.m. and Typewriting (English) $\ge$ 40 w.p.m.
* **Technical Skills (PA):** Shorthand (English) $\ge$ 100 w.p.m. and Typewriting (English) $\ge$ 40 w.p.m.

### Age Limit (as of 01.01.2026)
* **Minimum:** 18 Years
* **Maximum:** 32 Years
* **Relaxations:** SC/ST (5 years), OBC-NCL (3 years), PwBD (10-15 years).

## Selection Process
Candidates will be evaluated through a four-stage process:
1. **English Typing Test:** Qualifying stage (40 w.p.m.).
2. **English Shorthand Test:** Merit-based transcription test.
3. **Main Descriptive Examination:** Essay, Letter Writing, Grammar, and Translation.
4. **Interview:** Final personality and suitability assessment.

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 15.09.2026 (11:00 AM)
* **Application Deadline:** 05.10.2026 (11:00 PM)
* **Correction Window:** 12.10.2026 to 14.10.2026

## Application Fee
* **General / OBC-NCL / EWS:** ₹1,500
* **SC / ST / PwBD:** ₹1,300

website_content.summary: The Directorate of Technical Education (DoTE), Tamil Nadu, is releasing the TNEA B.Arch 2026 rank list today. Candidates can proceed with online registration, choice filling, and seat allotment via the official portal.
website_content.markdown_content:
## TNEA B.Arch Counselling 2026 Overview
The Directorate of Technical Education (DoTE), Tamil Nadu, is conducting the admission process for first-year **Bachelor of Architecture (B.Arch)** programmes. The entire process, from registration to seat allotment, is handled digitally.

### 📅 Key Dates (Tentative)
* **Rank List Publication:** 05 September 2026 (Expected Today)
* **Tentative Allotment Release:** 01 August 2026
* **Provisional Allotment:** 02 August 2026
* **Reporting/Joining Dates:** 02 to 06 August 2026
* **Upward Opted Provisional Allotment:** 08 August 2026

### 📝 Admission Process
1. **Registration:** Create login credentials with basic personal and academic details.
2. **Application:** Submit NATA/JEE scores, category details, and upload original certificates.
3. **Verification:** Complete document verification (online or at designated centres).
4. **Rank Check:** Log in to view your rank and category position after publication.
5. **Choice Filling:** Select preferred colleges and branches. **Tip:** Enter as many valid choices as possible to ensure allotment.
6. **Allotment:** Confirm tentative allotment within the same-day window and download the provisional order.
7. **Reporting:** Visit the allotted college with original documents to finalize admission.

### ⚠️ Important Instructions
* All dates are tentative; verify the live notification on the portal.
* **Confirmation Window:** Tentative allotments usually require confirmation within a narrow window (typically 10 AM to 7 PM).
* **B.Arch Specific:** Do not confuse these dates with B.E./B.Tech supplementary counselling, as B.Arch is a separate process.
* Keep your NATA/JEE scorecards and academic certificates ready for every stage.

| 7 Sept | 04:05 PM - 06:05 PM | Junior Manager |

website_content.title: NVS Class 11th Lateral Entry Admission 2027-28
website_content.summary: Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti (NVS) invites applications for admission to Class XI for the 2027-28 session through the Lateral Entry Selection Test. The registration window is open from 2nd September to 30th September 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## NVS Class XI Lateral Entry Selection Test 2027

**Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti (NVS)**, under the Ministry of Education, Government of India, has announced the admission process for **Class XI (11th)** for the academic session 2027-28 against vacant seats in Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas (JNVs).

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Registration Start Date:** 2 September 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 30 September 2026 (Wednesday)
* **Date of Selection Test:** 10 April 2027 (Saturday)

### 🎓 Admission Details
* **Admission Class:** Class XI (11th)
* **Academic Session:** 2027-28
* **Selection Method:** Lateral Entry Selection Test
* **Application Fee:** No fee required at any stage

### 📝 Application Process
1. Visit the official NVS portal.
2. Read the notification-cum-prospectus for eligibility.
3. Fill in basic details: state/district of residence and study, and Aadhaar number.
4. Upload required documents: Photograph and signatures (Candidate & Parent).
5. Select up to **two streams** and up to **three preferred JNVs** per stream.
6. Review and submit the final application.

### ⚠️ Key Instructions
* **Aadhaar Mandatory:** Candidates without an Aadhaar number must apply for enrolment before registering.
* **Verification:** Provisional selection is subject to successful document verification.
* **Transfer Certificate:** Apply for TC from the current school only after admission confirmation by the allotted JNV.
* **Accuracy:** No correction requests will be entertained after the correction window closes.

website_content.title: Karnataka UGCET (KCET) 2026 Round 3 Provisional Seat Allotment & Choice Entry
website_content.summary: KEA has released the Round 3 provisional seat allotment for KCET 2026. Candidates must exercise their choice by September 6, 2026, to secure their allotted seats.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA)** has officially announced the Round 3 Provisional Seat Allotment results for the Karnataka UGCET (KCET) 2026 counselling process. Candidates are now required to log in and exercise their choice (including Choice 4) to confirm their admission status.

## Important Dates
* **Round 3 Result Date:** September 4, 2026
* **Choice Entry Window Opens:** September 4, 2026
* **Choice Entry Deadline:** September 6, 2026 (until 10:00 AM)

## Courses Covered
This allotment applies to the following professional courses:
* Engineering & Architecture
* Agriculture & Veterinary Science
* Pharmacy & B.Sc Nursing
* Yoga & Naturopathy
* BPT, BPO, and Allied Health Sciences

## Steps to Check Allotment & Exercise Choice
1. Visit the official KEA portal.
2. Log in using your **CET application number** and password/DOB.
3. Verify your allotted college, course, and category.
4. Select the applicable choice (Choice 1, Choice 4, etc.) displayed on your dashboard.
5. Complete the fee payment if accepting the seat and download the admission order.

## Key Instructions
* **Deadline Warning:** Failure to exercise a choice by the deadline may result in the automatic cancellation of your allotted seat.
* **Terminal Round:** Round 3 is generally considered a terminal round; ensure your selection is final.
* **Documentation:** Keep your CET number and category certificates ready for a smooth process.

website_content.title: KEA Principal Recruitment 2026: 247 Vacancies in Govt PU Colleges
website_content.summary: KEA invites applications from eligible serving lecturers to fill 247 Principal posts across Karnataka. The application window is open from September 7 to October 4, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## KEA Principal Recruitment 2026 Overview
The Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA) is recruiting for the post of **Principal in Government Pre-University Colleges** on behalf of the Department of School Education. 

**Important Note:** This recruitment is **NOT open to the general public**. It is a departmental recruitment specifically for serving lecturers.

## Vacancy Break-up
Total Vacancies: **247**
* **Residual Parent Cadre (RPC):** 216 Posts
* **Kalyana-Karnataka (KK) Local Cadre:** 31 Posts

## Eligibility Criteria
To be eligible, candidates must meet the following requirements:
* **Current Status:** Must be a serving Lecturer in Government Pre-University Colleges (School Education Dept).
* **Experience:** Minimum of **10 years of service** in the Lecturer cadre.
* **Probation:** Must have satisfactorily completed the probation period.

## Selection Process
Selection is based on a competitive examination consisting of three papers:
* **Paper 1:** Kannada Language Test (Qualifying only - 50 marks minimum required).
* **Paper 2:** General Studies (150 Marks).
* **Paper 3:** KCS Rules, Education Act 1983, and Educational Psychology (150 Marks).

**Marking Scheme:** 0.25 negative marking for each wrong answer in Papers 2 and 3.

## Application Fee
* **GM / 2A / 2B / 3A / 3B:** Rs. 1,500
* **SC / ST / Cat-1 / ESM / TG:** Rs. 1,000
* **PwD:** Rs. 500

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 07-09-2026
* **Application Last Date:** 04-10-2026
* **Fee Payment Deadline:** 05-10-2026

## Maharashtra B.Sc Nursing Merit List 2026

The **State Common Entrance Test Cell, Maharashtra** is scheduled to release the provisional merit list for candidates seeking admission to B.Sc Nursing through the **Centralised Admission Process (CAP) 2026**.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Provisional Merit List Release:** September 6, 2026 (Expected)
* **Grievance/Objection Window:** September 7 to 8, 2026 (up to 8 PM)
* **Final Merit List Release:** September 11, 2026

### 🔍 How to Download the Merit List
1. Visit the official CET Cell medical portal.
2. Navigate to the **Maharashtra B.Sc Nursing CAP 2026** section.
3. Click the link for the **Provisional Merit List 2026**.
4. Download the PDF file.
5. Use **Ctrl+F** to search for your name or application number to find your merit rank.

### ⚠️ Key Instructions for Candidates
* **Provisional Nature:** The list released on Sept 6 is provisional and subject to change based on grievances.
* **Correcting Errors:** If any discrepancy is found, candidates MUST submit a grievance between **Sept 7 and Sept 8 (by 8 PM)**.
* **Finality:** The final merit list will be published on **September 11, 2026**, following the review of all objections.
* **Documentation:** It is highly recommended to keep copies of both the provisional and final merit lists for the counselling process.

website_content.title: ICSI CS December 2026 New Exam Centres Notification
website_content.summary: ICSI has announced 7 new ad hoc examination centres across five states for the CS Executive and Professional December 2026 session. Candidates must complete their enrollment by September 25, 2026, to avoid late fees.
website_content.markdown_content:
## ICSI New Exam Centres Update (December 2026 Session)

The **Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI)** has expanded its examination network by introducing **7 new exam centres** on an ad hoc basis. This move aims to provide greater convenience to candidates appearing for the CS Executive and Professional programmes.

### 📍 New Exam Centres & Codes
* **Bihar:** Begusarai (Code: 129), Darbhanga (Code: 130)
* **Uttar Pradesh:** Ayodhya (Code: 268), Saharanpur (Code: 270)
* **Uttarakhand:** Haridwar (Code: 269)
* **Maharashtra:** Ratnagiri (Code: 492)
* **Madhya Pradesh:** Rewa (Code: 493)

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Enrollment Window:** 26 August 2026 to 25 September 2026 (Without late fee)
* **Late Fee Enrollment Deadline:** 10 October 2026 (Late fee: ₹250 per group)
* **Pre-Examination Test Deadline:** 24 September 2026 (Without late fee)

### 🛠️ How to Select New Centres
1. Log in to the **ICSI Student Portal** using your credentials.
2. Access the enrollment form for the **December 2026 session**.
3. Navigate to the **Exam Centre Preference** section.
4. Select the desired new centre from the updated drop-down list.
5. Complete the form and submit the applicable fees.

### ⚠️ Key Instructions
* These centres are opened on an **ad hoc basis** and are subject to review in future sessions.
* Candidates who have already enrolled can check the student portal for **centre-change facility** availability.
* This update does not impact the exam syllabus, pattern, or eligibility criteria.

* **SC/ST:** Rs. 250

website_content.title: Delhi University (DU) Competence Enhancement Scheme (CES) Admission 2026
website_content.summary: Delhi University invites applications for the Competence Enhancement Scheme (CES) 2026 starting September 2nd. This unique program allows learners of any age to enroll in individual papers without committing to a full degree.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Competence Enhancement Scheme (CES)**, conducted by the Institute of Life-Long Learning (ILLL) at the University of Delhi, is designed for lifelong learners who wish to enhance their skills through specific academic papers.

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Age Limit:** No age bar; open to all.
* **Target Audience:** Students, working professionals, and senior citizens.
* **Restriction:** Candidates currently enrolled in any regular programme at the University of Delhi are **not eligible** to apply.

## Scheme Highlights
* **Course Load:** Applicants can enroll in a maximum of **2 papers or 8 credits** per semester from the same discipline.
* **Certification:** Successful completion (based on eligibility and attendance) earns credits recorded in the **Academic Bank of Credit (ABC)** and a certificate.
* **Fee Structure:** The cost is **₹6,000 per paper**, payable via the DU Miscellaneous Fee payment system.

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** September 2, 2026
* **Deadline:** Please refer to the official portal for closing dates.

## Step-by-Step Application Process
1. **Registration:** Create an account on the official CES portal.
2. **Course Selection:** Enter the programme name, semester, course/paper name, code, and credits.
3. **Documentation:** Upload the required documents and NOC (if applicable).
4. **Verification:** Wait for the concerned department or college to verify the application.
5. **Payment:** Once verified, pay the fee through the Miscellaneous Fee system.
6. **Confirmation:** Submit the fee receipt to the respective office to finalize admission.

website_content.summary: The National Testing Agency (NTA) has released the provisional answer key for the AIAPGET 2026 exam. Candidates can now download their responses and challenge any answers until September 5, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## AIAPGET 2026 Provisional Answer Key Update

The National Testing Agency (NTA) has officially published the **provisional answer key** for the All India AYUSH Post Graduate Entrance Test (AIAPGET) 2026. Candidates who appeared for the examination on August 22, 2026 (or the re-examination on September 1) can now verify their performance.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Answer Key Release Date:** September 3, 2026
* **Last Date to Raise Objections:** September 5, 2026 (11:59 PM)

### 🛠️ How to Download Answer Key
1. Visit the official AIAPGET portal.
2. Click on the **'Answer Key / Challenge(s)'** link on the homepage.
3. Log in using your **Application Number** and **Password/Date of Birth**.
4. Review your recorded responses and download the PDF for future reference.

### 🚩 How to Raise Objections
* Access the objection link via the official login portal.
* Select the specific question(s) you wish to challenge.
* Upload necessary **supporting documents** as evidence.
* Pay the prescribed **objection processing fee** to make the challenge valid.

### ⚠️ Key Instructions
* Objections are accepted **only online**; no offline requests will be entertained.
* A challenge is only valid upon successful payment of the processing fee.
* Ensure all login credentials are ready before accessing the portal.

website_content.markdown_content:
## RITES Limited Engineering Professionals Recruitment 2026

RITES Limited, a Navratna Central Public Sector Enterprise under the Ministry of Railways, is recruiting for various professional engineering and architecture roles on a regular basis.

### 📌 Vacancy Details
| Post Name | Vacancies | Max Age |
| :--- | :---: | :---: |
| DGM (Structural Engineer / Buildings) | 1 | 41 Years |
| Assistant Manager (Structural Engineer / Buildings) | 1 | 32 Years |
| Assistant Manager (BIM Expert / PHE) | 1 | 32 Years |
| Assistant Manager / Architect (Healthcare Expert) | 1 | 32 Years |
| Assistant Manager (Architect / Building Expert) | 7 | 32 Years |
| Assistant Manager (Architect / Metro Rail Expert) | 1 | 32 Years |

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria

**1. DGM (Structural Engineer / Buildings)**
* **Education:** Full Time B.E/B.Tech in Civil Engineering AND Master's in Structural Engineering.
* **Experience:** Min 11 years post-qualification experience (including 5 years in design of multi-storied buildings).

**2. Assistant Manager Posts**
* **Structural/BIM/Architect:** B.Tech (Civil) or B.Arch as per specific post requirements.
* **Experience:** Minimum 2 years of post-qualification experience in the respective specialization.

### 💰 Salary & Fees
* **Pay Scale (DGM):** ₹70,000 - ₹2,00,000
* **Pay Scale (AM):** ₹40,000 - ₹1,40,000
* **Application Fee:** 
    * General/OBC: ₹600 + Taxes
    * EWS/SC/ST/PwD: ₹300 + Taxes

### ⚙️ Selection Process
* **For DGM:** Document Scrutiny $\rightarrow$ Interview (100% weightage).
* **For Assistant Manager:** Written Test (60% weightage) $\rightarrow$ Document Scrutiny $\rightarrow$ Interview (40% weightage).

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 03 September 2026
* **Application Start:** 03 September 2026
* **Last Date to Apply:** 30 September 2026

website_content.markdown_content:
## MPPSC Veterinary Result 2026 Overview

The Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission (MPPSC), Indore, has officially declared the results for the **Assistant Director / Veterinary Assistant Surgeon / Veterinary Extension Officer Exam 2026**. A roll-number-wise list of provisionally shortlisted candidates for the interview round has been released.

### Key Highlights
* **Total Vacancies:** 80
* **Total Shortlisted for Interview:** 255 candidates (Part A: 193, Part B: 62)
* **Exam Date:** 2 August 2026
* **Result Date:** 3 September 2026

### Important Dates
* **Result Declaration:** 3 September 2026
* **Document Submission Deadline:** 24 September 2026
* **Late Submission Window (with ₹3,000 fee):** 25 September to 1 October 2026

### Document Submission Process
Shortlisted candidates must follow these steps to ensure their candidature:
1. **Order:** Arrange all documents as per Appendix Form-01.
2. **Attestation:** Self-attest or notarize photocopies as required.
3. **Identification:** Clearly mention your name, roll number, and total page count on the form.
4. **Submission:** Send the physical set to the Secretary, MPPSC, Residency Area, Indore.
5. **Labeling:** The envelope must be clearly marked as *"Sahayak Sanchalak/Pashu Chikitsa Sahayak Shalya, Pashu Chikitsa Vistar Adhikari Pariksha-2026 ke Sakshatkar hetu Abhilekh"*.

### Important Instructions
* The current list is **provisional**; eligibility will be verified during the interview.
* Interview dates will be announced separately.
* Any candidate providing false information may be debarred at any stage of the selection process.

## UPSC NDA & NA (II) 2026 Exam Overview

The **Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)** has officially released the e-Admit Cards for the National Defence Academy and Naval Academy Examination (II), 2026. Eligible candidates who applied for the **394 vacancies** can now access their hall tickets via the official portal.

* **Paper I (Mathematics):** 10:00 AM - 12:30 PM
* **Paper II (General Ability Test):** 02:00 PM - 04:30 PM

### 📄 Documents Required for Exam Day
Candidates must carry the following to the center:
* **Printed e-Admit Card** (Clear copy)

* Report to the center at least **30 minutes** before the reporting time.
* Electronic devices (Mobiles, Smartwatches, Calculators) are **strictly prohibited**.
* Ensure the OMR sheet is not folded or damaged.

website_content.markdown_content:
## RCF Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27

Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited (RCF), a **Navratna Public Sector Undertaking**, is engaging apprentices for its Trombay (Mumbai) and Thal (Raigad) units under the Apprentices Act, 1961.

### 📌 Vacancy Breakdown
* **Graduate Apprentices:** 145 Posts (Accounts Executive, Secretarial Assistant, HR Recruitment Executive)
* **Technician Apprentices:** 105 Posts (Diploma in Chemical, Civil, Computer, Electrical, Instrumentation, and Mechanical Engineering)
* **Trade Apprentices:** 76 Posts (Attendant Operator, Instrument Mechanic, Lab Assistant, Boiler Attendant, Electrician, Horticulture Assistant, MLT)

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Education:** Must be a regular full-time course from a recognized University/Institute. (Distance/Part-time not eligible).
* **Age Limit:** 18 to 25 years (as of 01.09.2026). 
* **Age Relaxation:** SC/ST (5 years), OBC (3 years), PwBD (10 years).

### 💰 Monthly Stipend
* **Graduate & B.Sc Trades:** ₹17,300
* **Diploma Technician:** ₹15,900
* **Other Trade Apprentices:** ₹14,600
* **Extra Benefits:** Free breakfast, tea, and vegetarian lunch thali provided at company canteen.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Registration Starts:** 4 September 2026, 8:00 AM
* **Application Deadline:** 20 September 2026, 5:00 PM

### ⚙️ Selection Process
Selection is based on a **Merit List** derived from the percentage marks of the essential educational qualification, followed by **Document Verification**.

The **Directorate of Educational Research & Training (DERT), Meghalaya**, has announced the results for the Meghalaya Teacher Eligibility Test (MTET) 2026. The exam was conducted on **24th July 2026**, and the result was declared on **3rd September 2026** via Memo No. DERT/MTET/18/2026/22.

* **Paper II (Classes VI-VIII) Pass Percentage:** 85.32%

* **Examination Date:** 24th July 2026
* **Result Declaration Date:** 3rd September 2026

The results have been released as **centre-wise roll number lists** in PDF format. Follow these steps:

website_content.title: UPESSC Special TET 2026 Notification for Serving Teachers & CWSN Educators
website_content.summary: UPESSC has released Advertisement 03/2026 for the Special Teacher Eligibility Test (Special TET) 2026. This mandatory exam is for serving Primary/Upper Primary teachers and approximately 2,500 Special Educators (CWSN).
website_content.markdown_content:
## 📢 UPESSC Special TET 2026 Overview
Following Supreme Court mandates, the Uttar Pradesh Government is conducting a **Special Teacher Eligibility Test (Special TET)**. This is a mandatory requirement for serving teachers to maintain their positions and for Special Educators (CWSN).

## 📅 Important Dates
* **Online Registration Starts:** 5 September 2026
* **Last Date for Fee Payment:** 4 October 2026
* **Last Date for Correction:** 8 October 2026
* **Exam Date:** 3 November 2026

## 🎓 Eligibility Criteria

### 1. Serving Teachers
* **Primary Level (Class 1-5):** Teachers in State Govt, Local Body, or Aided schools.
* **Upper Primary Level (Class 6-8):** Teachers in State Govt, Local Body, or Aided schools.

### 2. Special Educators (CWSN)
* **Primary Level:** Graduation + RCI-recognized D.Ed Special Education + Active CRR Number.
* **Upper Primary Level:** Graduation + RCI-recognized B.Ed Special Education + Active CRR Number.

## 💰 Application Fee
| Category | Primary Level | Upper Primary Level |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| General / OBC / EWS | ₹1,000 | ₹1,000 |
| SC / ST | ₹500 | ₹500 |
| PwD | ₹300 | ₹300 |

## 📝 Exam Pattern
* **Mode:** Offline (OMR based)
* **Total Questions:** 150 MCQs
* **Total Marks:** 150 (1 mark per question)
* **Duration:** 2 Hours 30 Minutes
* **Negative Marking:** None
* **Qualifying Marks:** 60% for General; 55% for SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwD.

## 📚 Syllabus Highlights
* **Common Subjects:** Child Development & Teaching Method, Hindi, and English/Urdu/Sanskrit.
* **Primary Level:** Includes Mathematics and Environmental Studies.
* **Upper Primary Level:** Includes Mathematics & Science OR Social Studies.

* **Second Phase Provisional Allotment:** September 2, 2026

## How to Download Allotment Letter
1. Visit the official CEE Kerala website.
2. Navigate to the **Candidate Portal** (Select either 3-Year or 5-Year LLB).
3. Log in using your **Application Number** and **Password/Date of Birth**.
4. Click on the **'Second Phase Provisional Allotment'** link.
5. View your allotted college and download the allotment memo for admission.

## Key Instructions for Candidates
* **Reporting:** Candidates must complete admission formalities within the deadline mentioned in the allotment memo to avoid losing their seat.
* **Upgradation:** If you have moved to a higher-preference college in this phase, your previous admission is automatically cancelled. You must obtain a **Transfer Certificate (TC)** from the previous college.
* **Verification:** Candidates under KIRTADS verification are considered provisionally subject to final approval.

website_content.summary: The Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) has opened Round 2 registration and released the seat matrix for NEET UG 2026. Eligible candidates can register and fill their choices from September 3 to September 8, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## MCC NEET UG Counselling 2026 - Round 2 Overview
The Medical Counselling Committee (MCC), DGHS, has announced the schedule for **Round 2 (AIQ)** for MBBS and BDS courses. This round is critical for candidates seeking admission under the 15% All India Quota.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Registration & Choice Filling Begins:** September 3, 2026
* **Last Date to Register/Lock Choices:** September 8, 2026
* **Seat Allotment Result:** September 11, 2026

### 🎓 Eligibility for Round 2
Round 2 is open to the following categories of candidates:
* Candidates who were **not allotted** any seat in Round 1.
* Candidates who wish to **upgrade** their previously allotted Round 1 seat.
* Candidates who **missed registration** during Round 1.

### 📝 How to Register and Fill Choices
1. **Visit Official Portal:** Access the UG Medical Counselling section.
2. **Fresh Registration:** New candidates must register using their NEET roll number.
3. **Login:** Access the dashboard using registration credentials.
4. **Payment:** Pay the required registration fee and security deposit.
5. **Choice Filling:** Select preferred colleges and courses in order of priority.
6. **Locking:** Ensure choices are locked before the deadline to avoid system auto-locking.

### ⚠️ Important Instructions
* **Upgradation:** Refer to the official bulletin for specific rules regarding seat upgradation.
* **Seat Reversion:** Seats remaining after Round 2 will not be reverted to participating states.
* **Verification:** Candidates are advised to verify the seat matrix PDF for confirmed vacancy figures.

website_content.markdown_content:
## PMBI Recruitment 2026 Overview

The Pharmaceuticals & Medical Devices Bureau of India (PMBI), the implementing agency for PMBJP, is hiring contractual staff for a period of 3 years across various departments.

**Key Details:**
* **Total Vacancies:** 178 posts across 44 designations
* **Appointment Type:** Contractual (Initial 3 years)
* **Application Mode:** Offline (Post/Courier only)
* **Application Fee:** ₹100 (via Demand Draft)

## Post-wise Vacancy Breakdown

| Post Category | Vacancies | Departments |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **General Manager** | 03 | Sales & Marketing / Procurement / Quality |
| **Dy. General Manager** | 06 | Sales, Quality, Finance, IT, Int. Assistance |
| **Manager** | 06 | Procurement, Quality, Grievance, Coordination |
| **Deputy Manager** | 04 | Sales, IT, HR & Admin |
| **Assistant Manager** | 31 | Multiple Departments |
| **Senior Executive** | 61 | Multiple Departments |
| **Senior Marketing Officer** | 15 | Sales & Marketing |
| **Senior Pharmacist** | 06 | Sales & Marketing |
| **Executive** | 10 | Finance, IT, HR, Int. Assistance |
| **Marketing Officer** | 30 | Sales & Marketing |
| **Pharmacist** | 06 | Sales & Marketing |

## Eligibility Criteria

* **Pharmaceuticals/Quality:** B.Pharma / M.Pharma / B.Sc (Biotech/Medicinal Chemistry).
* **Finance/Accounts:** B.Com / M.Com / CA / ICWAI.
* **IT & MIS:** B.Tech / M.Tech (CS) / MCA / BCA.
* **HR & Legal:** Graduate with MBA / LLB.
* **Media:** Degree in Mass Communication/Journalism.
* **Veterinary:** BVSc & AH (specifically for Pasu Aushadhi roles).

## Salary & Benefits

* **Monthly Pay:** Ranges from **₹32,500 to ₹1,58,000** depending on the post.
* **Additional Perks:** Conveyance Allowance, Telephone Allowance, Provident Fund, Group Mediclaim Policy, and Term Life Insurance.

## Important Dates

* **Notification Date:** 03 September 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 24 September 2026 (till 5:00 PM)

website_content.title: SBI Specialist Cadre Officers (SCO) Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: State Bank of India invites applications for 207 Specialist Cadre Officer (SCO) positions in its Wealth Management vertical. The application window is open from September 4 to September 25, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
State Bank of India (SBI) is looking for experienced professionals for its Wealth Management vertical on a contract basis. These roles are spread across 17 Circles nationwide with a contract duration of 5 years (renewable for another 4 years).

## Vacancy Details
Total Tentative Vacancies: **207**

* **Zonal Head (Retail):** 1
* **Regional Head:** 5
* **Relationship Manager–Team Lead:** 24
* **Investment Specialist:** 9
* **Investment Officer:** 4
* **VP Wealth:** 91
* **AVP Wealth:** 73

## Eligibility Criteria

### Educational Qualification
* **Zonal/Regional Head & RM/VP/AVP:** Graduate (MBA, CFP/CFA/NISM preferred).
* **Investment Specialist/Officer:** PG Degree/Diploma in Finance, Accountancy, Commerce, Economics, Capital Markets, Banking, or CA/CFA.

### Experience Required
* **Zonal Head:** 15+ years in Wealth Management/Retail Banking sales.
* **Regional Head:** 12+ years in relationship management.
* **RM-Team Lead:** 8+ years in relationship management.
* **Investment Specialist:** 6+ years as investment advisor/officer.
* **Investment Officer:** 4+ years post-qualification experience.
* **VP Wealth:** 6+ years in sales & marketing with banks/wealth firms.
* **AVP Wealth:** 3+ years in sales & marketing or 4 years as SBI Wealth CRE.

## Compensation & Benefits
* **Salary:** Annual CTC ranges from **₹27.10 Lakhs (Investment Officer)** to **₹97.00 Lakhs (Zonal Head)**.
* **Additional:** Performance Linked Pay (0% to 45% of Fixed Pay) and Annual Increment Band.

## Important Dates
* **Registration Start Date:** 04-09-2026
* **Application Deadline:** 25-09-2026

## Selection Process
1. **Shortlisting:** Based on qualifications and experience.
2. **Interview:** Personal, telephonic, or video interview (100 marks).
3. **CTC Negotiation:** Individual negotiation for shortlisted candidates.

website_content.title: HOS 10th & 12th Re-Appear, CTP Exam 2026 Date Sheet and Application
website_content.summary: The Haryana Open School (BSEH) has announced the date sheets and application process for Class 10th and 12th Re-Appear and CTP examinations 2026. Exams are scheduled to take place in October 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## HOS Re-Appear & CTP Exam 2026 Overview

Haryana Open School (HOS), under the **Board of School Education Haryana (BSEH)**, has released the schedule and application details for students appearing for Re-Appear, CTP (Compartment), and Additional examinations for the year 2026.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 15 June 2026
* **Online Application Start:** 23 June 2026
* **Last Date (No Late Fee):** 15 July 2026
* **Class 10th Exam Dates:** 1 October 2026 to 13 October 2026
* **Class 12th Exam Dates:** 1 October 2026 to 22 October 2026

### 💰 Exam Fee Structure
| Class | CTP / Additional Fee | Re-Appear Fee | Practical Fee |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **10th** | ₹1,250 | ₹1,150 | ₹100 |
| **12th** | ₹1,300 | ₹1,200 | ₹100 |

### ⚠️ Late Fee Penalties
* **16 July - 26 July:** ₹100
* **27 July - 7 August:** ₹300
* **8 August - 18 August:** ₹1,000

### 📝 How to Apply
1. Visit the official HOS application portal.
2. Log in or register using your credentials.
3. Select the appropriate exam category (**CTP/Additional** or **Re-Appear**) for Class 10th or 12th.
4. Enter required details and pay the applicable fee online.
5. Submit the form and print the confirmation page.

### 📌 Key Instructions
* Ensure the application fee is paid online before the deadline to avoid heavy late fees.
* Download the official date sheet PDF for the specific subject-wise schedule.
* Carry a printed copy of the admit card to the examination center.

website_content.title: APSC Forest Ranger Provisional Answer Key 2026
website_content.summary: The Assam Public Service Commission (APSC) has released the provisional answer keys for the Forest Ranger Screening Test (Botany & Zoology). Candidates can submit objections online until September 7, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## APSC Forest Ranger Provisional Answer Key 2026

The Assam Public Service Commission (APSC) has officially released the provisional answer keys for the OMR-based Screening Test conducted for the post of **Forest Ranger** in the Assam Forest Service under the Environment & Forests Department, Assam.

### 📌 Key Exam Details
* **Advertisement No:** 22/2025
* **Subjects:** Botany and Zoology
* **Marks:** 200 marks per subject
* **Duration:** 2 hours per subject
* **Exam Mode:** OMR-based MCQ

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Screening Test Date:** 03 September 2026
* **Answer Key Release Date:** 03 September 2026
* **Deadline for Objections/Claims:** On or before **07 September 2026**

### 🛠️ How to Raise an Objection
If you disagree with the provisional answer key, follow these guidelines:
* **Mode:** Submissions must be made **online only** via the official portal.
* **Requirement:** Every claim must be backed by an **authentic source** (general websites or unspecified documents are not accepted).
* **Restrictions:** Objections sent via email or hard copy will be strictly ignored.

### 📝 Steps to Download Answer Key
1. Visit the official APSC portal.
2. Navigate to the Forest Ranger Screening Test section (Advt. No. 22/2025).
3. Download the subject-wise PDF for **Botany** or **Zoology**.
4. Match your question paper series (A, B, C, or D) with the provided answer key table.

website_content.title: Maharashtra DSE CAP Round 4 Seat Allotment Result 2026
website_content.summary: The Maharashtra CET Cell has released the Round 4 seat allotment results for Direct Second Year Engineering (DSE) admissions. Eligible candidates must complete seat acceptance and institute reporting by September 7, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **State Common Entrance Test Cell (CET Cell), Maharashtra** has announced the results for the **DSE CAP Round 4**. This result is critical for candidates seeking admission into the Direct Second Year Engineering (DSE) programs through the Centralized Admission Process (CAP).

## Important Dates
* **Result Release Date:** September 4, 2026
* **Online Seat Acceptance Window:** September 5 to September 7, 2026 (up to 3:00 PM)
* **Physical Reporting to Institute:** On or before September 7, 2026 (up to 5:00 PM)

## How to Check Allotment Status
1. Visit the official Maharashtra DSE counselling portal.
2. Click on the **CAP Round 4 seat allotment result** link.
3. Log in using your **Application ID** and **Date of Birth**.
4. Review the allotted institute and engineering programme.
5. Download and save the allotment result PDF for admission formalities.

## Post-Allotment mandatory Steps
* **Seat Acceptance:** Log in and accept the offered seat online by Sept 7, 3:00 PM.
* **Fee Payment:** Complete the payment of the seat acceptance fee via the candidate login.
* **Institute Reporting:** Report to the allotted college physically by Sept 7, 5:00 PM to confirm your admission.

## Key Instructions
* Use only the official portal to avoid third-party scams.
* Keep your login credentials ready to avoid last-minute technical delays.
* Ensure you report to the institute; online acceptance alone does not complete the admission process.

website_content.title: MCC NEET UG Counselling 2026 Round 2 Registration
website_content.summary: The Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) has commenced Round 2 registration for NEET UG 2026. This round covers seats for MBBS, BDS, and B.Sc Nursing across AIQ, AIIMS, JIPMER, and Deemed Universities.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) and DGHS have opened the registration and choice filling window for **NEET UG 2026 Round 2**. This phase is critical for candidates seeking admission into 15% All India Quota (AIQ) seats and 100% seats in Deemed/Central Universities, AFMC, ESIC, AIIMS, and JIPMER.

## Available Courses
* **MBBS**
* **BDS**
* **B.Sc Nursing** (under applicable quotas)

## Key Dates to Remember
* **Registration Window:** September 3 to September 8, 2026
* **Choice Filling Window:** September 3 to September 9, 2026
* **Choice Locking:** September 8 to September 9, 2026
* **PwD Medical Assessment Deadline:** September 5, 2026
* **Seat Allotment Result:** September 11, 2026
* **Reporting at Allotted Institute:** September 12 to September 18, 2026

## Step-by-Step Registration Process
1. Visit the official MCC portal.
2. Navigate to the **UG Medical Counselling** section and select the Round 2 registration link.
3. New candidates select **'New Registration'**; returning candidates log in with existing credentials.
4. Enter NEET UG roll number and personal details.
5. Upload required scanned documents (photograph, signature, and certificates).
6. Complete the payment for the non-refundable registration fee and refundable security deposit.
7. Log in during the choice filling window to arrange and lock college preferences.

## Critical Instructions
* **Payment Source:** Use only your own bank account/card to ensure seamless refunds.
* **Choice Locking:** Once the locking window closes, no further changes can be made to preferences.
* **Document Readiness:** Ensure all certificates are correctly uploaded to avoid allotment cancellation.

Eligible candidates must lock their college and branch preferences for the provisional seat allotment on September 9.
website_content.markdown_content:
## TNEA Supplementary Counselling 2026

The **Directorate of Technical Education (DoTE), Tamil Nadu** is conducting the supplementary counselling process for engineering admissions 2026. Candidates listed in the supplementary rank list can now proceed with their college preferences.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Registration & Certificate Upload:** August 17 - August 31, 2026
* **Supplementary Rank List Release:** September 3, 2026
* **Choice Filling Start Date:** September 4, 2026
* **Provisional Allotment Release:** September 9, 2026

### 🛠️ Allotment Process
* **Registration:** Online registration and document upload of scanned certificates.
* **Rank Generation:** DoTE releases rank lists based on merit and category.
* **Choice Filling:** Candidates log in to arrange preferred colleges and branches in order of priority.
* **Tentative Allotment:** System matches candidates based on rank, category, and choices.
* **Confirmation:** Candidates must confirm their acceptance (e.g., accept and join or accept and upward movement).
* **Provisional Allotment:** Final order released on September 9, 2026.

### ⚠️ Key Instructions
* **Maximize Choices:** Enter as many college and branch options as possible to increase the likelihood of allotment.
* **Priority Order:** Arrange choices strictly according to genuine preference (highest priority first).
* **Mandatory Confirmation:** Failure to confirm the tentative allotment within the deadline will result in automatic cancellation of the seat.
* **Verification:** Regularly monitor registered email and mobile numbers for official notifications.

website_content.markdown_content:
## DVC Overman Recruitment 2026 Overview
Damodar Valley Corporation (DVC) has announced contractual engagements for experienced professionals to serve as Overmen. 

**Key Highlights:**
* **Post Name:** Overman (Contractual)

* **Certification 1:** Valid Overman's Certificate of Competency issued by DGMS for Coal (under CMR 2017/1957).
* **Certification 2:** Valid First Aid Certificate from a DGMS-recognized organization.

### Experience Requirement
* Minimum **three years** of post-qualification working experience in open cast coal mines specifically as an Overman.

### Age Limit
* **Maximum Age:** 55 Years (as of the application closing date).
* Age relaxation applies as per Government of India rules.

## Selection Process
Selection will be conducted via:
* **Interview / Skill Test**
* DVC may conduct additional screening or trade tests if deemed necessary.

## Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 03 September 2026
* **Application Start Date:** 03 September 2026
* **Last Date to Apply:** 21 September 2026 (23:59 hrs)
* **Interview Date:** To be announced

## How to Apply
1. Visit the official DVC website.
2. Navigate to **Career → Recruitment → Recruitment Notices**.
3. Fill in personal and professional details.
4. Upload necessary documents (Photo, Signature, Diploma, DGMS Certificates, Experience Letter).
5. Submit and print the application form.

website_content.title: JNVST Class 9 & 11 Lateral Entry Selection Test (LEST) 2027-28
website_content.summary: Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti (NVS) invites online applications for lateral entry admission to Class 9 and Class 11 for the 2027-28 academic session. The application window closes on September 30, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti (NVS)**, under the Ministry of Education, has announced the Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya Selection Test (JNVST) Lateral Entry Selection Test (LEST) 2027. This is a prime opportunity for students to secure admission into premier residential schools.

## Important Dates
* **Online Application Start:** September 2, 2026
* **Application Deadline:** September 30, 2026
* **Correction Window:** October 1 to October 3, 2026
* **LEST 2027 Exam Date:** April 10, 2027

## Eligibility Criteria
* **For Class 9 Admission:** Students currently studying in **Class 8** in a government or government-recognized school.
* **For Class 11 Admission:** Students currently studying in **Class 10** in a government or government-recognized school.
* **District Domicile:** Applicants must be studying in the same district as the JNV they are applying to.

## Application Process
* **Registration:** Visit the official NVS portal and register for the respective class.
* **Details:** Fill in basic personal, academic, and communication details.
* **Documents:** Upload photograph, candidate signature, parent signature, and category/UDID certificate (if applicable).
* **Verification:** Preview the application and submit before the deadline.
* **Confirmation:** Download and print the registration slip for future reference.

## Key Instructions
* Ensure the **Date of Birth** matches school records exactly.
* Use an active mobile number and email for admit card and result notifications.
* Refer to the official NVS prospectus for legal eligibility and procedural details.

website_content.title: AP PGCET 2026 Counselling Registration
website_content.summary: The Commissionerate of Higher Education, AP, has opened registration for AP PGCET 2026 counselling for admission into 150+ PG programmes. Eligible candidates must register via the CAP portal by September 8, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## AP PGCET 2026-27 Counselling Overview

The Commissionerate of Higher Education, Government of Andhra Pradesh (APSCHE), has officially opened the counselling process for candidates who qualified in the **AP PGCET 2026** exam. This process facilitates admission into postgraduate programmes across various state universities.

## Key Highlights
* **Participating Institutions:** 17 state universities, their constituent/affiliated colleges, and eligible private universities.
* **Courses Available:** Over **150+ postgraduate (PG) programmes**.
* **Seat Allotment:** Based on PGCET rank, reservation category, local area status, and candidate web options.

## Important Dates
* **Notification Release:** September 1, 2026
* **Registration Start Date:** September 3, 2026
* **Registration End Date:** September 8, 2026

## Step-by-Step Application Process
1. **Login:** Access the CAP portal using your Hall Ticket Number and Date of Birth.
2. **Verification:** Review personal, academic, and rank details.
3. **Documentation:** Upload scanned certificates if automatic verification is unavailable.
4. **Payment:** Pay the non-refundable processing fee via UPI, Debit/Credit Card, or Net Banking.
5. **Submission:** Submit the form and download the confirmation slip.

## Allotment Workflow
* Online Registration $\rightarrow$ Certificate Verification $\rightarrow$ Web Options Entry $\rightarrow$ Seat Allotment $\rightarrow$ Self-Reporting at College.

website_content.title: GMC Mahabubnagar Contract Faculty Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: Government Medical College, Mahabubnagar is hiring 149 contract faculty members including Professors and Junior Residents. Interested candidates must attend a walk-in interview on September 15, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The Office of the Director, GMC Mahabubnagar, has announced recruitment for **149 purely temporary contract positions** across 22 departments. 

**Key Details:**
* **Notification No:** 02/GMC-MBNR/2026
* **Appointment Nature:** Contract basis (up to 31-03-2027)
* **Application Mode:** Walk-in Interview Only

## Vacancy Distribution
| Post Name | Total Vacancies | Monthly Remuneration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Professor** | 8 | ₹1,90,000 |
| **Associate Professor** | 19 | ₹1,50,000 |
| **Assistant Professor** | 62 | ₹1,25,000 |
| **Tutor** | 10 | ₹55,000 |
| **Junior Resident** | 50 | ₹46,000 |

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Professors/Associate Professors:** MD/MS/DNB in the concerned subject with required teaching and research experience as per NMC TEQ Regulations 2025.
* **Assistant Professors:** MD/MS in the concerned subject with 1 year of Senior Residency or equivalent experience.
* **Tutors/Junior Residents:** MBBS or equivalent degree.
* **Mandatory Requirement:** Must be registered with the **Telangana State Medical Council**.

## Important Dates & Venue
* **Walk-in Interview Date:** 15-09-2026 (9:00 AM to 3:00 PM)
* **Result Declaration:** 17-09-2026
* **Joining Deadline:** 30-09-2026
* **Venue:** Office of the Director, Govt. Medical College, Mahabubnagar, Edira Campus, Thirulmalla Hills, Mahabubnagar District.

## Required Documents
* Filled application form (from official website)
* Aadhar, PAN, and Date of Birth proof
* Degree certificates and marks memos (MBBS/MD/MS/DNB)
* Telangana Medical Council Registration
* Experience & Senior Residency certificates
* BCBR and MET Certificates (for faculty)

website_content.title: UPSSSC Computer Operator & Assistant Computer Operator Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: UPSSSC invites applications for Computer Operator Grade-A and Assistant Computer Operator posts at the Advocate General's Office, Allahabad High Court. Eligible PET-2025 candidates must apply by September 28, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
UPSSSC has released Advertisement No. 20-Pariksha/2026 for technical positions within the Office of the Advocate General, Allahabad High Court. These are temporary positions selected via a Main Examination based on PET-2025 merit.

## Vacancy Details
* **Computer Operator Grade-A:** 11 Posts (Level-4)
* **Assistant Computer Operator:** 01 Post (Level-2)
* **Total Vacancies:** 12

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Mandatory:** Must have appeared in **PET-2025** and possess a valid score card.
* **Education (Both Posts):** Bachelor's degree from a recognized university AND a Diploma in Computer Science or NIELIT 'O' Level certificate.
* **Experience:** 
    * Grade-A: 3 years of experience in computer applications.
    * Assistant: 2 years of experience in computer applications.
* **Age Limit:** 21 to 40 years (as of July 1, 2026). Age relaxation applies as per government norms.

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 07 September 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 28 September 2026
* **Correction Window Closes:** 05 October 2026

## Salary Structure
* **Computer Operator Grade-A:** ₹25,500 – ₹81,100 (Grade Pay ₹2,400)
* **Assistant Computer Operator:** ₹19,900 – ₹63,200 (Grade Pay ₹1,900)

## Selection Process
Shortlisting will be done based on normalized **PET-2025 scores** (15 times the vacancies per category). Shortlisted candidates will appear for a written Main Examination.

website_content.summary: Calicut University has announced the 4th Semester M.A. Sanskrit and 2nd Semester MCA scrutiny results for 2026. Candidates can now download their provisional marks via the official results portal.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Calicut University Result 2026

Calicut University has officially released the examination results for specific postgraduate programs on its official portal.

**Results Declared:**
* **M.A. Sanskrit Language and Literature (General):** Fourth Semester (Distance) SDE CBCSS Examination 4/2026 (2022 Admission).
* **Master of Computer Applications (MCA):** Scrutiny Result of Second Semester Examination 4/2026 (2023, 2024, and 2025 Admissions).

**Key Highlights:**
* **Declaration Date:** 3 September 2026
* **Mode of Result:** Online
* **Credential Required:** Registration Number
* **Result Status:** Provisional (Final mark sheets will be issued separately by the university).

**Steps to Check Result:**
1. Visit the official results portal.
2. Select the link corresponding to your specific course and semester.
3. Enter your **Registration Number** and the captcha code.
4. Click **Submit** to view your marks, grade, and evaluation details.
5. Download and print the result for future reference.

website_content.title: GPSC Inspector of Inspection (Building and Other Construction) Class-2 Result 2026
website_content.summary: The Gujarat Public Service Commission has released the final list of candidates eligible for personal interviews for the post of Inspector of Inspection of Building and Other Construction, Class-2. This list follows the preliminary exams and application scrutiny conducted for Advertisement No. 98/2025-26.
website_content.markdown_content:
## GPSC Inspector Interview Eligibility List 2026

The Gujarat Public Service Commission (GPSC) has officially announced the candidates qualified for the face-to-face interview stage for the **Inspector of Inspection of Building and Other Construction (Class-2)** position.

### 📌 Key Recruitment Details
* **Organization:** Gujarat Public Service Commission (GPSC)
* **Advertisement No:** 98/2025-26
* **Department:** Labour, Skill Development and Employment Department, Govt. of Gujarat
* **Post Name:** Inspector of Inspection of Building and Other Construction, Class-2

### 📊 Selection Statistics
* **Candidates Scrutinized:** 189
* **Eligible for Interview:** 155
* **Not Eligible:** 34

### 📅 Important Timeline
* **Subject Preliminary Paper:** 3 May 2026
* **General Studies Preliminary Paper:** 10 May 2026
* **Scrutiny List Publication:** 25 June 2026
* **Interview Eligibility List Publication:** 2 September 2026

### 🛠️ How to Check Your Status
1. Visit the official GPSC portal.
2. Navigate to the notice section for **Advt No. 98/2025-26**.
3. Download the official PDF result list.
4. Search for your seat/bench number using `Ctrl+F`.

### 🚀 Next Steps for Eligible Candidates
* **Stay Updated:** Regularly check the GPSC website for the interview schedule, venue, and call letters.
* **Documentation:** Prepare all original certificates and identity proofs required for the personal interview.
* **Verification:** Always verify your result through the official government portal.
